sanskrit: ātmārthaṃ ca parārthaṃ ca dvividhaṃ yajanaṃ matamdīpāntaṃ ca haviṣyāntaṃ dvividho vidhirucyatepradhānaṃ sarvadīkṣāsu śivadīkṣā viśiṣyatecaturvidhaṃ samākhyataṃ dīpāntaṃ havirantakamśaucamācamanaṃ snānaṃ bhasmasnānaṃ ca tarpaṇamaṅganyāsakaranyāsaṃ mahātattvādilakṣaṇaṃgranthinaśchedanaṃ paścād bhūtaśuddhau tu saṃbhavamdvārapūjāṃ tathā paścāt sthāna śuddhimataḥ parampādyamācamanaṃ cārghyaṃ gandhadravyasya lakṣaṇaṃsaptavāyurpācārayat mahāghaṇṭāpratāḍanammukhaṃ pādaṃ ca pṛṣṭhaṃ ca pīṭhaśuddhimataḥ parampañcāvaraṇapūjāṃ ca teṣāṃ varṇākṛtiṃ tataḥkavāṭo dumbara vidhiṃ dhūpadhīpavidhiṃ tataḥparivārārcanaṃ caiva sarvadevārcanaṃ tataḥnityotsavaṃ tataḥ paścāt pādukābhyarcanaṃ tathāityevamādikāḥ sarvā yo vindati sa pūjakaḥgatvāgrāmādbahiḥ paścāt viṇmūtrādi visarjayetraviṃ dakṣaṇataḥ kṛtvā dakṣiṇābhimukho niśipratyādityajalāgnīnāṃ candra go brāhmaṇān pratikṣetreṣu vṛkṣacchāyāyāṃ nadyāmantaḥ sarassu canakṣatre candramaye caiva na kuryādubhayaṃ naraḥjalatīre samāgamya śaucaṃ paścāt samācaretpañcadhāpādahastau ca tridhā caiva praśodhayetsapavitrakaraḥ kuryāt tribhirdarbhaistu pañcabhiḥsthale tu dakṣiṇaṃ pādaṃ kṛtvā vāmāṃ jale sthitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yathā trivāraṃ pītvā tu ṛgyajuḥsāmamantrakaiḥśrotreṅguṣṭhe kaniṣṭhābhyāṃ bāhyāṅguṣṭhena saṃspṛśetmūrdhni sarvāṅgulibhistu pañcaprahyaṣaḍaṅgakaiḥsnānāddhi mṛdamādāya vinyase dakṣiṇādhikamkavacena brahma tīrthābhi mantra krameṇa tudakṣiṇena mṛdā cāssu śivatīrthaṃ prakalpayetpaścāt snānaṃ prakurvīta caredācamanaṃ budhaḥmāṣamagnaṃ tu yadvāri tat tan mantraiḥ pibed budhaḥdvijānāṃ dakṣiṇe haste pañcatīrthaṃ pracoditamsāvitryāṣṭaśataṃ japtvā upasthānaṃ samācaretkaniṣṭhamadhyarekhābhiḥ tarpayet suratṛptayeaṅguṣṭhatarjanīmadhye pitṛtarpaṇa mācaretpāda prakṣālanaṃ kṛtvā paścādācamanaṃ caretsadyena gomayaṃ grāhyaṃ piṇḍaṃ vāmena kārayetbhasmaṃ tu brahmavidyāṅgaiḥ patrāmatraiśca vinyasetpraviśedālayaṃ paścādācāryastu samāhitaḥaghorāstraṃ samuccārya kavāṭod ghāṭanaṃ kriyātuttarābhimukho bhūtvā rucirāsanasaṃsthitaḥśivamantraśataṃ japtvā bhasmanā snānamācaretdaśadigbandhanaṃ kṛtvā astreṇaiva tu deśikaḥpūrakaṃ kumbhakaṃ caiva recakaṃ pūrvamabhyasetdrutivat pūrayet saṃmyak jaṭharaṃ bāhyavāyunāantarbahisthitaṃ vāyuṃ na gṛhṇāni na muñcatidvādaśena tu mātreṇa recakādīn tathābhyasetbrahmacāri gṛhasthānāṃ sṛṣṭiśca sthitireva ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dakṣiṇādi kaniṣṭhāntamaṅguṣṭhāntaṃ tu vāmataḥdakṣiṇāṅguṣṭhamādi syāt kaniṣṭhādi tathotarevāmāṅguṣṭhamathādi syād dakṣiṇāṅguṣṭhamantataḥkaranyāsamidaṃ proktamaṅganyāsaṃ tataḥ parammūrdhni vaktre ca hṛdaye guhye pāde yathākramampāde guhye ca hṛdaye vaktre murdhni ca vinyasethṛdaye hṛdayaṃ nyāsaṃ śiraḥ śirasi vinyasetastraṃ hasta pradeśe tu netraṃ netreṣu vinyasetpṛthivyādi mahātatve sthitaṃ tattvaṃ samāsataḥvakṣye pṛthak pṛthak nyāsaṃ aṅguṣṭhādi yathākramamaṅguṣṭhādi ca jānvantaṃ pañcoccāryaṃ tu hyānyasetjānvādinābhiparyantaṃ hviṃ ceti caturastataḥvāyumaṇḍalamevoktaṃ hyaiṃ ceti dvisamuccaretdhūmraṃ vṛttaṃ tathākāśaṃ maṇḍalaṃ tu sadāśivampṛthivyā lakṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ pañcagranthistu chedayettritīyam udaragranthi galagranthi caturthakamgranthicchedamidaṃ proktamātmaśuddhiṃ tu kārayetśikhāgre dvādaśāṅgulyā śuddhasphaṭikasannibheagnimaṇḍalasaṃyuktaṃ agnibījena dāhayetbhasmākāramidaṃ dhyātvā amṛte plāvayet tataḥamṛtaṃ cintayed bhinne sauṣumne mastake śubhesarvajñānamayaṃ devaṃ sarvadevamayaṃ śubhamaṅganyāsaṃ tataḥ kuryāt mūrdhnādīśānapūrvakamīśānaṃ pañcamūrdhni syāt puruṣaṃ vadaneṣu cahṛgrīvayostathācāse jaṭhare nābhipṛṣṭhayoḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: liṅge corvostathā jānvoḥ jaṅghayoḥ sphikpradeśataḥpādau pāṇyaustathā ghrāṇe śiro bāhū tu sadyataḥhṛdayābje nyased devaṃ praṇavākāramīśvaramaṅguṣṭhamātramacalaṃ śivavidyāṅgasaṃyutamdhyāyet tatreśvaraṃ samyagantaryāgamidaṃ kramātśvetaṃ raktaṃ tathā pītaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ caiva caturvidhamnandyāvarttaṃ śriyāvartaṃ mahādroṇaṃ ca sātvikamraktotpalāni puṣpāṇi rājasāni vinirdiśetmiśrakāni samākhyātaṃ viṣṇukrāntyupalāni cakaraṃ ca bandhūkaḥ karamudaḥ ḍāḍimī kiṃśukādayaḥapakvādīni mukulaṃ lūtasūtravṛtāni caekāhoṣitapuṣpāṇi varjayet tu prayatnataḥvṛṣabhagāyatrimantreṇa śivāgre vṛṣabhaṃ yajetdvārordhve vāmapārśve tu sarasvatīṃ prapūjayetdvārasya dakṣiṇe pārśve gaṅgānandinamarcayettattat svanāmamantreṇa gandhapuṣpādibhiryajetcaturaśramaṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā tritalaṃ ca hṛdā budhaḥsthānaśuddhiriti khyātaḥ pādyācamanapātrakamkalaśaṃ hṛdaye naiva kavacenāvakuṇṭhayetpañcabrahmaṣaḍaṅgaiśca pātre mantraiśca tajjalaiḥaṣṭadroṇajalaiścāpi tadardhārdhajalai kramātprokṣayet sarvapātrāṇi hṛnmantreṇa śivāmbhasāyavasiddhārthadūrvāśca candanośīrasaṃyutāḥelālavaṅgakarpūraṃ ṣaṅgācamanaṃ bhavettaṇḍulaiḥ sarṣapopetamarghyametat prakīrtitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śivayogyaṃ bhaved dravyaṃ sā kriyā dravyaśodhinīgandhadravyamidaṃ proktaṃ śītāri cādhunocyateaguruṃ caikabhāgaṃ syāt kiñcit karpūramiśritamāvāhane ca pūjānte visarjanānte yojayetāvāhane tathā cārghyena snāne dhūpe vilepaneāvāhane tathā cārghye pādye snāne tathaiva caāvāhanaṃ purāproktaṃ sthāpanārghye tathaiva cavisargācamīye ca upacārā daśa smṛtāḥdhūpadīpena saṃyojya dīpaṃ dhūpena yojayetnamaḥ svāhā vaṣaḍvauṣaṭ svāhāntaṃ praṇavādikammanasāntarajapye tu sarvamantramudāhṛtamabhiṣeke ca dhūpe ca naivedye liṅgakarmaṇipāpiṣṭhakuṣṭharogārtanāstikanāmadarśayetpūjāparyuṣitaṃ puṣpaṃ hṛdayena visarjayetliṅgapīṭhasthalaṃ sarvaṃ śuddhaṃ kṛtvā śivāmbhasāgandhapuṣpādinā pūjya liṅge sarvāṅgamuddharetsūtrapārśve tu pārśvaṃ syādaghoreṇa tu saṃspṛśetmahāpaṭṭidvipādāntaṃ devyaṅgāni tu saṃspṛśetāgneyādiṣu koṇeṣu dharmajñānāni vinyasetśuklaṃ raktaṃ tathā pītaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ siṃhasya rūpakamtanmadhye candramācchādya samagātrairupasthitamavyakto niyataḥ kālaḥ kalāśceti catuṣṭayamevaṃ yogāsanaṃ kalpya padmāsanamataḥ parampārthivaṃ tasya mūlaṃ syādviṣṇubījaṃ svanālakambījaṃ śaṃkhanibhaṃ nālaṃ vaiḍūryaṃ maṇisannibham
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tat tad bījena saṃyojya padmāsanamidaṃ kramātnaivedyārcanakāle tu kalpayet padmamāsanamkāṣṭhādicayane vahni tathāvāhanamucyateāvāhanodvāsane ca śivaliṅge na kārayetsānnidhyaṃ dhvajamudreṇa pañcamudrāṃ prakalpayetsadyenāvāhya vāmena sthāpayet tu nirodhanamevaṃ saṅkalpya vidhinā pūjayet parameśvaramdaśabāhudharaṃ divyaṃ daśāyudhadharaṃ śubhamdivyāmbaradharaṃ saumyaṃ divyagandhānulepanamśūlaṃ vajraṃ ca khaḍgaṃ ca śaktyābhītī ca dakṣiṇeevaṃ dhyātvā tu manasā pādayoḥ pādyamādiśetpūrvamīśānamūrtiḥ syāt aiśvarī dakṣiṇe tathāsadāśivā tadūrdhve tu pañcamūrtiriti smṛtāīśānena tu mantreṇa triyambakenābhiṣecanamkuḍubājya dadhiproktaṃ dviguṇaṃ triguṇaṃ payaḥpratyekamāḍhakaṃ vātha pādyādi snapayet kramātvastrottarīyopavītāni gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ sudhūpakammakuṭaṃ kuṇḍalaṃ hāraṃ keyuraṃ kaṭisūtrakamevaṃ pūjyavidhānena paścādāvaraṇe yajetāsanāvaraṇaṃ sthāyi vidhinā caiva pūjayetkuṅkumadyuti saṃṅkāśaṃ vaktramantreṇa pūjayetśyāmavarṇaśikhāṃ paścāt sadyaṃ śvetākṛtiṃ tataḥdhūmrabhāsaṃ śirovidyād iśānenaiva pūjayetiśāne pūjayennetraṃ taruṇāditya sannibhamtriṇetrāścaturbhujā sarve ṣaḍaṅgaṃ pañcamūrtayaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tattadvarṇanibhairvastraistriśūlaparaśūjvalāḥmāheśaṃ stāśivaṃ madhye hṛdayena tu karṇikāmiṣṭottare tathā vidyāddhṛdayena tu mantravitjapāpuṣpanibho'nantaḥ pūjayedgandhapuṣpakaiḥśrīkaṇṭhamutpalābhāsaṃ śivoktaṃ caindusannibhamkundapuṣpanibhākāram ekarudraṃ yathākramamsarvābharaṇasaṃyuktā jaṭāmakuṭabhūṣitāḥnandinaṃ tvañjanābhāsaṃ daṇḍahastaṃ trilocanamtriṇetraṃ caturbhujaṃ caiva śūlahastaṃ mahābalamtriṇetraṃ caturbhujaṃ śūlaṃ dantapāśāṅkuśairyutamraktavarṇaṃ kumāraṃ syācchaktihastaṃ tu ṣaṇmukhamumā jāmbūnadābhāsā haste kusumadhāriṇivaiḍūryadyuti saṃkāśaṃ caṇḍeśaṃ śūlahastakamśyāmaṃ tu piṅgalaṃ dhūmraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ śvetaṃ ca pītakambrahmāṇaṃ mūdhyataḥ paścāt myaritirvāruṇādhyamecaturbhujaṃ triṇetraṃ ca īśānaṃ ca prakīrtitamcaturvaktro'ṣṭanetraṃ ca brahmā caiva caturbhujaḥevametat krameṇaiva bhāvayitvātha pūjayetnīlāgnipadmarāgaṃ ca tuṣāraṃ caindranīlakampadmamiṣṭvātha pārśve tu viṣṇoścakraṃ tu pārśvataḥśeṣāḥ pumāṃso vikhyātā daśāyudha tridhocyateevamāvaraṇaṃ pūjya kṣetrapālaṃ tu śāṅkarephalakaṃ caturaśraṃ tu pīṭhotsedhaṃ tu mānataḥcaturbhujāṃ tribhedaiśca pṛthak prācchedanāṃ pratinandī cānī ca balli ca prakuṇīṃ ca praṇālake
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gaurigāyatryā saṃpūjya vaṭodumbaramācaretalābhe kāṃsyapātre tu piṣṭaṃ bhasma tu kausumampradoṣe pratidinaṃ kuryāt svastimaṅgalavācakaiḥpaścālliṅgaṃ tu puṣpeṇa tribhiḥ parivṛto nayetgandhamekāvṛtaṃ nītvā dīpapātre hṛdā budhaḥmūrdhnipuṣpaṃ nyasitvā tu sarvatra hṛdayena vaipaścādācamanaṃ kuryānnaivedyaṃ tu pradāpayettaṇḍulaṃ veṇunīvāraṃ madhyamaṃ samudāhṛtamuttamaṃ tu śatadroṇaṃ tadardhaṃ madhyamaṃ bhavetdvādaśadroṇamevaṃ vā cāṣṭadroṇamathāpi vāevaṃ naimittikaṃ kuryāt tadardhaṃ nityameva cadroṇārdhaṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā tathānyat parivarjayetnānāvidhopadaṃśaiśca kapilājyadadhi plutamnirmālyaṃ ca nivedyaṃ ca laṅghane dānakarmaṇinityāgnikāryaṃ kurvīta pacanālayāt pāvakearatnimātravistāraṃ bilaṃ tanmānamucyateyāvanmūlopacāreṇa tāvadagniṃ supūjayetparito darbhairācchādya sthāpayet pariṣecanamājyāhu dṛkṣamantreṇa haviṃ hutvā viśeṣataḥpraṇavaṃ huṃ puroddhe tu hutvā cānnaṃ hunet kramātkūśmāṇḍaṃ ca hunet paścāt sviṣṭamagnau samācaretekabhāgaṃ tu naivedyaṃ ekabhāgaṃ hutaṃ bhavetpramādābhinnakāle tu aghoreṇa śatāhutiḥparivārāṣṭakamabhyarcya puruṣādīśamāśritamvighnaṃ guhaṃ ca jyeṣṭhāṃ ca durgāṃ sūryamiti kramāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mūrdhni cābhyarcya pīṭhaṃ cenmadhyamekhalamadhyameliṅgārcanaṃ purā proktaṃ sakalādyarcanaṃ kramātsukhāsanaṃ tathā nandivāhanaṃ puraśāsanamardhanārīśvaraṃ caiva śaṅkarārdhaṃ hariṃ tathākālanāśaṃ tathā caiva liṅgadvādaśameva cahayardhanārīśaṃ śyāmam anyeṣāṃ raktavarṇakamvidyādevamime sarve śvetavarṇāḥ prakīrtitāḥtriṇetrāścaturbhujāḥ sarve sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥpañcaśuddhiṃ tataḥ kṛtvā paścādyajanamārabhetśivāmbhaḥ prokṣayenmantrī īśānena kuśaistathāaghoreṇārghyamuddiṣṭaṃ gandhaṃ puruṣamantrataḥnaivedyaṃ caiva tāmbūlaṃ hṛnmantreṇa pradāpayetmakuṭaṃ kuṇḍalaṃ caiva hāraṃ keyūrameva catasmādāvāhanaṃ pūrvaṃ tathaivod vāsanaṃ sadāsūryakāmotha nāgendro guho lakṣmīśca raktakāḥśāstādurgāmahāmoṭī jyeṣṭhākālisurādhipāḥevameva samākhyātaṃ bhāvayitvātha pūjayettatta svanāma mantreṣu śodhanadekapañcakamdadyātsadyena pādyaṃ tu vāmenācamanaṃ tathāpuruṣeṇa tathā dhūpaṃ dīpānte naiva pūjayetvastrābharaṇāñjanāni kavacenātradāpayetmṛnmaye lohaje vātha śailajaiścaiva pūjayetaṣṭādaśagaṇānāṃ tu svanāmādyakṣarairyajetstrīṇāṃ caiva narendrāṇāṃ śivabhakta svanāmataḥnityotsavaṃ prakurvīta śāstra dṛṣṭena karmaṇā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tasya madhye tribhāgaikaṃ karṇikāmācared budhaḥnamaḥ śaktiḥ samopetaṃ padmagandhādibhiryajetsāyaṃ prātaḥ prakurvīta puṣpaliṅgaṃ prapūjayetprasthaṃ vā dviguṇaṃ mūmagrekāṅgulanāhakamśikhākoṭipratīkāśaṃ śūladaṇḍadharaṃ sadāīśānādyaiḥ sugandhādyairarcanaṃ kramaśaḥ punaḥgandhapuṣpairalaṅkṛtya soṣṇīṣaṃ sottasāyakampradakṣiṇatrayaṃ kṛtvā tatra gehaṃ samāviśetdakṣiṇe cāstrarājānamuttare candraśekharamlokapālān samabhyarcya pādukāvṛtameva higandhapuṣpādinā pūjya paścādgarbhagṛhaṃ viśetbalivādyadhvanī kṛtvā piśācārākṣasāsurāḥevaṃ nityotsavaṃ kuryādiṣṭasaṃpatkaraṃ nṛṇāmghaḍike dve bhave snānaṃ ghaṭikaikārcanaṃ bhavetghaṭikā ghaṭikārdhaṃ yat nityotsavamudāhṛtamsvaguruṃ pūjayet pūrvaṃ gaṇeśe saṃprapūjayetpādaprakṣālanaṃ kṛtvā ācamya vidhinā budhaḥevaṃ yaḥ kurute mardhaḥ ātmārtheva parārthakerudralokāt paribhraṣṭā nararūpeṇa bhūgatāekalakṣaṃ bhavaṃ bhaktyā yo dadyāt parameśvaregrahaṇe viṣusaṃkrāntau yaḥ śivaṃ pūjayet sakṛtpūrṇamāsyāmamavāsyāmarcayet pūjayecchivamna kiṃca natvamaṣakā manovākkāyakarmabhiḥtasmāt sarvaprayatnena śivaṃ bhaktyā prapūjayetghṛtakambalamityuktaṃ viṣṇuprītikaraṃ bhavet

sanskrit: samayārambhapūrve tu cakracinnāni pūjayetpañcādhikāra nāmaya cakracinnāni dāpayetvācakaścārcakassandhyā viṣvagaṃ cāpyalaṅkṛtabhasmadāyi dhūpadāyi dīpadarpaṇadhārakaḥtaritantuṇḍadhāri ca tālavṛndaṃ ca bhājininityadīpajale kṣālī dhāmni śodhananāyakaḥamuśojalathikṣāli gandhalepe padaṃśakamśodhaki lepaki pātrakṣālaki hastadīpakāvinodi naṭini vīṇāpādini rāgini tathākarmaṇāścaritaṃ proktaṃ samayi kṛtya racatesamintraṇa kuśoddhāri stotra drāviḍagāyinijñānavairāgya santoṣi samayādhipa kṛtyakeśiṣrūṣakajananveṣi svadeśikṛtya nāyakākathavākya praśaṃśi ca svadeśādhipa kṛtyakemṛṣṭagrāsi ca siśrūsi stotra drāviḍagānavitproktaṃ dvādaśabhedena śivājñā cakra pūrvikāvibhajet kāmya nirmālyaṃ maṣṭāṃ myāṃśa yathā samamrasāṃśaṃ vādyakasyaiva lekhyakasya yugāśakamdvibhāgaṃ kāṣṭhabhāgasya vedāṃśaṃ prekṣyakasya capātraśodhi dviphāgaṃ ca sthānācāryaika bhāgakamsamayi bhāgamekāṃśaṃ samayādhipatestathāśeṣamātithyabhāgārthaṃ kalpayedabdhi pācakievaṃ bhāgakramaṃ proktaṃ śṛṇu nirmālya kalpanamiti sūkṣmaśāstre pūjācakravidhirnnāma ṣaṭcatvāriṃśatpaṭalaḥutsavaṃ pañcadhā jñeyaṃ tadbhedamiha kathyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pañcāhaṃ sātvikaṃ proktaṃ triyāhaṃ gauṇamucyateādramāsādi māsāntamutsavaṃ vidhinocyateavabhṛdānte vrataṃ kuryādavarohaṇamantakemāghe cāśleṣakartavyāṃ darśadvayaṃ ca saṃmatamcaitramāse tu kartavyaṃ citrāntaṃ ca dvitīyakamjyeṣṭhā caiva prakartavyaṃ caturdaśamūlasaṃyutamśrāvaṇe śrāvaṇe vāpi dvādaśi cā viśeṣataḥaśvetvaśvasamāṃ yuktaṃ kārttike kṛttikaṃ matamathavānya prakāreṇa tattadberādinaṃ matamyajamānavaśāt tatra tridinaṃ tīrthamācaretnavāhe caiva saptāhe dhvajārohaṇamācarettricaturhastamārabhya dviguṇāntaṃ krameṇa tupucchidvayasamāyuktaṃ vetradvayasamanvitampucchadvayaṃśakaproktaṃ maṃśantu padmapīṭhakampīṭhapārśve tu kartavyamaṣṭamaṅgalamaṃ likhetchatrapārśve tu kartavyaṃ cāmaradvayameva capañcavarṇasamāyuktaṃ muktasthāne prakalpayetstitaṃ vā śayanaṃ vāpi yānaṃ vāpi samālikhetsuṣiraṃ yantrasaṃyuktaṃ yatra rajju subandhayetyathāśmalo vṛkṣe vā dhvatsārakramukādayāsaptaviṃśati hastāntaṃ navadhā hastamānakamevamādhamamākhyātaṃ manyat sarvaṃ puroktavatardhayāmavasāne tu vighneśaṃ pūjayed budhaḥpaścime tu paṭaṃ nyasya tatpūrve navakaṃ nyasetnetronmīlanaṃ kuryāntu netramantreṇa deśikaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prāṇapratiṣṭhā kartavyaṃ rakṣābandhaṃ puroktavatśaktyādi śaktiparyantaṃ ddhyāyet tu gurūttamampaścimāsyo vṛṣaṃ pūjya varuṇādyaṣṭadikṣu caevaṃ kumbhānsamabhyarcya naivedyadhūpadīpakamagnikāryoktamārgeṇa agnikāryaṃ samācaretdhvajastānaṃ purā proktaṃ tasdhānaṃ lepayet tataḥgrāmapradakṣiṇe vāpi vāhanaṃ tatra vinyasettatkumbhamuttare sthāpya tato vighneśamarcayetvṛṣagāyatrimantreṇa dhvajamāropayedguruḥsiṃhasya mūlamantreṇa ativāsaṃ tiropayetvaktrāvaktrasamākāyamūrdhapucchaṃ ca vakrakampaścimādi mahāśāsu kalpayet tu vicakṣaṇaḥitarāṇyapi sarvāṇi kārayed vṛṣabhoktavatśunirmālya dhāriṇi devimalaṅkṛtyā viśeṣataḥvidhiśodhanamevoktaṃ bheritāṭanamucyateahūyāṣṭagaṇāṃ caiva deśikaḥ śiṣya eva cabheriṃ saṃpūjya vidhivadekadvitri ca tāḍayetāvāhanabaliṃ dadyācchuddhānnaṃ vā gulānnakamdhvajo dhvajādi balyantaṃ dinaṃ devakaliṃ vināvighnarājaṃ ca gauriṃ ca rakṣāsūtraṃ ca bandhayetvedimadhye viśeṣeṇa sthaṇḍilādiralaṅkṛtamvāmādi śaktayaścāṣṭau pūrvādi sthāpayed guruḥuttamādiṣu vastrāḍhyaṃ śeṣaṃ pūrvavaducyatenavāgni vātha pañcāgniṃ mekāgnimathavā caretevaṃ saṃkalpya vidhivat svasvamantreśca pūjayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nityāgni homakāryaṃ tu nityaṃ vā homamācaretdina devādi tatsarvaṃ śivavat kārayet kramātvīthi sammārjanaṃ pūrvaṃ prokṣaṇaṃ ca dvitīyakamutsaveśimalaṅkṛtya vādyaghoṣasamanvitamsarvatra jvaladīpāśca nānājāti samākulamtat tadantaramānaṃ tu ekāṅgulavaśāt smṛtametat sarvaṃ samāpādya pratiṣṭhāvidhimācaretbhadrapīṭhapratiṣṭhā ca samatantreṇa kārayetekācāryeṇa kartavyaṃ nekasminnekakālakeprāsādapūrvadigbhage maṇḍapaṃ vidhinā caretrudravediti saṃproktā tattārāgrekatuṅgakamanena vāsakaṃ kuryāt tadvidhāna prakārakanavāhe vātha pañcāhe triyāhe'ṅkuramācarettarjanyaṃ tu tridhā proktaṃ sphaṭikaṃ chinnabhinnakamupāna jagaticchādakumudaṃ karṇapaṭṭikamdalopadalanāsyādi upāṅgamiti kīrtitamkṣudrapīṭhādi sarveṣu vibhinetāśca varjayetsaṅkalpyāsanamāvāhya pūjāmantraṃ samācarettanmadhye padmamālikhya sāṣṭapatra sakarṇikamāvāhya pīṭhad devāṃśca kumbhamadhye tu vinyasetādhānādi vivāhāntaṃ kṛtvā madhughṛtairapiśatamardhaṃ tadardhaṃ vā homayet tu pṛthak pṛthakjayādirabhyādhānāñca kramādrāṣṭrāhutiṃ hunetbhūtale nikhinetāṃśca samudreṣvadhavā nayetpīṭhaśuddhiṃ tataḥ kṛtvā pañcamṛdgavyabilvakaiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dhārābhiṣecanaṃ kuryācchuddhairuddheti mantrataḥrakṣābandhaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā bhadrapīṭhodhvakarṇikevedyāsu sthaṇḍilaṃ kuryādaṣṭadroṇena śālinālājaiḥ puṣpaistilaiḥ ṣṭarbhai vikirṇai samalaṅkṛtamnandinaṃ ca mahākālaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ pūjayet kramātdurgāmātraṃśca vighneśaṃ varaskandau ca mādhavampradici vedikumbheṣu siṃhaṃ ca bhujageśvaramudici vedikumbheṣu indrāvaiśvānaraṃ yamamviṣṇupītāmahañcāpi pūrvādārabhya pūjayetsumukhaṃ durmukhṃ cātha avighnaṃ vighnanāyakamāsano mūlattimūlādyai saṃyutaṃ tānsamarcayetbhadrapīṭho viśeṣo'stitasthāne cādhivāsayetagnyādānādikaṃ sarvam agnikāryoktamācarettaṃ tanmūla ṣaḍaṅgaiśca pāvamānaistriyambakaiḥevaṃ jāgaraṇaṃ rātrau prabhāte snānamācaretkṣudrapīṭhapratiṣṭhāyā sthānaṃ vakṣyāmi tacchṛṇudurgādi caṇḍapīṭhāntam anyadiśāntamarcayettatpṛṣṭhe bhūtanāthasya pīṭhadaṇḍapramāṇataḥantarmaṇḍalamāsyaddhameśasya vṛṣāgrataḥtasthānasīmā saṃbandhamarntarmaṇḍalamānataḥnair-ṛte daṇḍamānena viṣṇupīṭhaṃ pratiṣṭhayetdvitīryavaraṇe pīṭhe stvevameva prakalpayetācāryaṃ pūjayet paścād vastrahemāṅguliyakaiḥparyaṣṭinottariyādyairuṣṇiṣaimaṇḍitena caśirasā vāhayitvā tu kṛtvā dhāmapradakṣiṇam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhadrapīṭhe viśeṣo'sti mantranyāsasamuddharetgauri caiva manonmanyā bhavāni trividhaṃ bhavethastāvalambā parameśvariṃ syātlambamekakara dakṣiṇetpalaṃ yā bhamanusāravaktrakamsumukhamambikāyāmkaraṇḍamakuṭopetā sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutāraktakamalāsanamanonmanisvarūpamtuṅgakuṭojvalamanonmani svarūpamsakala * * pi kṛtaṃ syāt śyāmavarṇañca gaurimśrikāmakoṭiṃ śivaśakti rūpām* * * * ni pararūpadhararūpamprakārābhyantare vāpi aiśānye vā viśiṣyateathavānyaprakāreṇa dakṣanai-ṛtapāvakesvatantrāla saṃkalpya nacittestu pratiṣṭhayetdakṣiṇābhimukhaṃ kṛtvā sarvasaṃpatkaraṃ tathāuttarābhimukhaṃ devi saukhyakaṃ ca tataḥ paramyadvaktraṃ dvāraṃ saṃkalpya prākārādini kalpayetyoge liṅga samāyuktaṃ bhogaṃ vāme samanvitamuttare tu yajed gaurīṃ vāyudeśe manonmanīgauri dakṣiṇadigbhāge pāvake tu manonmanīsthānaṃ saṃyuktadasthāne śaktināṃ jīrṇanaṣṭakebhaktāṃśca parivārāṃśca kartabhaktyānukūlakenyunādhikyaṃ na kartavyaṃ pūrvavat parikalpayetsvatantrālasaṃkalpya sthāpayet pūjayet tataḥdvibhujāṃ ca dvinetrāṃ ca pītavastrāṃ suyauvanām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: karaṇḍamakuṭopetāṃ bhūmadeviṃ salakṣaṇāmdvāradakṣiṇapārśve tu gaṅgāyamarcayet tataḥdvārasya vāmapārśve tu yamunāmarcayet tathāūrdhve pataṅgamadhye tu mahālakṣmī prapūjayetvāmapārśve sarasvatyāṃ pataṅgoparipūjayetvimalaṃ ca subāhuṃ ca pūjayet tu kavāṭayoḥdvārapūjā vidhiproktā gauryārcanaṃ viśeṣataḥnirmālyaṃ ca visṛjyātha caṇḍeśvara samarcayetśivaśaktisvarūpatvācchivaśaktiṃ prapūjayet* * * * pa saṃbandhaṃ tasacchelajalohajambhāvarūpaṃ tu saṃbandhaṃ lohajāni śilānvitamsāṅgopāṅgaṃ ca pratyaṅgaṃ pūjayet trividhaṃ smṛtamvastramābharaṇaṃ caiva sugandhālepanaṃ tathāupāṅgaṃ dhūpadīpaṃ syāt sāyaṃ rakṣā tu bhasmanānṛttageyasamāyuktaṃ upāṅgaṃ ceti kīrtitamnityotsava culukodaṃ ca pratyaṅgaṃ ceti kīrtitamraudriṇavan dakṣiṇe deśe kalinyā nai-ṛte tathābalapramathani saumye sarvabhūtadamaniśaketat tatsvanāmamantreṇa tat tatsthāneṣu pūjayetbrāhmī pūrve tu saṃpūjya maheśimagnigocarevārāhi paścime pūjya indrāṇi vāyugocarevīrabhadraṃ ca vighneśaṃ aiśānyāṃ nair-ṛte yajetvṛṣabhaṃ pūrvataḥ pūjya gaṇeśaṃ cāgnigocareśanaiśvaraṃ paścime tu vāyavyāṃ vīrameva catṛtiryavaraṇe proktaṃ caturthāvaraṇaṃ śṛṇu
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śāntimoha rākṣāṇye bhedini nai-ṛte tathādurgāyāṃ saumyadigbhāge caṇḍiśimiśa gocarebalipīṭhe tu pūrvāyāmākāśamātari tathādevamātari saumyeyāṃ matumātamūrdhyataḥvṛṣādibalipīṭhāntaṃ kuṅkuṭāṇḍa pramāṇataḥsarvabhūtavihīne tu balināṃ tatra traptayetatsmāt sarvaprayatnena balidānaṃ samācaretāyuśrīyaṅgalabdhāmāmaiśvaryārogyavardhanamiti sūkṣmaśāstre gaurinityārcanavidhiṃ nāma aṣṭacatvāriṃśatpaṭalaḥdvitiyaṃ prokṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ bhadrayogaṃ tathaiva cabālasthānaṃ tathā kṛtvā prokṣaṇaṃ bhadramucyateśvānādi kukuṭe caiva vānaraiḥ praviśedyadiprāsadasyāgrataḥ kuryā ṇḍapaṃ caturaśrakamvitānaidarbhamālābhimuktādāmaralaṅkṛtamkṛtvā navapadaṃ madhye padamekaṃ tu vedikākuryāt kuṇḍāni paritaḥ diśāsu vidiśāsu caindra iśānayormadhye pradhānaṃ tatra kalpayetcandanāgarukarpūrā kuṣṭhe cakrakesaraiḥpañcagavyena saṃprokṣya pāvamānamudirayanhaima kautukasūtraṃ tu bandhayecchirasā śivamyātrāhomaṃ prakartavyaṃ bālasthānasya cāgrataḥagnyādānādikaṃ kṛtvā śivāgniṃ kalpayet tataḥspṛṣṭvā spṛṣṭvā tu juhuyāt sārdhasārdhamathāpi vātasyāgre śivakumbhantu saṃsthāpya sthaṇḍiloparidhyātvā sadāśivaṃ tasmin sadyenāvāhayet tataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gaṇāmbikye tu mantreṇa snāpayet pūjayet tataḥtasyottare nyasen mantrivardhanī sahiraṇyakāmniśāsvadhyāyanaṃ kṛtvā dvidhivadvaidapālagaiḥsamidhājyacarūrlājānsarṣapāśca yavāṃ tilānpālāśodumbaraśca dhvaplakṣaśceva diśāsu vāsahasraṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā tadardhārdhamathāpi vāghṛtamīśānamantreṇa puruṣeṇa carustathātilānpāśupatāstreṇa kavacena yavāṃstathāpratidravyaṃ svamantreṇa sūcā pūrṇāhutirbhavetsadyādi pañcagavyena pañcagavyābhiṣecanaṃhaimapuṣpaṃ ca saṃyuktaṃ puṣpaṃ śirasi dhārayetkaṭakaṃ kuṇḍalaṃ caiva yajñasūtraṃ tu haimakamsumuhūrte tato dhyātvā devadevaṃ triyambakamliṅgaṃ ca mūrdhni saṃyukte kalāṃmścāgāni vinyasettadabhi snapayet liṅgaprāsādaṃ tu manusmaretśivakumbhajale devaṃ vardhanyāṃ piṇḍikāmapigandhādyairarcayed devaṃ pañcāvaraṇapūrvakamsaṃtoṣayet cchivaṃ sākṣād bhadramevaṃ prakīrtitamsantoṣayet cchivaṃ sākṣādbhadramevaṃ prakīrtitamiti sūkṣmaśāstre saṃprokṣaṇavidhiṃ nāma ekona pañcāśatpaṭalaḥprāyovināśamityuktaṃ cittaṃ sandhānamucyateādau tu niścayadravyaṃ hi na vā doṣakārakamakalpitaṃ tu yad dravyaṃ hīne doṣaṃ na vidyatesaurapūjāvihīne ca puṇyahaṃ gavyahīnakepādyamācamānārghyaṃ hi hīne snānavihīnake
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mukhavāsaṃ ca hīnakve na ca bhūtabalyutsave'pi cabhasmatāmbūlahīne ca darpaṇaścatrahīnakepurāṇaśravaṇe hīne pañcāṅgaśravaṇe'pi caevamādisamutpanne niṣkṛtiṃ ca vadāmyahammārjanaprokṣaṇaṃ kuryād gavyena prokṣya bhūtaletaddoṣaśamanārthāya vyomavyāpi śataṃ japetsayeva spṛśitadravyaṃ varjayet tatprayatnataḥmṛdbhāṇḍāni visṛjyātha snapanairabhiṣecayetśāntihomaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā snapanairabhiṣecayetnityapuṇyāhahīne ca tadrāṣṭrau naśyate śriyampañcagavya vihīne ca mahāmāri pravartatevighneśvarārcane hīne jīvāvāraṇa nāśanambhakṣyāpupādikaṃ datvā vighnamantraśataṃ japetśāntikumbhasthito yena deveśāmabhiṣecayetpādyadravyasadā caiva hīne rāṣṭrasya nāśanammūrtikumbhasthito yena snāpayet parameśvaramsnānadravyavihīne ca tadrāṣṭraṃ jalavarjitamsnāpayet parameśānaṃ vyomavyāpi samuccarantvakkāṣāyodakenaiva snapayet parameśvaramaṣṭottaraśataṃ japtvā anyasandhyāsu dāpayetśāntikumbhodake snāpya aghoreṇa śataṃ japetastrodakena saṃsnāpya tadravyaṃ dviguṇaṃ bhavetdiśākumbhodake snāpya sadyamantraśataṃ japettad doṣaśamanārthāya snāpayedvalkalodakaiḥpāniyamukhavāsaṃ ca hīne tu jalavarjitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dinaṃ prati viśeṣeṇa pūjāhīnaṃ tathaiva caphālgune dadhisaṃpūjya dhanaputravivardhanamviṣuvaṃ proktamevaṃ hi madhyāhne pūjayet tathāvaiśākhe triphalaṃ pūjya vighneśaṃ prītirucyatekṣīrābhiṣekamityuktaṃ vatsagovardhanaṃ bhavetāṣāḍhe bhasma sampūjya rudraprītikaraṃ bhavetproṣṭhe apūpaiḥ saṃpūjya skandaprītikaraṃ bhavetāśvini cānnasaṃpūjya brahmaṇaḥ prītirucyateoṣadhināṃ vipadyarthaṃ bījadānamihocyatekanyānāṃ vastradānaṃ syāt svarṇadānaṃ tu kanyakāmgauriyānaṃ bhavet tasmāt sarvaprāṇihitāvahambhūsure tu prasādaṃ hi mahājvālādharaṃ haramghṛtasnānaṃ bhavet tasmānmārga māse tu kathyateḍolārohaṇamevoktaṃ gaurīlīlāvidhikramampuṣyamāsādi pūjā yā māghamāsāntameva casaṃdhyādau kṛtanṛttaṃ syāt saṃdhyānṛttamathārabhetāgneyaṃ lohajaṃ proktaṃ vāyavyaṃ vaṃśajaṃ bhavetetāni pañcaśabdāni ghoṣayet prathamaṃ tataḥsāyarakṣavihīnaṃ ca bālānāṃ nāśanaṃ bhavetsāyaṃ kāle prayoktavyaṃ naṭeśaṃ pūjayet tataḥśvetapuṣpairalaṅkṛtya śvetacandanalepitametatkālaṃ samabhyarcya pūrvoktavidhinā sahadivyagandhānuliptāṅgaṃ divyamālāvibhūṣaṇampūjayet ciraśaktiṃ syāt arcanoktapadaṃ caretpūjayet śaktimantreṇa śibikāṃ rocayet tataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tadravyadviguṇaṃ dadyānmūlamantraśataṃ japetśāntihomaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā ṣoḍaśasnapanaṃ kuruprakārabalihīne ca tadrāṣṭraṃ balavarjitamdaśabījaśataṃ japtvā paścād balisamācaretśāntihomaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā snapanairabhiṣecayetnityotsavaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā punaḥ kiñcid vadāmyaham* * deśe tu saṃsthāpya pūrvavat śāntimācaretbalidīpavihīne ca yatra deśe tu saṃsthitambhasmatāmbūlahīne ca māhāmāri pravartateārātrikavihīne ca nṛttaghnaśchadane'pi caśāntikumbhodakaisnāpya bahurūpaśataṃ japetastramantraśataṃ japtvā parimārjanatoyakaiḥdarpaṇaśchatra hīne ca cāmaraṃ khaḍgahīnakeśāntihomaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā snapanairabhiṣecayetṛgādhyadhyāyanaṃ hīne bhaktādi stotrahīnakevedāgaśravaṇe hīne purāṇa śravaṇe tathāmānyodakena saṃsnāpya daśabījaśataṃ japetśāntihomaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā mūrttikumbhābhiṣecayetcaṇḍārcanavihīne ca rājāsenavināśanamcaṇḍamantraśataṃ japtvā paścāccaṇḍasamarcayetyatra devāya tṛpyarthaṃ kuryānniṣkṛti pūrvavatevaṃ yaḥ kurute martyaḥ sa puṇyāṃ gatimāpnuyātiti sūkṣmaśāstre nityavidhiprāyaścittaṃ nāma pañcāśatpaṭalaḥsarvapāpavināśārthaṃ sarvaśāntyarthamucyatetadarthamadhamaṃ jñeyaṃ trividhaṃ parikalpayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kṣīraṃ triprastamityuktaṃ catuprastaṃ tu gomayamkṣīraṃ kuḍupatrayaṃ caiva prastaṃ gomayamucyatekapilā goghṛtaṃ caiva sitāṅgodadhirucyatekṛṣṇavarṇaṃ tu gomūtraṃ saṅgrahe tu vicakṣaṇaḥkṣīraṃ tu śukradaivatyaṃ gomayaṃ cārkadevatamkāśyapakraghṛtamevaṃ tu kauśikaṃ dadhirucyateātrayaṃ caiva gomūtraṃ ṛṣiyāca prakīrtitaḥgomūtraṃ bahurūpaṃ tu puruṣeṇa tu gomayavyomavyāpimahāmantrerabhiṣekaṃ samācaretśālipiṣṭamuṣādevi rajanīṃ ca * * * *padaṃ vai pañcakoṣini catusūtraṃ tu vinayasetgāyatriyādayage mūtraṃ gandhadvāreti gomayamśukramajyotirityājyaṃ devasya tvā kuśodakammadhyānnakālabhiṣekāṃ tu sarvathātyarthamucyateprasādādi mukho bhūtvā maṇḍapasya tu madhyamegomayaṃ pūrvake sthāpya gomūtraṃ caiva dakṣiṇeāgneryamadhu saṃsthāpya nai-ṛtyāṃ nālikerakamtat tadṛkṣa caturthāṃśe kumudeśapradeśakemṛdaṃ saṃgrāhya yatnena kāmyarāṣṭreśamandirepradhāna gajavāse ca śrīṃgaspṛg vāsasaṃyutamgrāmadevālaye kṣetre taṭākaṃ jalanirgamepṛthak pātre samākṛṣya svadeśe devamandiretasminmāsārdhamāse vā pūrvavatkarkaṭodayamprātatkāle samutthāya snānaṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥtato devagṛhaṃ gatvā mahādevaṃ praṇamya ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: praṇavenaiva saṃkṣālya sadhūpya śivabījataḥdaśakumbheṣu saṃsthāpya mukhaṃ vastreṇa veṣṭayetsthaṇḍilaṃ kārayed vidvānnāḍhakadvayaśālināpidhāya śuddhavastreṇa dhārābījena cārcayetpūrvāsyāmuttarāsyaṃ vā rucirāsanasaṃsthitamdaśasahasrakaṃ japtvā japānte homamācaretanyathā nādikaṃ sarvaṃ pūrvoktavidhinā nayetkadalipanasopetaṃ sahasrāhutimācaretdinaṃ prati viśeṣeṇa evameva samācaretśivāgre maṇḍapaṃ kalpya ṣoḍaśastambhasaṃyutamdarbhamālāsamāyuktaṃ vitānādyairalaṅkṛtamvedivastreṇasaṃveṣṭya sthaṇḍilaṃ raktaśālināsnānaṃ kṛtvā vidhānena santarpyā tadanantaramsaṃkalparajitenaiva śivaliṅgaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥsaṃsthāpya ca mahādevaṃ droṇapuṣpai samarcayetdroṇapuṣpasamabhyarcya dhūpadīpaṃ pradāpayetśivabījena vādāya tanmṛdālepayed vibhumsṛṣṭimārgeṇa cābhyarcya sannivedyagulodanamdroṇaiśca jātikusumaiḥ rarcayitvā gurūttamaḥsādhakenaiva cābhyarcya śivahastaṃ prakalpayetsaṃstāpyā ca mahāmantraṃ macakrānteti mantravitsaṃkalpadivase prāpte pratiniyamamānasādīnāndhakṛpuṇādīnāṃ annapānaṃ pradāpayetdaivajñeya yathākāle yajamānāya bodhayetgurūpatiṣṭhamārgeṇa veṣayennavasaṃkhyayā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: trivāraṃ prāśayet tena tadrājyaṃ labhate dhruvamiti sūkṣmaśāstre mṛlliṅgārcanavidhiṃ nāma tripañcāśatpaṭalaḥardhayāmasya pūjānte pūjayet pādukāvubhautasyordhve śivamāvāhya gandhapuṣpaisṛgādibhiḥsarvālaṅkārasaṃyuktaṃ sarvavādyasamanvitampādaprakṣālanaṃ kṛtvā pādyācamanaṃ dadetdevirabhyarcyavidhivad astreṇāvāhya deśikaḥpādyamācamanaṃ datvā bhakṣyā prapādikaṃ dadetdaśāstraṃ paritobhyarcya pādukau vinyaset sthaleśaṇḍeśvaraṃ samabhyarcya svagṛhaṃ praviśedguruḥiti sūkṣmaśāstre pādukārādhanaṃ nāma catuḥpañcāśatpaṭalaḥvivṛtaṃ saṃvṛtaṃ caiva dvividhaṃ tat prakīrtitammāsakṣe janmanakṣetre ṣaḍāśitimukhe'pi caṣaṣṭāṣṭadvādaśe māsi śūlanakṣatrake'pi capūjayennṛparakṣārthaṃmanena vidhinā budhaḥśivarāmādhyavidhivaddarcayet kṛṣṇacagāmsa devi śikhā bilvi pañcāṅgena samanvitamśoṣaṇaṃ bahurūpeṇa puruṣeṇaiva pācanammṛtpātre tāmrapātre vā nikṣiped dhṛdayena tugrāmapradakṣiṇaṃ kuryāt sarvālaṅkārasaṃyutampūjayed gandhapuṣpādyai mūlenaivā vicakṣaṇaḥvisṛtaṃ nandadhā bhajya madhye vyomapadaṃ gṛhetmuṣṭimātrasamutsedhaṃ darpaṇodarasannibhamupavediprakartavyaṃ taccaturbhāgabhāgayākuṇḍāni kalpayet tatra pūrvokta vidhinā budhaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: puṇyāhaṃ vācayet ddhīmān pañcagavyasamanvitamśālibhiśca vasudroṇaiḥ sthalikaṃ kārayedbudhaḥlājaiḥ puṣpai paristirya pañcavarṇena pūrayettanmadhye'bja prakartavyaṃ dalāṣṭakasamanvitamtantunā veṣaye sarvāgavaṃkṣa sadṛśānnaramtoraṇakalaśānastrān dikpatīśca yathākramamtataḥ saṃpūjya gandhādyaiḥ rvedikordhve śivāsanamdvādaśāṅgulamānena maṇḍalaṃ svastikānvitamyugaliṅgasamāyuktaṃ svastikasaṃprakalapayetstaṇḍilaṃ tatra kartavyaṃ vimalaiḥ śālitaṇḍulaiḥsthalikāyānyaset tatra śālipiṣṭaiḥ vicakṣaṇaḥsarvāvayavasaṃpūrṇaṃ kalpayet kalpavittamaḥkharaśrīṅgāsya karṇau ca vṛṣaṇaṃ dvātiriktakambhruvau tanmāna rekhāṇāṃ kṛṣṇavarṇemiti smṛtamsarvapuṣpairalaṅkṛtya dhūpadīpasamanvitamācāryādāya vṛṣabhaṃ śaṅkhadhvanisamanvitamdūrvāgramaṣṭasāhasrādhavalākṣatasaṃyutamhaviṃ nivedayitvātha mudgabhinnasamanvitamtato devālayaṃ datvā gītavādyasamanvitamnavakadakṣiṇe bhadre sthāpayet pūrvavanmanavinyased gandhapuṣpādyaiḥ hṛdayena vicakṣaṇaḥdhūpadīpaiḥ samabhyarcya śuddhānnaṃ ca nivedayetāyanādi vivāhāntaṃ pūrvoktavidhinā kuruḍāḍimipuṣpasaṃkāśaṃ daśadobhissamanvitamvajrādiśūlaṭaṅkaṃ ca abhayaṃ dakṣiṇe dhṛtam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: manonmanyāsamāyuktaṃ pañcāvaraṇasaṃyutamindhanādājyasamidhaṃ sūpaṃ dadhi yavaṃ madhusitāmrapañcadūrvāgraṃ homadravyaṃ daśāṣṭadhampratyekaṃ śatamardhaṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā hutaṃ caretgandhapuṣpaisamabhyarcya dhūpadīpaṃ daded guruvitānavannimabhyarcya sarvadravyai hutaṃ caretgandhapuṣpaiḥ samabhyarcya visṛjaidagnidaivatamvedadhvanisamāyuktaṃ stotradhvani samanvitamśivāgre maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā sarvālaṅkārasaṃyutamnavakaṃ dakṣiṇe sthāpya nīrājanamathottaregaṇeśaṃ pūjayet pāścād dvāradevān samarcayetarcayedīpadānāntaṃ tanmatreṇa vicakṣaṇaḥmantrapuṣpaṃ tato datvā mantrānnaṃ ca nivedayetkumbhānbhasmasamādāya liṅgamūrdhani dāpayetpañcavarṇahavirdatvā pāniyācamanaṃ dadetdhūpadīpaiḥ samabhyarcya vṛṣamūlena deśikaḥtataḥ sāyānnasamaye dhūpadīpāvasānakenivṛtyādi kalāmantrerarcayed gandhapuṣpakaiḥsagulmalughṛtairyuktaṃ dhūpāmodasamanvitambhūmayo mūlamantreṇa avatiyya śanaiśanaiḥpūrvavadbhramaṇaṃ kṛtvā praṇavena visarjayetpradakṣiṇaṃ tataḥ kuryā vādyadhvanisamanvitamnirājanaṃ parityajya bahurūpamanusmaranpādaprakṣālanaṃ kṛtvā praveśedālayaṃ gurupuṣpāñjalitrayaṃ datvā abhiṣṭhaṃ prāthayed guru
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhasmaṃ visṛjya tāreṇārdha pātre vinikṣipettatassāḍhyaṃ samādāya kalpayeducirāsanammūlena sandhyamālokya cūḍādicaraṇāntakamniṣkamātrasamādāya sādhyasya śirasoparicūḍādipādaparyantaṃ pādāccūḍāvasānakamṣaḍaṅgānācaredbhaktyamṛtyuñjayamanusmañjapetsaṃsādhya hṛdayaṃ spṛṣṭvā mūlamantraṃ śataṃ japetevaṃ yaḥ kurute martya sa puṇyāṅgatimāpnuyātiti sūkṣmaśāstre rājarakṣavidhiṃ nāma pañcapañcāśat paṭalaḥyatsarvaṃ tattvayā pṛṣṭa tatsarvaṃ vada me prabhośāntikaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ caiva kāmadaṃ ca tridhā matamsthalikā kṛtisaṃyuktaṃ viṃśadāṅgulisaṃyutamdaśāṅgulasamutsedhaṃ vistṛtaṃ ca daśāṅgulampādaṃ caiva śarāṅgulyaṃ mutsedhaṃ tatsamaṃ bhavettripādyuparivinyasya rakṣādīpaṃ tu kārayetviṃśatyaṅgulavistāraṃ sthalikāmānamucyateevatpauṣṭikamākhyātaṃ kāmyadaṃ ca tataḥ śṛṇupañcasaptanavaikaṃ vā dīpārādhānaṃ prayatnataḥnavadīpaṃ viśeṣeṇa sthaṇḍilaṃ prasthapādakamaṣṭadikṣu kramātsarvaṃ sarvadikṣukṛtaṃ havitadūrdhve vartitaṃ prāpya goghṛtenaiva secayetdinaṃ prati viśeṣeṇa rājñāṃ vijayabhetalesāyāhne śayanaṃ kuryādyakṣeśiṃ samyagarcayettasya paścimadigbhāge sthaṇḍilaṃ caturaśrakamtailaṃ vā goghṛtaṃ vāpi vantitaṃ caiva secayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: athavā vahnibījaṃ vā madhyadīpaṃ praropayetvyomavyāpi samuccāryā sarvadīpaṃ prapūjayetvādi trilayasaṃyuktaṃ gaṇikā nṛttamācaretgacchet pradakṣiṇaṃ tasya tattavedapasya sannidhaudhūpadīpavasāne tu rakṣāmantraṃ samuccarantrinvantaraṃ ca vārānvā bhrāmayet tu śanaiḥ śanaiḥevaṃ śāntikamityuktaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ ca tataḥ śṛṇuvinyaset sthalikordhve tu rakṣādeviṃ ca mantrataḥgarbhagehaṃ tataḥ prāpya astramantreṇa pūjayetekadvitrikramādbhrāmya berādīnbhramaṇaṃ tataḥśivasya rakṣāṃ kṛtvā tu sarvaprāṇi hitāvahamkuṇḍe vā sthaṇḍile vāpi garbhagehe'thavā punaḥpauṣṭikasya krameṇaiva pūjayed devamuttamamevaṃ kāmadamityuktaṃ kathayaṃ deva tvayā śṛṇuśarāṅgulaṃ tu madhyaṃ syācchūlāṅgulaṃ tu kanyasāmtailaṃ kanyasamevoktaṃ gālitenaiva kārayetpādyādi darśanādūrdhvaṃ śive dadyāt krameṇa tuyāntenaiva samāyuktaṃ rakṣarasvarasaṃyutamparātparamidaṃ mantraṃ tava stotraprakāśitamkaraṇḍamakuṭopetaṃ saumyarūpasmitānanamevaṃ dhyātvā yajed deviṃ rakṣādevīṃ ca matravitsomāṅgārādi saṃpūjya dvitiyyavaraṇe nyasetevameva krameṇaiva rakṣeśiṃ pūjayed budhaḥpradoṣe śayanaṃ kalpya evaṃ niścitya buddhimānevaṃ krameṇa saṃyojya rakṣādīpaṃ samācaret
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: iti sūkṣmaśāstre rakṣādīpavidhiṃ nāma ṣaṭpañcāśat paṭalaḥkāryaṃ kartṛnā śakyaṃ syāt sarvādhakaraṇairvinakuṇḍānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ caiva tataḥ sṛksṛvayostathāparistaraṇadarbhānāṃ samidhānāṃ ca lakṣaṇaṃpādyamācamanīyaṃ ca arghyaṃ cāpi viśeṣataḥvitānalakṣaṇaṃ caiva pracchinnapaṭalakṣaṇaḥdvividhaṃ tu vidhānaṃ syād bāhyamābhyantaraṃ tathādhvajadaṇḍapramāṇaṃ ca balidānasya lakṣaṇaṃpūrvāgraṃ muttarāgraṃ ca kuryāt sūtratrayaṃ punaḥkarṇasūtraṃ caturbhāgaṃ kṛtvaikena tu vartayetkarṇasūtrasya saptāṃśaṃ pūrvayā diśi vinyasetcatvāriśrikṛte kṣetre madhyāt karṇa vigṛhya cabhāgenaikena saṃyuktaṃ kṣetrārdhena tu yojayetcaturaśraṃ tu karṇena kṛtvā tatraiva pūrvavatkṣetrasyārdhārdhamānena sahaikāśitibhāgikamkṣetraṃ tu saptadhā kṛtvā bhāgamekaṃ bahirnnyasetkarṇārdhāṣṭāṃśasaṃyuktaṃ karṇārdhaṃ yad bhavedihaprāgādi pañcasūtreṇa pañcāśraṃ kārayed budhaḥsūtreṇa madhyamāt tasmādvṛttaṃ kṛtvā tato budhaḥevaṃ sūtraṃ tataḥ kṛtvā saptāśre tu bhujā bhavetpadmapadmasamaṃ vṛtte karṇikādalasaṃyutamvaikaṅkatamayo vātha khādiro vā sruk sruvaḥpālāśa khadirāśvattha plakṣādumbaracandanaiḥdvidhā kṛtvā tato bhāgaiḥ sūtreṇa sumitannayāaratnimātramāyāmaṃ tatpaśve tu baliṃ bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tadardhaṃ kaṇṭhanāhaṃ syāt puṣpakaraṃ mūlavadbhavetpuṭadvayasamāyuktaṃ karṣaśejyanapūritamṣaṭtriṃśadaṅgulāyāme maṣṭāṅgulasuvistṛtaḥsaptāṅgulabhavedāsyaṃ vistārāya mayopi higribhāgaikaṃ bhavedagraṃ kṛtvā śeṣaṃ parityajetvedikāṣṭāṅgulāyāmā vistāraṃ tatpramāṇataḥbilaṃ suvṛttitaṃ kuryād aṣṭapatraṃ sakarṇikamtadbāhye yavanimnaṃ tu padmapatraṃ vicitritamvedikā madhyato randhraṃ kaniṣṭāṅgulamānataḥdaṇḍaṃ ṣaḍaṅgulaṃ nāhaṃ daṇḍāgre daṇḍikātrayamtrayodaśāṅgulāyāmaṃ daṇḍamūle ghaṭo bhavetvedimadhye tayā kumbhe pātralakṣaṇamucyatenitye naimityake kāmye snānānte tu maheśvaramuttamottamadhāreṣā parātparamaśakti sātataḥ pātra samādāya tallakṣaṇamihocyatesaptaviṃśāṅgulaṃ yāvat pāstravistāramucyatevistāraparito mṛtyāḥ pādāṅgulaghanaṃ bhavetāyāśṛṅkhalayāyuktaṃ vātarajjusamanvitamuttamādi krameṇaiva kārayet tat tatprabhañjanabhūpatināṃ viśeṣeṇa svarṇaṃ vā rajataṃ matamtatpātraṃ caturaśraṃ vā suvṛttaṃ vā prakalpayetvṛttaṃ cetu viśeṣeṇa sarvakāmārtha sādhanampātramadhye viśeṣeṇa padmaṃ sāṣṭākasaṃkarṇikampadmāvṛtasamāyuktaṃ ratnaṃ kāñcitamācarettadbāhye suṣiraṃ kalpyā sūcimātrapramāṇataḥ

sanskrit: nṛttaṃ ca ratnasaṃkhyā tu navatālaṃ samācaretindrādīśānarāgaṃ syadratnāka nṛttameva cadhūpadīpaṃ hṛdā datvā ācamanaṃ daded budhaḥnālikerādi kṣīraṃ ca kadalīpanasaṃ kramātkṛsarānnanivedyaṃ syādetaiḥ pañcānnameva cakarpūramukhavāsaṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ ca nivedayetdvāraśuddhiṃ tataḥ kṛtvā mahāliṅgaṃ prapūjayetdūrvākṣata pavitreṇa darpaṇacchatracāmaraiḥbhasmāni dāpayet śaṃbho nṛpabhaktajanāya capaścime somadigbhāge śayyāsthānaṃ prakalpayetpādukā pratimā vāpi śayanopari vinyasettriṇetraṃ ekavaktraṃ ca mṛgiparaśudhāraṇamvyāghracarmāmbaradharaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitamgaurīṃ saṃpūjya vidhivat tāmbūlaṃ tu nivedayetguruvadbhaktimevoktaṃ sarpavadbhītirucyateevaṃ nitya krameṇaiva svaguruṃ pūjayet tataḥvijayaṃ lalitaṃ sūkṣmaṃ śivotsavavidhi śṛṇusūcanaṃ sarvalokānāṃ śivavaktrādvinirgatammārgaśīrṣamāsādi ṣāṇmāsaṃ saptarātrikamsarvabhūtahitaṃ śāntaṃ sarvadoṣanivāraṇamayanādyastu saṅkrāntyo vyatipāteṣu janmanirājābhiṣeke ṛkṣānte utsavaṃ kārayed budhaḥudgatastu savo yasmāt tasmādutsavamucyatepuṣyamāse tu puṣyāntaṃ māghamāse maghāntakamphalgune cottarāntaṃ tu bhavādbhogārthamucyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: trayodaśāpraṇārthāya bhrāmayo manusūtrakamdakṣiṇe puṣyarāgaṃ ca nirutau candranilakamsaumye mastakaṃ caiva aiśānye nilameva catrayodaśāvaraṇāni randhrasaṅkhyāṃ tataḥ śṛṇudvitīye ca kalārandhre kalānamadhidevatācaturthe dvātriṃśarandhrānmahāgaṅgādhidaivatamyamunāmādhidaivatyaṃ sarvarandhra pūjayetgodāvari sadaivatyaṃ sarvarandhreṣu yogyatāḥsaptamāvaraṇe caiva randhraṃ ṣaṣṭitamaṃ bhavetaṣṭamāvaraṇe caiva yugmādhikamaśitikamnavamāvaraṇe caiva randhraṃ ṣaṇṇavati smṛtamdaśamāvaraṇe caiva śatarandhrasamanvitampaścādāvaraṇaṃ cettu yugādhikaśataṃ bhavetsarvarandhrāṇi kartavyaṃ vinyaset tu vicakṣaṇaḥicchāśaktyādhi daivatyaṃ sarvarandhraṃ viśeṣataḥjñānaśaktyādhidaivatyaṃ sarvarandhrasamanvitamcaturaśrasya madhye tu saptasaptapadaṃ bhavetvaijranilaṃ caiva vaiḍūryaṃ maratakaṃ puṣyarāgakamsuṣiraṃ pañcaviṃśacca padamekaṃ prakalpayetsahasradhārayā yuktā parāśaktyādhi daivatamathavānya prakāreṇa śṛṇudhvaṃ tatprabhañjanadvādaśāṅgulamevaṃ tu uttamaṃ parikīrttitamtriyaṅgulasuvistāraṃ madhamaṃ parikīrttitamekāṅgulasamutsedham uttamaṃ parikīrtitampādāṅgulasamutsedhaṃ madhyamaṃ tvadhi vidyate

sanskrit: yavamātraghanaṃ proktaṃ krameṇaiva subuddhīmānsvarṇarajatatāmre vā caturaśraṃ vā vṛttakamāvṛttaṃ cāṣṭasuṣiraṃ padamekaṃ prayatnataḥsūcimātrapramāṇena śrutirandhraṃ prakalpayetaṣṭottaraśataṃ proktaṃ pañcāśaścaika hīnakeavṛtaṃ cāṣṭasuṣiraṃ tadbāhye tu viśeṣataḥpañcāśarandhramevoktaṃ pañcaviṃśati cocyateanyāni padamadhye tu īśadṛksuṣiraṃ kurupūrvavatpātramevaṃ tu saṣṭapatrasakarṇakamtadbāhye dalamadhye tu * * * * * raṃ kuruevaṃ suṣiramākhyātaṃ aṣṭottaraśataṃ kramātkṣudrama * midaṃ proktaṃ mātmārthaṃ ce parārthakammodahadajñānato vāpi bhadrapātrobhiṣecayettatpātraṃ śaṅkhatoyena pūjayenmūlamantrataḥevameva krameṇaiva sahasrārdhābhiṣecanamiti sūkṣmaśāstre sahasradhāravidhiṃ nāma aṣṭapañcāśat paṭalaḥsvarṇaṃ rajita tāmreṇa śilayeṣṭakayeekahastasamārabhya vasvaṅgulavivardhanātāyādiśobhanopetaṃ śubhamānaṃ parigrahetvedāṃśamukhamānasyāt rudrāṃśaṃ mukhavistṛtamnāsāpuṭāntaraṃ pādaṃ nāsitāraṃ śivāṃśakamtanmadhye yavamānena kṛṣṇamaṇḍalamācaretpakṣadīrghaṃ dvibhāgaṃ syāt tadvistāraśivāṃśakamvedāṃśaṃ karṇavistāraṃ yuktyā siṃhasya karṇavitdantādi tvaṅgulārdhaṃ syāddharidanta vadācaret

sanskrit: madhye phaṇārdhamānena tasya pārśvaphaṇaṃ bhavetnāhaṃ vai ṣoḍaśāṅgulyaṃ bālāntadvaṅgulaṃ bhavetnāsimadhyamasūtraṃ tu bālāgraṃ rujusūtrakamśobhābalasamopetaṃ yuktyā sarvāṅgamācaretnāgalakṣaṇamevoktaṃ śṛṇu maṇṭapamānakamiti sūkṣmaśāstre nāgalakṣaṇavidhiṃ nāma ekonaṣaṣṭhi paṭalaḥbhadraṃ kṣudraṃ dvidhā proktaṃ kṣudramevālpapīṭhakametayoḥ kṣudrapīṭhānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ vakṣyate'dhunāsaptāṃśamuttamaṃ proktaṃ pañcāṃśamadhyamaṃ smṛtamtadvistāracaturbhāge ekaikaṃ pīṭhatuṅgakamārttosedhāṃśamānena pañcabhāge kṛte * *ekena karṇikāṃ kuryāt dadhāvānyavidhānataḥmātrapīṭha prā * * ntu ayuktaṃ vā sayuktakamcatuṣaḍaṅgulaṃ vāpi saptapīṭhaviśālakamtattadantaramānaṃ tu ekāṅgalavaśāsmṛtametatsarvaṃ samāpādya pratiṣṭhāvidhimācaretbhadrapīṭhapratiṣṭhā ca samatantre ca kārayetekācāryeṇa kartavyamekasminnekakālakeprāsādapūrvadigbhāge maṇḍapaṃ vidhinācaretrudravediti sā proktā tattāratraikatuṅgakamanena vā samaṃ kuryāt tadvidhānaprakārataḥnavāhe vātha pañcāhe triyāhe'ṅkuramācarettajjirṇaṃ tu tridhā proktaṃ spuṭataścinnabhinnakamupānajagati cātha kumudaṃ kaṇṭhapaṭṭikādalopadalanāsyādi upāṅgamiti kīrtitam

sanskrit: kṣudrapīṭhādi sarveṣu vihīne tāścavarjayetsaṃkalpyāsanamāvāhya pūjāmantraṃ samācarettanmadhye padmamālikhya sāṣṭapatrasakarṇikamāvāhya pīṭhād devāśca kumbhamadhye tu vinyasetādhānādivivāhāntaṃ kṛtvā madhughṛterapiśatamardhaṃ tadardhaṃ vā homayet tu pṛthak pṛthakjayādirabhyādhānāṃ ca kramādraṣṭrabhṛtaṃ hunetbhūtale nikhanetāṃśca samudreṣvathavā nayetpīṭhaśuddhiṃ tataḥ kṛtvā pañcamṛdgavya bilvakaiḥdhārābhiṣecanaṃ kuryācchuddhai ruddhaiti mantrataḥrakṣābandhaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā bhadrapīṭhordhva karṇikevedyāstha sthaṇḍilaṃ kuryādaṣṭadroṇena śālinālājaiḥ puṣpaiḥ tilaiḥ darbhaivikīrṇai samalaṅkṛtamnandinaṃ ca mahākālaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ pūjayet kramātdurgāmanstraśca vighneśaṃ varaskandaṃ ca vadhāvampradici vedikumbheṣu dhariṣaṃ bhujageśvaramudīcivedikumbheṣu indraṃ vaiśvānaraṃ yamamviṣṇuṃ pītāmahañcāpi pūrvadārabhya pūjayetsumukhaṃ durmukhaṃ cātha avighnaṃ vighnanāyakamāsanaiḥ mūrtimūlādyaiḥ saṃyuktāṃ samyagārcayetbhadrapīṭhe viśeṣosti tasdhāne cādhivāsayetagnyādhānādikaṃ sarvamagnikāryoktamācarettattamūlaṣaḍaṅgaiśca pavamānaiḥ stryambakaiḥevaṃ jāgaraṇaṃ rātrau prabhāte snānamācaretkṣudrapīṭhapratiṣṭhāyā sthānaṃ vakṣyāmi tacchṛṇu

sanskrit: durgādi caṇḍapīṭhāntamagnyādīśāntamarcayetdeśakaḥ tatpṛṣṭhe bhūtanāthasya pīṭhaṃ datvā pramāṇataḥantarmaṇḍalamātraṃ syādharmeśasya vṛṣāmṛtaḥtasdhānasīmasambandham antarmaṇḍalamānataḥnairute daṇḍamānena viṣṇupīṭhaṃ pratiṣṭhayetdvitiryavaraṇe pīṭhosvevamevaṃ prakalpayetācāryaṃ pūjayet paścād vastrahemāṅguliyakaiḥparyaṣṭinottariyādyairuṣṇiṣairmaṇḍitena caśirasā vāhayitvātha kṛtvā dhāmapradaṣiṇaṃbhadrapīṭho viśeṣo'sti mantranyāsaṃ samācaretantarmaṇḍalamārabhya maryādyādyāntasalakedvāraśālā dvāraśobhā dvāraprāsādaharmyakamdvādaśālādiharmyantaṃ śobhārtharakṣaṇārthakamekādi tritalāntaṃ ca snānārthaṃ saṃprakalpayetaṣṭādi pañktiparyantaṃ śayanārthaṃ prakalpayettritālādiṣu bhūmyāntaṃ dvāraprāsādamācaretkalābhūmyavasānaṃ ca mahāgopuramiṣyatesalānamapi sarvāsāṃ mityevaṃ parikalpayetupapīṭhasamāyuktaṃ pañcāṃśaṃ tu vibhājiteekāṃśaprastarotsedhaṃ adhiṣṭhānamubhāṃśaketaśramāyāma utsedhaṃ vistārāt saṃpravakṣyatepañcaṣaḍbhāgamānaṃ tu gopuraṃ saṃprakalpayetśivāṃśaṃ ropayed dhīmānnekāṃśa rahitaṃ kramātśālādigopurāntaṃ ca vistāramiha kathyatepañcahastaṃ samārabhya dvidvihastavivardhanāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pañcadhā gopure kāryaṃ krameṇa viniveśayethasta saptati yavacca yathāmānaṃ prakalpayetaśitidvayahastāntaṃ pañcadhā parikalpayetvistāramevamākhyātaṃ māyāmaṃ madhunā śṛṇudviguṇaṃ dviguṇārdhaṃ ca tvayāmaṃ kalpayed budhaḥāyādi śobhanārthaṃ ca vistāre tu viśeṣataḥāyādi śubhasaṃyuktaṃ tatra mānaṃ prakalpayetśātyotsedhaṃ tu dharmāṃśaṃ kalpayet tu vicakṣaṇaḥtripādādhikaprāsādaṃ bhajyaṃ dviguṇamuttamamuttarādiśikhāntaṃ ca vā mastakādiṃ ta mathāpi vāprāsādoktapadāt tatra nivṛcceśaṃ ca kathyatesaptabhāge tribhāgaṃ ca sālaniṣkrāntameva hidvāravistāramevaṃ tu krameṇaiva tu kalpayetdviguṇaṃ tu tadutsedhaṃ dvāramānaṃ vidhīyateliṅgasya madhyādvāme tu dvāramadhye prakalpayettribhagenaikabhāgaṃ vā pañcabhāgekameva vādvārastambhapramāṇena upanādyuttarāntakamadhiṣṭhānaṃ ca dvyayaṃśena dvyayaṃśatilapāyanamtribhāgenaikabhāgena adhiṣṭhānocchrayaṃ bhavetupapīṭhodayāntaṃ ca sthānamānaṃ vidhīyatepūrve kavāṭabandhaṃ syādapare tu vivarjayetpaṃktitrayaṃ samārabhya rudrapaṃktyantavistṛtamvistāre navabhāge tu pañcāṃśaṃ nālagehakamśeṣaṃ tu bhittivistāramekabhauma prakalpayettrayaṃśaṃ grabhagehaṃ syātpādaṃ bhittiviśālakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: hārāntaradvayaṃśenavistārāyāmameva cadaśāṃśaṃ dvibhajedīrghaṃ vistāraṃ ca tathā bhavetālindraṃ dvekabhāgena hārāvyāsaṃ śivāṃśakamekāṃśaṃ pañcaravyāsamardhāṃśaṃ harayonnaramtritālaṃ dvitivikhyātaṃ caturbhumamadhaśṛṇudvitālādi kalāntaṃ ca sārdhakoṭi samanvitammadhyakoṣṭhāṃśasaṃyuktaṃ sārdhakoṭi subhadrakamdvayaṃśaṃ bhittiviskambhamaṃśenā dhārikaṃ bhavetvistāraṃ daśadhā kṛtvā karṇakūṭaviśāṃśakamkarṇakūṭāṃśakaṃ tyaktvā āyāme tu viśeṣataḥśālādīrghaṃ ṣaḍaṃśaṃ tu ardhāṃśena tu pañjaramtriyodaśāṃśaṃ vistāre nālaṃ gehe triyaṃśakamhāradīrghaṃ ca mekāṃśaṃ bāhyabhittiviśālakamdvādaśāṅgulavistāramekāṃśaṃ kūṭavismṛtamkarṇakūṭāṃśakaṃ tyaktvā āyāme tu viśeṣataḥrasabhūmiriti khyātaṃ saptabhūmirathocyateśālādīrghaṃ tu bhūtāṃśaṃ śeṣaṃ hārāntaraṃ bhavettrayoviṃśāṃśamāyāmaṃ rasāṃśaṃ koṣṭhadīrghikamśeṣaṃ hārasamāyuktaṃ saptabhūmimiti smṛtamśālāśaṃ bhūtabhāgaṃ tu śeṣaṃ hāra sapañjaramtrayoviṃśatibhāgaṃ tu pārśvakoṣṭhadvayaṃśakamekāṃśādhikaṃ koṣṭhaṃ ca śeṣaṃ hārā sapañjaramevaṃ rasādībhūmyantaṃ triyaṃśaṃ garbhagehakampañjaramvistare saptadāśāṃśaṃ ekāṃśaṃ kūṭavistṛtam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dvātriṃśadīrghamevaṃ tu dvayaṃśaṃ pārśvakoṣṭhakamśeṣaṃ hārāntaraṃ proktaṃ daśabhaumaṃ prakalpayetdvayaṃśaṃ pārśvakoṣṭhaṃ ca rasāṃśaṃ koṣṭhadairghyakamdīrghamevaṃ prakartavyaṃ karṇakūṭāṃśakaṃ vināpakṣāṃśaṃ pārśvakoṣṭhaṃ ca pañjaraṃ tu tripādakamekamardhaṃ tripādaṃ vā pañjarasya tu dīrghakamtrisaptati vibhāgaṃ tu ekāṃśaṃ karṇakūṭakamardhāṃśaṃ pañjaraṃ proktaṃ śeṣaṃ hārāntaraṃ smṛtamśālāyāmaṃ tu bhānvāśanandāśaṃ pañjaraṃ bhavettrīṃ viṃśadaṃśena vistāraṃ ekāṃśaṃ kūṭavistaramekāṃśapañjaraṃ proktaṃ trayodaśatalaṃ kramātśālādīrghaṃ tu rudrāṃśaṃ pārśvakoṣṭhadvayaṃśakamcatvāryaṃśaṃ vibhajyātha arkāṃśaṃ koṣṭhameva caśeṣaṃ hārāntaraṃ caiva caturdaśatalaṃ matamnandāṃśaṃ kūṭamevaṃ tu pārśvakoṣṭhadvayaṃśakamāyāme tu viśeṣeṇa pañcāśadbhāgamevaṃ hitripādaṃ pañjaraṃ proktaṃ śeṣaṃ hārāntaraṃ kramātpārśvakoṣṭhadvayaṃśaṃ ca daśāṃśaṃ madhyakoṣṭhakamṣaṣṭhyaṃśaṃ vibhajet tatrātraidaśaṃ madhyakoṣṭhakamśeṣaṃ hārāntaraṃ proktaṃ rdantimānamidaṃ paramsubhadraṃ vā vibhadraṃ vā pastharama kalpayed budhaḥgaṇḍamānamadhovakṣye śṛṇudhvaṃ tatprabhañjanamsārdhāṃśaṃ tu kapotoccaṃ mekāṃśaṃ galameva caevameva krameṇaivā ekabhaumamiti smṛtamekāṃśa pañcamānaṃ tu sārdhapakṣaṃśakaṃ ghaṭam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: uttarādi śikhāntaṃ ca trayodaśāṃśameva caprastaroccaṃ sapādāśaṃ dvayaṃśaṃ pādameva casārdhapakṣaṃ śakaṃ proktaṃ śeṣaṃ ghyudayaṃ smṛtampañcamānaṃ sapādāṃśaṃ dvayaṃśaṃ caraṇāyatamśeṣaṃ stūpyadayaṃ proktā dvitalaṃ jvīti vidyatesārdhāṃśa pañcamānaṃ syātsārdhadvyāṃśāṅghri tuṅgakammañcamānaṃ śivāṃśaṃ ca śaśyambhaṃ galamucyatetritalaṃ hyevamākhyātaṃ caturbhumimadha śṛṇumado na dvayaṃśamañcoñcaṃ pakṣāṃśaṃ caraṇāyatampādonatriṃśaśikharaṃ śeṣaṃ sthūpyādayaṃ bhavetuttarādi śikhāntaṃ ca pañcaviṃśati bhāgayāsapādoṃśakapotoccaṃ guṇāṃśaṃ talipāyatamsapādāṃśakapotoccaṃ pakṣāṃśaṃ talipāyatamyugāṃśaṃ śikharot tuṅgaṃ śeṣaṃ sthūpyādayaṃ bhavetuttarādiśikhāntaṃ ca ekatriṃśāṃśakaṃ bhavetpakṣāṃśaṃ mañcamānaṃ tu sārdha hyaṃśaṃ ghrituṅgakamsārthāṃśamañcamānaṃ tu sārdhapakṣāṃśamaghrikamvyomāśaṃ mañcamānaṃ tu sapādāṃśaṃ galodayamrasabhūmimiti proktaṃ saptabhūmimadha śṛṇuuttarādi śikhāntaṃ ca aṣṭatriṃśati bhāgayāsapādadvayaṃ śamaṃ coccaṃ yugāṃśaṃ talipāyatamsapādadvyaṃśamañcoccaṃ vedāṃśaṃ caraṇāyatamsthāṇu tripādamaccorcaṃ magnyardhaṃ talipātakamsapādāṃśa kapotoccaṃ tribhāgaṃ galamucyatesaptabhūmimiti proktaṃ vasubhūmimadhaśṛṇu

sanskrit: prathamam aṅkuraṃ caiva dvitīyaṃ cotsavāṅkurammānuṣādipiśācāntaṃ manyānaṃ tu prakīrtitamtaddine ca tṛtīyaṃ syādvāpayedaṅkuraṃ budhaḥtṛtīyamutsavāṅgaṃ syādutsaveṣu ca yogyakamtasmātsarvaprayatnena tīrthāṅkuramathārabhetmaṅgalāṅkurakaṃ kuryāt sarvakāryeṣu yogyakammaṅgalāṅkurakaṃ kuryāt tīrthāṅkuraṃ tu vāpayetpālikā ratnamātroccāṃ mātrāṅgulena kārayettat tatriguṇatannāhaṃ pālikāpādamānakamśarāvamukhavistāraṃ dvādaśāṅgulamucyatevarjayet tu prayatnena sādhayellakṣaṇānvitamyathālābhapramāṇena kārayed deśikottamaḥvālukairgomayermṛdbhiḥ pālikādi prapūjayetgandhapuṣpādibhiḥ pūjya tilairdarbha paristaraiḥaśvattha patra darbhāstu pālikā pādake nyasetpayasā kṣālayitvā tu vāpayed daśabījakaiḥtāmbūlaṃ dāpayet tatra svanugupte nidhāpayetpaścācchubhāśubhaṃ vīkṣya śubhaṃ saṅgṛhya buddhimānaśubhāni bhavet tatra prāyaścittādi kārayetācāryo yajamānaśca cintayed dinasaṅkhyayātaddine vāpi kartavyamuttamaṃ madhyāmādhamamkṣatriyasya tu madhyāhne vaiśyānāmaparāhnakedhvajārohaṇapūrvaṃ tu brāhmaṇānāṃ hitāya vaiaṅkurārpaṇapūrvaṃ tu nagare puṇyadeśakebherītāḍanapūrvaṃ tu kuryād grāmaṃ viśeṣataḥ

sanskrit: aṅkurārpaṇapūrvaṃ tu bhaktānāṃ dikṣu kārayetanyathā kārayed yastu kriyāsaṅkaramucyatesaralaṃ candanaṃ caiva dhātakī campakaṃ tathāuttamaṃ śatahastaṃ syānmadhyamaṃ tu tadardhakamathavāṣṭadaśaṃ hastaṃ dvādaśāṅgulavistaramavakraṃ nirvṛṇaṃ caiva kṛmikoṭaravarjitamṣoḍaśāṅgulanāhaṃ syāddaṇḍāgre caturaṅgulamādhāraphalakāstisro hastamātrapramāṇataḥevameva vidhānena kārayed deśikottamaḥvraṣālayāgre pṛṣṭhe vā śūlasyāgre ca vā punaḥbrahmaṇasya dhvajaṃ śvetaṃ kṣatriyasya tu raktakamdukūlaṃ paṭṭavastraṃ vā paṭaṃ kārpāsameva capañcabhāgaikavistāraṃ ṣaḍbhāgaikamathāpi vāvistārasya samaṃ pucchaṃ tasyārdhaṃ śikharaṃ bhavetacchinnamuttamaṃ proktaṃ sacchinnaṃ lakṣaṇānvitamdvādaśaṃ vā prakūrvīta aṣṭahastāyataṃ śubhamutsavārthaṃ tu saṅgṛhya tanmadhye vṛṣabhaṃ likhetpaścādyāgeśaśalāyāṃ pūjayet tu śivadvijaḥdarpaṇaṃ pūrṇakumbhaṃ ca cāmaraṃ vā dvayornyasetevameva vidhānena kārayed deśikottamaḥpaścāddhvajaṃ pañcagavye prokṣayecchivamantrataḥdaṇḍaṃ ca pūrvaratrau tu sthāpayet tu śivadvijaḥvṛṣabhaṃ kūrmakaṃ vāpi haimaṃ śvabhraṃ vinikṣipetsakūrcadarbhamālaṃ ca veṣṭayed dhvajadaṇḍakebrāhmaṇādi krameṇaiva kārayet tu viśeṣataḥ

sanskrit: iṣṭikābhiśca mṛdbhirvā sudhayā vātha kārayettadūrdhve padmamālikhya dalāṣṭakasamanvitamyathā manoramaṃ kuryādathavā deśikottamaḥastraṃ caiva paṭaṃ caiva bimbāgre vā śivāgraketriśūlaṃ ca paṭaṃ caiva bimbaṃ caiva viśeṣataḥhomaṃ kṛtvā tadāgrāme nagarādiṣu kārayetgandhapuṣpādibhiḥ pūjyā puṣpaṃ gāyatrimantrataḥathavā bandhamārgeṇa sarvālaṅkārasaṃyutamsnapanaṃ kārayet tatra puṇyāhaṃ vācayed budhaḥbrāhmaṇān bhojayet paścādācāryaṃ pūjayet sadādhvajārohaṇapūrveyu rātrau bheryāstu tāḍanamtaṇḍulasyāṣṭabhāgaṃ ca vyajanaṃ ṣoḍaśāṃśakamphalādi bhakṣaṇadravyairdaśāṃśaṃ dāpayet kramātaṅkurārpaṇapūrve tu rātrāveva pratāḍayetprokṣayet pañcagavyena nandigāyatrimantrataḥmaṇḍapasya tu madhye tu pariveṣasya madhyameāpohiṣṭheti mantreṇa prokṣayet tu kuśāmbhasātrihastaṃ caiva vistāraṃ śālibhiścaturaṅgulamdharmeṇa saṃsmareddhīmān gandhapuṣpādinārcayetkarṇikāyāṃ nyaset śūlaṃ bheriṃ cānye tu kārayetvastrayugmaparicchinnaṃ kuśadarbhena veṣṭitamkrameṇārādhyayatnena havistatra pradāpayettasmindeśe baliṃ dadyānnandigāyatri mantrataḥtriśūlena samāyuktaṃ sandhyāṃ sandhyā hi tāḍayetrātryamevaṃ prakartavyaṃ navarātraṃ viśeṣataḥ

sanskrit: gehasya purataḥ kuryādīśānye pāvake'thavābhūmiśuddhiṃ purākṛtvā prokṣayet pañcagavyakaiḥadhamaṃ daśahastaiśca nava hastaṃ ca saptakaiḥcaturaṅgulamutsedhaṃ nimnonatavivarjitamkūṭaṃ vā maṇḍapaṃ vāpi kārayellakṣaṇānvitamratnimātrasamutsedhaṃ darpaṇodarasannibhambrāhmaṇādyaiśca kartavyamutsedhaṃ ṣoḍaśāṅgulamvedibāhye tu parito navakuṇḍāni kārayetathavā hastamātreṇa kuṇḍaṃ vistārakhātakamdikṣu vai caturāśrāṇi vṛttāni ca vidikṣu vainavahomakramaṃ proktaṃ pañcahomakramaṃ śṛṇuindreśānakayormadhye aṣṭāśraṃ kalpayed budaḥvṛttaṃ vā caturaśraṃ vā kalpayeddeśikottamaḥvṛttaṃ vā caturaśraṃ vā lakṣaṇoktena kārayetnavāhe navahomaṃ syāt saptāhe saptahomakamekāhe caikahomaṃ syāddhomaṃ kṛtvā vicakṣaṇaḥathavā caikahomena kārayeddeśiko budhaḥcatustoraṇasaṃyuktamaṣṭamaṅgalabhūṣaṇamlājaiśca vividhaiḥ puṣpaimaṇḍapaṃ pūjayed budhaḥpuṇyāhaṃ vācayet paścācchilpakarmāvasānakeutsavārambhapūrve tu rathādīn kārayet kramātnānādhvajādi piṃcchāni nānācāmarakāni cautsavasyādirātrau tu aṅkurārpaṇamārabhetastamādapare kāle pañcanāḍyāṃ sulagnakeliṅgaṃ ca kautukaṃ caiva triśūlaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ

sanskrit: maṇḍapaṃ mārjayitvā tu gomayenānulepayetsnānaṃ kṛtvā yathānyāsaṃ vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇānāsamārga kramaṃ kuryāt sthitinyāsaṃ viśeṣataḥsarvābharaṇasaṃpūrṇaḥ sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutaḥsthaṇḍilaṃ kārayed vedyāmaṣṭo droṇena śālinātilataṇḍulamiśraṃ tu kesarāgreṇa vinyasetkuṭṭimasyeśadigbhāge śālibhiścaturaśrakamdharmajñānādi vinyasya āsanārcanakarmaṇikumbhaṃ ca vardhanīṃ caiva kalaśaṃ ca vicakṣaṇaḥvastrapūtena toyena pūrṇaṃ kuryād yathepsitamkūrcādi nikṣipet tatra pañcaratnādi nikṣipettathā devyā sahāsīnaṃ yāgeśaṃ cārcayet kramātevaṃ dhyātvā tu manasā kalpayedīśagocarevaddhanīṃ hemasaṃyuktāṃ kalaśeṣuttare kramāt prabhoḥgandhaiḥ puṣpaiśca dhūpaiśca dīpairārātrikaistataḥsarvālaṅkārasaṃyuktaṃ stotramaṅgalavācakaiḥyāgamaṇḍapamadhye vā sthāpayetpūrvadeśakeastraṃ tatraiva saṃsthāpya kautukaṃ bandhayeddhṛdāpṛthagvastreṇa saṃveṣṭya pradhaṃ hemaṃ nikṣipetdaśāyudhāni paritaḥ kalpayeddeśikottamaḥdvārādi devatābhyarcya sarvān devān prapūjayethomasya dakṣiṇe bhāge yāgeśaṃ pūjayed budhaḥsamidhājya carūn lājān tilasarṣapamudgakaiḥpañcabrahmaṣaḍaṅgaiśca vyomavyāpi daśākṣaraiḥyathākrameṇa hotavyamaṣṭāviṃśatireva ca

sanskrit: śivāgneragniṃ saṃgrāhya sarvakuṇḍeṣu nikṣipethomānte vātha kartavyam athavā madhyame'pi vāśuddhānnaṃ dadhisaṃyuktaṃ baliṃ dadyācchivadvijaḥbrahmarātraṃ tṛtīyaṃ syādgāndharvaṃ tu caturthakamsaptamaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ proktamaṣṭamaṃ rākṣasaṃ tathāsaptāhe brahmarātrādi indrarātrādi pañcamepakṣotsave tu tithayaḥ rātridevāḥ prakīrtitāḥāptotsave tu tatsyād devaṃ vai rātridevatāḥpadmapuṣpaṃ sarajanī lājasaktusamanvitamharidrānnaṃ sasarpi ca nālikeraphalairyutamgulodanaṃ ghṛtaṃ miśraṃ kadalīphalasaṃyutammāṣānnaṃ ghṛtasaṃyuktam aṣṭameha'ni dāpayetsvasvairnāmādibhirmantrairdhvajādiṣu baliṃ dadetsaṃhāreṣu na kartavyaṃ kartavyaṃ cenmahadbhayamanyabimbena kartavyaṃ kartavyaṃ cenmahadbhayamkārayed yadiṃ mohena rājarāṣṭraṃ vinaśyativaiṣṇave vaiṣṇavaṃ kuryād bauddhādiṣu tathaiva cateṣāṃ hi cotsave sa * tge karkṣe saṃbhavedyadicatuṣpathe tripāthe ca brahmasthānaṃ prakalpayettasmin vīthyāṃ prakartavyamutsavaṃ vidhipūrvakamtasya deśādhipatyasya bhūnāśaṃ tu na saṃśayaḥutsavasya tu kāle tu ativṛṣṭistu saṃbhavettasmiñcaivotsavaṃ kuryātsarvālaṅkārasaṃyutamśūlābhāve tu bimbaṃ syāt tadabhāve tu golakābaliṃ kuryād dvikāle tu utsavānta hi daivikam

sanskrit: tasmātsarvaprayatnena kārayedbalimuttamambalyarthaṃ sthalikāyāṃ tu vinyaseddhṛdayena tupāśaṃ vāmakare caivamabhayaṃ dakṣiṇe tathāevaṃ pāśupataṃ dhyātvā baliliṅge tu pūjayetprathame tu patākāśca dvitīye vādyakastathāpañcame cānnaliṅgaṃ tu ṣaṣṭhake kautukaṃ vrajetsabhāsthāne rājagṛhe deśikasyālaye tathāpraṇavādi namontaṃ tu svanāmapadamadhyagamevaṃ balibhramaṃ kuryād balipīṭhe baliṃ kṣipetbalipīṭhe baliṃ samyag visarjeddhṛdayena tukautukaṃ balidānānte kuryād grāmapradakṣiṇaṃyantraraṅgaiḥ samāyuktaṃ nānābhinnairanekaśaḥnānāvidhasamāyuktaṃ nānāpiñchaiḥ samāyutamekaṃ vāpi trayaṃ vāpi caturthaṃ pañcadhā purānānāgeyasamāyuktaṃ nānānṛttasamāyutamevameva prakāreṇa kārayet utsavaṃ śubhamgrāmaike caiva kartavyaṃ utsavārthaṃ hi vartmaniyathāvācakabimbena kārayedutsavaṃ budhaḥrakṣādīpaṃ śivaṃ dadyād balipīṭhe visarjayetyajñādi dīkṣitaṃ bimbaṃ aṅkurasyādi rātrakaiḥnavayātrā pare cāhni ālaye saṃpraveśayetavabhṛtasya pūrvedyuḥ nṛttabimbaṃ samācaretgrāmapradakṣiṇaṃ kuryāt kautukaṃ mandire'pi vāpuṇyāhaṃ vācayet tatra brāhmaṇān bhojayet tataḥdevasya dakṣiṇe haste kuryāt sūtrādibhirbudhaḥ

sanskrit: prātaḥkāle samabhyarcya ānīyā maṇḍape śubhetriyambakena mantreṇa arcayennṛttabimbakampaścād devyāstathā dṛṣṭyā ācāryāya pradāpayetpuṇyāhaṃ vācayet tatra brāhmaṇān bhojayet tataḥgandhayuktividhānena kārayedgandhamuttamamhṛdayenaiva mantreṇa prokṣayed gandhavāriṇāastrasya dīkṣitasyaiva mūlaliṅgasya dāpayetsarvālaṅkārasaṃyuktaṃ sarvātodyasamanvitamśanaiḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ kuryānnadūraṃ na samīpataḥsaṃhite saṃhitaṃ kuryād bhinne bhinnaṃ samācaretpaścāddhomaṃ baliṃ kuryādutsavaṃ tadanu vrajetrātrāvevaṃ prakartavyamudayādaparena hidevasya visṛjedṛkṣāṃ gandhaṃ caiva tu varjayetdevyāṃ ca kārayet tadvacchaktimantreṇa buddhimānpaścānnirañjanaṃ kuryācchāstradṛṣṭena karmaṇāprabhūtaṃ ca havirdadyāt sahasarvopadaṃśakaiḥpariveṣakramaṃ kuryāt sāye caiva viśeṣataḥpaścācchaṇḍeśakaṃ kuryāt sarvālaṅkārasaṃyutamālayaṃ praviśeddhīmān brāhmai caiva muhūrtakepaścādvisṛjya nirmālyam abhiṣekaṃ hi kārayetpaścānirañjanaṃ kuryāt prabhūtaṃ haviṣandadetevameva vidhānena kārayed deśikottamaḥmūlabimbaṃ viśeṣeṇa pūjayet pūrvamārgataḥācāryaṃ pūjayet tatra vastrahemāṅgulīyakaiḥtīrthādi pūrvarātrau tu kautukaṃ bandhayeddhṛdā

sanskrit: haimairvā rajatairvāpi kṣaumakārpāsakena vāsthaṇḍilaṃ kārayet tatra śālibhiścaturaṅgulamvimānapradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā puṇyāhaṃ vācayed budhaḥādhivāsanaṃ tataḥ kuryād brāhmī caiva viśeṣataḥvitānopari saṃpādya muktādāmairalaṅkṛtamtaṇḍulaistiladarbhaiśca samyagaṣṭadalaṃ likhetaṣṭau ghaṭāni paritaḥ sthāpayedaṣṭamūrtikānpaścādbimbaṃ tu saṃsthāpya mūlabimbaṃ viśeṣataḥgacchet samatale samyak sthaṇḍilaṃ kārayedbudhaḥastragandhasamāyuktān sakūrcān sapidhānakāngandhapuṣpādibhiḥ pūjya śūlagāyatrimantrataḥsarvālaṅkārasaṃyuktaṃ śūlaṃ yāge tu veśayetpūrvoktena vidhānena homaṃ bimbaṃ ca kārayetrajanīcūrṇasyārambhamutsavānte viśeṣataḥsthaṇḍilaṃ caturaśraṃ tu aṣṭadroṇena śālināekasminnastrasaṃsthāpya madhye tālaṃ ca vinyasetarcayedgandhapuṣpādyai bimbaṃ cāsraṃ viśeṣataḥhṛdā nikṣipya rajaniṃ cūrṇayeddhṛdayena tupaśādbhaktajanaiścaiva kārayet sumuhurmuhuḥgandhapuṣpādibhiḥ pūjya prāsādena tu mantrataḥyāgamūrtestathā caiva cūrṇaṃ tailaṃ ca dāpayetpaścād bhaktajanānāṃ tu cūrṇaṃ tailaṃ ca dāpayetbalimādikrameṇaiva cūrṇaṃ tailaṃ ca dāpayetpaścātprāsādamāveśya gandhapuṣpādibhiryajetsarvapāpaharaṃ caiva sarvatīrthaphalapradam

sanskrit: snānānte cārcanaṃ kuryād gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ kramāthavirnivedayet paścāt dyatha vibhavavistaraiḥnagarādivimāneṣu kiñcidīśānamāśritammadhyāpracalitaṃ liṅgaṃ sarvatra calitaṃ nayetdvāramānena vā kuryāddhastamānena vā punaḥtrayatriṃśāṅguladairghyaṃ muttamaṃ mānamucyateekaikatryaṅgulaṃ hīnaṃ navadhā mānamiṣyateāyavyayasamāyuktaṃ sarvaṃ kuryād viśeṣataḥśilpaśāstreṇa saṃyuktāmācaryasya viśeṣataḥtasmāt sarvaprayatnena hīnādhikyaṃ na kārayetāṣāḍhādi ca ṣāṇmāsaṃ devānāṃ nici cocyatepuṣye ca māghamāse ca liṅgasthāpanamuttamamvaiśākhe ca tathā jyeṣṭhe adhamaṃ kālamiṣyatenṛpāṇāmabhivṛddhyarthaṃ māghamāse tu kārayetvaiśākhe paśujātīnāṃ anyeṣāṃ jyeṣṭhamāsakedivākāle tu saṃprāpte tadā kāle tu sthāpayetmaghasvāti ca saume dṛśravaṇe aśvayugbhavetmaitre ca rohiṇī caiva eṣu ṛkṣeṣu sthāpayetpūrvapakṣe tṛtīye ca dvitīye pañcami tathātrayodaśi tathā caiva ubhayoḥ pakṣayorapiṣaṣṭi cā saptami caiva daśamī ca viśeṣataḥvṛṣabhe mithune caiva mīne siṃhe tathaiva capratiṣṭhārambhavidhinā yajamānānukūlakameṣu sthāneṣu candraṃ syāt jīvaśukrabudhodayeeṣu sthāneṣu śāstraṃ hi budhasyānuviśeṣataḥ

sanskrit: eṣu sthāneṣu śāstraṃ hi bṛhaspatiḥ sthite satitriṣaḍāyagatāḥ pāpāḥ sarvān ekādaśe'pi catasmāt sarvaprayatnenāśubhaṃ caiva tu varjayetbudhadviyukto dvitīye ca anurādha tathā yutāevamādiṣu yogeṣu anyeṣu śubhayogakṛtevaṃ parikṣya yatnena pratiṣṭhāṃ gururārabhetekāhaṃ pūjayet tatra sarvadoṣaharaṃ nṛṇāmjaṅgamādīni liṅgānāṃ kālakālaparikṣayetanyeṣāṃ devakāryeṣu yajamānecchayā sahāakurānarpayitvā tu pratiṣṭhāṃ samyagācarettṛtīyaṃ brahmasūtraṃ tu cātut grāmapradakṣiṇamṣaṣṭhe maṇḍapasaṃskāraṃ saptame śayanakrayadaśame dakṣiṇāproktā matranyāsamataḥ parameṣāṃ krameṇa vakṣyāmi yathā vā munipuṅgavāḥyasmin grāme baliḥ śabdastasmin strārākṣasādayaḥtasmātsarvaprayatnena kuryānnityabaliṃ kramamnityaṃ baliṃ kramaṃ kuryādrājāvijayamichatiadhamaṃ golakaṃ jñeyam athavā puṣpānnataṇḍulaiḥteṣāmabhāve mannādīn kuryāsamyak sadā budhaḥmadhyānne cānnaliṅgena maṇiliṅgaśivaprayamsauvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tāmraṃ kāṃsyapātracaturvidhampātrasya madhyame padmaṃ kalpayet tu dalāṣṭakamgomayenopalipyātha pātraṃ saṃsthāpya tatra tuīśānamantramuccārya baliliṅge śivaṃ nyasethṛdayādyastraparyantaiḥ mantrairabhyarcayet kramāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sahoṣṇīṣottarīyeṇa liṅgaṃ śirasi dhārayetpāśupadāstramūttirvā candraśekharameva capuṣpānnaṃ taṇḍulaṃ liṅgaṃ tasya liṅgaṃ tanuvrajetvādyadhvanisamāyuktaṃ gaṇikādyairalaṅkṛtamgopurātpurato gacchecchaṅkhadhvanisamanvitamtasya paścimabhāge tu pratimāsthānamucyatemaṇiliṅgasya paścābhyāṃ golakāsthānamiṣyatepradakṣiṇakrameṇaiva pratimādīni sthāpayetpratimādya iti proktā prati ca maṇigolakāpūrvābhimukhamāsthāpya pratimāgrasya pādukampātragandhaiḥ stathā puṣpaiḥ dhūpadīpairadhorghyakaicaturṇaprathamādīnāṃmarghyaṃ śirasi vinyasetsvasthāne sthāpya vārādyai pūjayedbrahmapañcabhiḥdvārādibhisamabhyarcya pañcabhiḥ brahmabhi kramātmūlaliṅge tu saṃsthāpya śimantre samuccaretbaliliṅgavisṛjyātha pādukānarcayedbudhaḥpūrvoktavidhinā sarvaṃ kārayeddeśikottamaḥyorabhāve maṇiśivaṃ golakāṃ hi viśeṣataḥtasmātsarvaprayatnena nityaṃ kuryāt phalecchutāevamabhyarcya vidhinā svasthāne ca praveśayetpaścānnīrājanaṃ kuryāt prāsādena tu mantrataḥdroṇahīnaṃ na kartavyaṃ kartavyaṃ mandire kramātpañcāśat pañcaviṃśadbhiḥ ghṛtākte navakaṃ hunettailābhyaṅgaṃ hṛdā kuryāt ccheṣaṃ pūrvavadācaretprātaḥkāle ca mabhyaṅgaṃ mūlaṃ ca bali bimbake
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: paścāt caruṃ pradadyāt tu pratyekaṃ hṛdinā budhaḥanyathā kārayed yastu tatkalaṃ nniṣphalaṃ bhavetvārotsavamidaṃ prokta tasmin mantre viśeṣataḥgocara satyavādi ca pūrvācāraprayogavitmantrajñaḥ śabdabhedajñaḥ gurudevāgnipūjakaḥnaktabhoji jitendrajñaśca vyaktācāra priyaṃvadaḥpañcayajñaparo nityaṃ śūdrānnaṃ parivarjayetniṣkalātsakalo jāta tadvadācāryaputrakaḥteṣāmabhāveṇācāryaputreṇaiva kṛtaṃ yadiparadravyaṃ na gṛhnīyāt bhaktānugrāhakāraṇaḥcāturṇāmapi varṇānāṃ brāhmaṇebhyo viśiṣyatebrahmaṇakṣatryakanyāyāḥ jāto vai kṣatriyottarāḥbrāhmaṇān kṣatriyāṇāmalābhe tu vaiśyānāṃ tu viśeṣataḥānulomastathācārya pratilomastu varjitākṣatriyasya prasūto'pi vaiśyātkiñcidivottamaḥkṣatryāsu vaiśyakanyāyāṃ jāto vaiśyottamo bhavetsarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannā dīkṣitaḥ śivagocaraḥśaivaṃ pāśupataṃ somaṃ trayassiddhāntabhedineaṣṭapradānāmukhyeta aṣṭasaṃdarśanapriyesmiṃgdhāṅgo lalitāṅgaśca sarvāvayavaśobhitaḥsūtratyāgi śikhātyāgi mantrasādhyādibhiḥ śubhaḥso'pi vai naiṣṭiko nāma ācārya śreṣṭha ucyateityevākṛtisaṃyuto vastrābharaṇaśobhitaḥdīrghāṅgi caiva hrasvāṅgi śaṭho dadhi guṇaṃ saramviṭapadvaiva dhūrtaśca dṛtomattapramattavān
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: andhakaṃ tanukāścaiva aṅgahīno'pi kopavānaṣṭāśauco vratahīno nāmadhāraka viprakaḥanācāryasya putro vā mugdhasya hṛdahāryatevyapāri devavikrīta vidyānaṣṭaśca naṣṭavānsvakarmaṇi phalaṃ tata syāt pratiṣṭhādiṣu yastu saḥādiśaivena kartavyaṃ pratiṣṭhāpanādikamsakalaḥ sarvadeśeṣu gatāgataviniściyaḥācāryalakṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ śiṣyāderlakṣaṇaṃ śṛṇusvamūrtimūrtidhāraśca paryaṣṭiparicārakaḥādiśaivakulotpanno śivadīkṣābhiṣiktakaḥśaivāgameṣu saṃpanno sarvaśāstrārtha tatvagaḥmahāśaivastu vikhyātāstadābhāve nṛpastathāsamayi putrakaścaiva sādhako mūrtidhārakaḥevameva vidhānenā pratiṣṭhādīnntu kārayetkarṣaṇādipratiṣṭhāntamekasantānamārgataḥprāsādakaraṇaṃ yasyāt tathā liṅgadayastathāanyaṃ vā cirakālaṃ tu pratisaṃvatsarotsavamarcanaṃ cāgnikāryaṃ ca snapanaṃ vāstukarmakamdinasaṅkhyāvidhānaṃ yadabhinnamiti kīrtitamavaśyagantumicchācetannarātravasate dhṛvamabhinnakavidhānena saṅkhyādi vidhe purāācāryādicaturṇāṃ tu evameva vidhīyateparivārāṇi cānyā ca yaḥ karoti puro tataḥkuryādihi viśeṣo'sti rūpāntarakṛtaṃ yadikāraṇaṃ kiṃ viśeṣo'sti mantrasaṃbandhakāraṇāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kuryāṃ tu sthāpanādīnāṃ yevameva vidhīyatetasyai cānugraheṇaiva kuryāgotrāntareṇa vāpitṝsya karaṇaṃ sasyāt tasya putreṇa tatkṛtamtasya bhāve tu tatputro kuryād bhinnakriyāśchirotevameva prakāreṇa sarvaṃ vai cārya kārayetgrāmādīnāṃ vināśāya śatrunāśaṃ na saṃśayaḥśiṣyāde lakṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ garbhanyāsaṃvidhi śṛṇusarvalokahitārthāya sarvaśāntikarāya casakalaṃ niṣkalaṃ caiva dvividhaṃ pratimucyatedvātriṃśadaṅgasaṃpūrṇaṃ sakalaṃ tu prabhedataḥsauvarṇaṃ rājyakāmīnāṃ rājitaṃ vaiśyavṛddhidamyathā na * * dravyeṇa pratimā kārayed budhaḥekaikaṃ tritribheduni navadā bhedamucyateekaviṃśatprabhedaṃ tu ṣoḍaśaiva prabhedataḥīśamānaṃ prakartavyaṃ uttamottamamucyateraśitiraṅgulaṃ mānaṃ uttamaṃ tu vidhīyateevaṃ mānaprabhedaṃ tu śilpiśāstroktamācarettṛtīyaṃ mumayayuktaṃ vṛṣārūḍhaṃ caturthakamcandraśekharamevoktaṃ saptamaṃ tu viśeṣataḥcaṇḍeśvaraprasādaṃ tu daśamaṃ parikīrtitamtrayodaśaṃ dakṣāṇamūrtiṃ bhikṣāṭanamataḥ paramevaṃ ṣoḍaśamūrtināṃ bhedaṃ vaivakṣyate'dhunāgaṅgādharaṃ ca pañcaite sṛṣṭimūrtirihocyatebhikṣāṭanaṃ ca pañcaite sthitimūrtirudāhṛdamgajodbhavaṃ manvahāri jalandharavadhastathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: triṇetrāśca caturbāhuṃ bālendukṛtaśekharaḥyajñopavītasaṃyuktā kuṇḍalābhyamalaṅkṛtamvaradābhayahastābhyāṃ kṛṣṇāparaśudhāriṇaḥviśeṣaṃ tu pravakṣyāmi umāskandamaheśvarepūrvoktena pramāṇena pañcāsana samāyutamśubhāśubhaṃ nirīkṣantu samyakkṛtvaṃ tu buddhimānmumāya bāhumānena skandamānaṃ pracakṣatedevasyādyapramāṇena āsanaṃ tu viśeṣataḥtribhāgeradhamaṃ vidyāt trividhamāsanasmṛtammukhabhāgaṃ viniścitya caturviṃśacchatāṅgulaiḥnuvāddhakālamānena skandarūpaṃ tu kārayetekavaktraṃ mahābāhu nilaśiva mahadyutiḥdakṣiṇe lambitaṃ padaṃ vāmapādaṃ samāsanamsapuṣpavaradaṃ hastaṃ gaurisamyagviśeṣataḥidaṃ saumyaprakāreṇa sarvasiddhikaraṃ śubhamnānālaṅkārasaṃyuktaṃ nānābharaṇabhūṣitamraudramevāsamākhyātaṃ pāśupatādimūrtinādakṣiṇaṃ pādamāsinaṃ mumādevīṃ tathaiva caevamiśraṃ samākhyātaṃ lākule naiva kārayettataḥ śāstroktamārgeṇa paśupadādi kārayettasmātsarvaprayatnena kārayellakṣaṇānvitampratimālakṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ manonmani vidhi śṛṇuprathamaṃ bhūtasālā ca dvitīyaṃ mūrtisālakampañcamaṃ śāstrasālā ca ṣaṣṭhaṃ pannakasālakātāsāṃ hi pūjanārthāya prākāraṃ kalpayed budhaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prāsādasya tu vistāraṃ caturaṃśairvibhāvayettadvyaṃśena samastena kāraye dve pṛthak pṛthaksārdhadvitrikrameṇaiva kārayetrividhaṃ paramdigbhāghā ca guṇenaiva caturguṇaṃ triguṇitena vātātparamarcāromaṇḍapaṃ śuddhaṃ divyapañcavasantakamutpalaṃ paṅkalagnaṃ ca śrīsvasti ca niveśanammahāpadmaṃ mahācchandaṃ devavṛttaṃ tathaiva casomacchandaṃ somavṛttaṃ bahupatraṃ suveṣṭikamsiddhayogaṃ caturvṛttaṃ kūṭākāraṃ vilokanamśaśivṛttiṃ viśālaṃ ca tathā kulendukaṃ punaḥvedikaṃ vedivṛttaṃ ca somaveṇuṃ caturmukhamhastipṛṣṭhaṃ ca nevṛttaṃ pramadālatribekaṃ trivitgoyāgamaṇḍukaṃ cāpi pariprādakamuttamamśābhikārasavṛttaṃ ca nivuṣaṃ paribrahmakamcaṇḍeśasya vimānaṃ tu bhūtākārasamanvitamṣaṇṇavātivimānāni kathitāni purātanaiḥnavabhedāni sarvāṇi vimānāni pṛthak pṛthakliṅgādirūpaprasāre āyādīṃśca na kārayetyasya liṅgasya pūjāśaṃ aṣṭāśaṃ bhajayet samamcaturviṃśatcchatāṅgulyairathavā kārayed budhaḥtasmādbhāge mukhādīni kārayeddeśikottamaḥsarvalokahitārthāya sarvabhūtahitāya camāghamāse magharkṣe tu paurṇamāsyāṃ viśeṣataḥdivā parvaṇi saṃbandhe rātrau nakṣatrasaṃyute
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sarvapāpakṣayaṃ puṃsāṃ sarvakārmārthasādhanamśivapratīkaraṃ sākṣādapamṛtyuvināśanamśvetādīnāṃ gavāṃścaiva ghṛtaṃ saṅgṛhya buddhimānātmārtheṣu parārtheṣu golakanyasya vinyasetbrahmacāri catuvaṇyāṃ gokṣīrā hi ca saṅgrahethṛdayenaiva mantreṇa agnikarmādi kārayettāvat pātreṣu saṃpūjya prāsādenaiva mantrataḥātmārthe caiśadigbhāge pūjāsthānaṃ tu pūrvaketasya madhye nyaset pātraṃ hṛdayenaiva mantrataḥhṛdayena tu mantreṇa śivāmbhasā tu pūrayetyāvadvai bhinnatāṃ yāti tāvadvai mathanakriyāpacanālayadeśe tu agnimantreṇa kārayetsahasraprasthakaṃ mukhyaṃ śataprasthāntakaṃ kramātathavā hīnamānaṃ tu daśaprasthāntakaṃ kramātevaṃ bahuprakāreṇa ātmārthe vā parārthakegandhapuṣpādibhiḥ pūjya prāsādena pṛthak pṛthaknānāvādyasamāyuktaṃ nānāgeyasamanvitamsugupte maṇḍape sthāpya prāsādena tu mantrataḥdvādaśahastaṃ vā navahastāṣahastakamcatudvārasamāyuktaṃ catustoraṇabhūṣitammaṇḍapasya tribhāgekaṃ madhye vediṃ prakalpayetvedikāpūrvadigbhāge homakuṇḍaṃ hi kārayetsthāvare tu caturdikṣu homaṃ kuryāt tu deśikaḥpuṇyāhaṃ vācayet tatra pāvamānena prokṣayetaṅkurānarpayedvidvān śāstradṛṣṭenakarmaṇā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: adhivāsanarātrau tu pātrāṇi pūrayejjalaiḥathavā ca jaladroṇāghaṭe vā pūrayet kramātekapātraṃ hi cālpe tu ātmārthe trīṇi caikataḥtrimūrtiśca tripātreṣu ekapātre śivastathāevameva krameṇaiva sthāpayedvedikābahitaṃ jale śivavat kṛtvā tajjale tu ghṛtaṃ kṣipetkarṣayedīśamantreṇa deśiko tatra buddhimānsauvarṇeṣu ca pātreṣu pratyekaṃ saṅgrahed budhaḥdaśāyudhāni paritaḥ aṣṭamaṅgalasaṃyutamaṣṭalokādhipān kumbhān kumbheṣu cārcayet kramātnavavastreṇasaṃveṣṭyā prāsādenarcayedbudhaḥhomaṃ kṛtvā tadante tu pañcabrahmaṣaḍaṅgakaiḥsarṣapaṃ mudgamāṣau ca homadravyaṃ krameṇa tudeśikasyānusāreṇa pratyekaṃ homamācaretātmārthe tadvadevoktaṃ śūdrāṇamekahomakambaliṃ tatra tu kuryāt tu vedibāhye baliṃ kṣipetghṛtaṃ śirorpaṇaṃ kuryāt prāsādena tu mantrataḥtāmbūlaṃ dāpayet tatra brāhmaṇānbhojayet tataḥprabhāte deśikaṃ snātvā paścādyajanamārabhetevaṃ vidhiprakāreṇa kārayeddeśikottamaḥlokapālān samabhyarcya svasvairnnāmaiviśeṣataḥante pūrṇāhutiṃ dadyāt prāsādena tu mantrataḥgrāmapradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā ghṛtakambalakaṃ budhaḥliṅgamūrtiṃ nyaset paścādghṛtakambalakaṃ hṛdāsakalāni ca sarvāṇi sthāpane vinyaset kramāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mahāvyomena mantreṇa kambalaṃ sarvathā nyasetprabhūtahaviṣaṃ dadyād hṛdayena tu mantrataḥdivasaṃ divasārthaṃ ca yāmaṃ yāmārthameva camahāvyomena mantreṇa daśākṣaraṃ tathaiva caparivārāṇi sarvāṇi snapanaṃ kārayet kramātkambalaṃ devadevasya caṇḍeśāya pradāpayetghṛtakambalakaṃ sarvaṃ goṣu cāpsu vinikṣipetyasmin karmaṇi yanmatraṃ tasmin hṛdayamantrataḥghṛtakambalamātre tu ekarātrāddhṛtaṃ yadiataḥ paraṃ na kartavyaṃ ātmārthe tu parārthakeghṛtakambalakaṃ nyasya bhitticitre tu darpaṇesūryamaṇḍalakādyomakambalaṃ śodhayed budhaḥyāvat kambalakaṃ yasya tāvadbījaṃ na cālayetevameva vidhānena kārayeduktamārgataḥghṛtakambalakaṃ proktaṃ damanāropaṇaṃ śṛṇuuttarāyaṇage sūrye kṣurakarmasamārabhetpañcādaśavarṣādūrdhvaṃ vivāhaviṣayaṃ kuru* * * * * * * * * virañca praṇamya catasya sannidhikāle tu śivāgamavicārayetpañcagocara śuddhātma śivena paribhāṣataḥanyasmin yadi vā kuryā sthānajasyānusārataḥanādiviṣayārddheto pūrvasantānako guruḥpitrā tu yatkṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ tasya putreṇa tatkṛtamanyathā karaṇīyañcet sthānanāśaṃ na saṃśayaḥteṣvasiddhe tu kuryāt tu tasya mitrādibhirbudhaḥ

sanskrit: anyenāpyanavaktreṇa kuryāśceddoṣadammahattayoramāvayossamyaksantānaśca sagotrabhiḥātmārthayajanaṃ kuryāt parārthaṃ tu kadācanātanyasmin māsi kuryāccettatphalaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavetsthaṇḍile maṇḍale cāgnau jale vā sūryamaṇḍaleliṅgabere tathā bhittau paṭe vāpi viśeṣataḥārohaṇādinātpūrve navame saptame diśiprāsādasyāgrataḥ kuryānmaṇḍaṃ śāṃkare diśiṣoḍaśastambhasaṃyuktaṃ catudvārasamanvitamathavā pañcaṣaṭ saptatāle vistarakaṃ kurupañcacūrṇairalaṅkṛtya vitānadhvajaśobhitamaṣṭamaṅgalasaṃyuktaṃ daśāyudhāni vinyasetṣaḍdroṇai pañcabhidroṇai vedimadhye samarcayettanmadhye padmamālikhya aṣṭapatraṃ sakarṇikamathavā trīṇi kuṇḍaṃ vā ekāgnimadhavāpi vātrimekhalairalaṅkṛtya ekamekhalameva vāadhivāsaṃ tu pūrvedyurdamanasya hṛdā budhaḥdeśiko mūrttipaścaiva snānaṃ kuryāssaśikānsthāpayed vedikāmadhye śivakumbhaṃ ca vardhanicaturdaśyādi ṣaṣṭhyantaṃ pañcadaśyādike parampratyekaṃ vastramāveṣṭya arcayedgandhapuṣpakaiḥpañcadhāvibhajet puṣpaṃ pratyekaṃ pātrakaṃ nyasetśivakumbhasya paritaḥ sthāpayeddhṛdayena tupañcabrahmaśivāṅgaiśca daśākṣareṇa mantrataḥkuṇḍaṃ prati viśeṣeṇa kuryādvai deśikajñayā

sanskrit: evameva vidhānena kārayd deśikottamaḥindra īśānayormadhye kārakumbhaṃ tu vinyasetgandhapuṣpādibhiḥ pūjyā svanāma hṛdayena tugandhadāmanaka dadyāt devadevasya mūrddhanibhaktanāṃ paricārāṇāṃ yathā lābhena dāpayetevaṃ rātrau prakuryāt tu prabhāte snānamācaretpāvamānena saṃprokṣya mahāvyomena mantrataḥkāmakumbhaṃ tatoddhṛtya ratikumbhaṃ viśeṣataḥnandiṃ caiva mahākālamabhiṣekaṃ krameṇa tupaścād garbhāntikaṃ gatvā nirmālyaṃ tu visarjayetgandhapuṣpādibhiḥ pūjya pāvamāne prokṣayetśuddhasnānaṃ prakuryāt tu prāsādena tu mantrataḥkṛtvā caiva viśeṣeṇa dvipātraṃ tu pṛthan nyasetnikṣipe piṇḍikāyāṃ ca paraṃ caiva viśeṣataḥśeṣāśaṃ sakalādīnāṃ svanāmaiścaiva pūjayethavinnivedayet paścācchivabhaktāśca bhojayetātmārthaṃ pūjaye kāle bhāgaṃ tu pūrvavat kurutṛtīyāṃśaṃ śivasyoktaṃ piṇḍikāyāścaturthakamekāṃśaṃ ca gurodadyāt dapaparaṃ cārcakasya tupañcāśaṃ paitṛkādīnām evameva kramād dadetviprakṣatriyavaiśyanāmātmārthe sthāpanoktavattrirātraṃ ca dvirātraṃ ca athavā ekarātrakamprathamārambhadivase adhivāsanamucyatetithipradhānamārohe hyavarohe na doṣabhākmahāvyomena mantreṇa śivāmbhasā tu prokṣayet

sanskrit: damānārohaṇaṃ kuryād yathā śeṣataḥmantre visarjanīyaṃ cet nirmālyaṃ tatra niścayaḥātmārthamekarātraṃ tu kuryād vai sarjayedbudhaḥcaṇḍeśvarasya dātavyaṃ caṇḍamantramanusmaranpañcagavyābhiṣekaṃ tu śuddhasnāne kārayetyavādīnāvisarjyāthāta vadagniṃ * * * retghṛtena caruṇā caiva homaṃ kuryād dinaṃ pratiprabhūtaṃ havirdadyād devadevasya buddhimānbhaktānāṃ parivārāṇāṃ yathāvibhava mārgataḥbhitticitraiḥ paṭe vāpi darpaṇe pariliṅgakamkārayet tu viśeṣeṇa kuryadamanakaṃ budhaḥevaṃ vidhiprakāreṇa kuryād vai citrake budhaḥagnau damanakaṃ kṛtvā jale tatra vinikṣipetātmārthe ca parārthe ca evamevaṃ hi kārayettasmāt sarvaprayatnena uktamārgeṇa kārayetmāsaṃ pakṣaṃ tithiṃ kumbhaṃ bhāgañcaivā samāsataḥanyasarvasamānaṃsya brahmakṣatryaviśāṃ kramātanuktaṃ yad bhave kiñcit pavitravat samācaretśivakumbhaṃ tathā śānti ghṛtasnānaṃ tu kambalamarcako deśikaścaiva brahmacāritvamācaretgrāmāntaraṃ na gantavyaṃ gantavyaṃ diśi na svapetaṅkurānarpayet pūrvaṃ vratastha deśikottamaḥevameva krameṇaiva kuryādārambhake butidhaḥmahāvyoti mantreṇa daśasāhaśrakaṃ japetevameva prakāreṇa kuryādārambhake vitheḥ

sanskrit: ātmārthebhyarcya karmaśca vināśaṃ bhavaniścayaḥdamanāropaṇaṃ proktaṃ śaivācāraṃ śṛṇuṣvathaārogyamāyukīrtiśca vijayaśca phalapradamgopahatti vināśārthaṃ prajāvṛddhikaraṃ paramātmārthayajānāt samyaṅ na bhūto na bhaviṣyatiśuddhaṃ vā śaktirahitaṃ kevalaṃ saktisaṃyutamprātarutthāya manasā lalāṭe bhasma lepayettadgrāmaṃ tu bahirgatvā viṇmūtraṃ ca visarjayetsnānaṃ ca darpaṇaṃ kṛtvā prāṅmukho vedikaṃ caretuttarābhimukho bhūtvā śaivasandhikramaṃ caretvastraśuddhiṃ taḥ kṛtvā ekākṣarīti mantrataḥvibhūtiṃ vāmahastena savyahaste'bhimantrayetdigbandhanaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā astramantra manusmaranmūrddhi caiva lalāṭe ca karṇe karṇe tathaiva caniṣkaniṣkārthakaṃ caiva niṣkadvayadvayārdhakamrudrasaṃdhyāsu sandhyeṣu brahmāṅgāni prakalpayetpūrvamevāṅgulinyāsa aṅganyāsaṃ ca kalpayetāpośanārghyamantreṇa pūrvamantratrayānnyasettarpaṇaṃ rudrasaṃkhyāta brahmāṅgainai mantrataḥpādaprakṣālanaṃ kṛtvā grahārāme śivālayenavahastaṃ saptahastaṃ pañcahasta trahastakammārjanaṃ prokṣaṇaṃ caiva gomayenānulepayettadūrdhve nirmikāṃ cādya ūrdhva pīṭhe tu paścimevastradhāraṃ ca vastraṃ ca puṣpādhārasamanvitamrudrākṣaṃ ca pravālaṃ ca muktāmālāsamanvitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: chidravastrasamāyuktaṃ cchitrābharaṇaśobhitamgandhapātrasamāyuktaṃ puṣpapātrasamanvitamsthalikā sthalikādharaṃ pāniyādhārapātrakamgandhaṃ ca dhūpadīpaṃ ca ārātrikamadhaḥ paramtīrthapātrasamāyuktaṃ mājyasthālīṃ ca sṛk sṛvamvrihi carmaṃ ca darvīṃ ca kāṣṭhā tripādasaṃyutampātraṃ saṃpādyamevoktaṃ dravyasaṃpādyamucyatehīmatoyaṃ kṛṣṇagandhaṃ goracanamatha dvayamkaṅkaṇaṃ lambamālā ca bilvadūrvākṣataṃ tathāpādyadravyādisaṃyuktaṃ dhūpadravyādisaṃyutampañcagavyāmṛtaṃ caiva nālikeraṃ prayatnataḥvastracinnāni vividhaṃ vastrantu prayatnataḥāvṛtaṃ saptanāliṃ vā pañcanālaikanālakamyedheṣṭaṃ goghṛte caiva vṛkṣabījamatailakamlavaṇakramavatvaṃ ca vyañjanairupadaṃśakaḥkramukasya phalaṃ caiva patraṃ ca śvetacūrṇakamāsanaṃ darbhadāruṃ ca sāraṅgaiścarmameva caāsanaṃ kalpayeddhīmān arcanākramamucyatebhasmasnānaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā pūrvoktavidhinā sahāprāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā bhūtaśuddhikramaṃ caretamṛtāplāvanaṃ kṛtvā karanyāsāṃguliṃ nyasetśivahastaṃ tu saṃkalpya hṛtpadme'rcayecchivamātmaśuddhiriti proktaṃ saurādipūjakaṃ śṛṇupūrvāśābhimukhaṃ prāpya lekhayedravimaṇḍalaṃudityaṃ jātamantreṇa pātre tu jalapūrite
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dakṣapāṇi talethārya darśanārghyaṃ tu secayetprabhūtāsana saṅkalpya vimalau saurameva cadīptāti sarvatomukhyā arkāsana khaṣolkakabindunādasamāyuktam anantaṃ rudra saṃyutamnamottaṃ sūryamuccārya saurasaṃpūjanaṃ kurudvinetraṃ cāruvadanaṃ raktamālānulepanamabhayaṃ varadopetaṃ prabhāmaṇḍalamaṇḍitampadmasthaṃ vā rathārohamaruṇena samanvitamsomāṅgārakasaumyāśca guruśukraśanaiścarānkṣīrānna dāpayet paścād dhūpadīpādikaṃ dadetpādaprakṣālanaṃ kṛtvā devāgre maṇḍalaṃ kuruṣoḍaśāṅgulamāyāmaṃ caturaśrasamanvitamsthānaśuddhiṃ ca kartavyaṃ bhūmirbhūmneti mantrataḥdevasya dakṣiṇe pārśve yatheṣṭaṃ mānasaṃ nyasetbhasmanyāsaṃ karanyāsaṃ aṅganyāsaṃ tu kārayetathavā pātramekaṃ tu pādyamācamanārghyakamtripādūrdhve sthitaṃ śaṅkhamavakuṇḍanamācaretsavyahastābhimantreṇa śivagāyatrikaṃ japetśaṅkhamūlaṃ dddharādevi mrakṣāṇāṃ viṣṇudevatammukhe ca saptatīrthāni praveśeccandradevatāvṛttamādhāraśaktiśca ityete adhidevatāvṛṣeśvaraṃ tathā pūrve vṛṣavāme tu bhāskaregaṇeśe nai-ṛte deśe tadvāme kamalodbhavesaumye tu nṛttamūrtiṃ ca īśāne kṣetrapālakamsomaśaṅkarayormadhye bhaktādīnvinyaset kramāt

sanskrit: ekākṣaryā ca vāme tu lakulīśaṃ tu vinyasetpaścimadvāramastreṇa prokṣaye tu śivāmbhasāmadhyame tu mahālakṣmīṃ nandigaṅganaṃ ca dakṣiṇeūrdhvādha saṃprapūjyātha śivāstraṃ suprapūjayetdvārapaścimamevaṃ tu naivedyaṃ pūrvavaktrakearghyodakena saṃprokṣya vaktrannyāsaṃ samācaretkaniṣṭhānāmikāmadhye navapuṣpaṃ tu saṃgrahetvisarjanasya tatkāle puṣpa mūrdhni ca vinyasetśuddhatoyābhiṣekaṃ ca astraṃ pāśupataṃ japetgurūpadeśaṃ vijñeyaṃ mantraśuddhirudāhṛtamabhyaṅgaṃ tu tataḥ kṛtvā śuddhatoyābhiṣecanamśuddhatoyābhiṣekaṃ ca puṣpaṃ mūrdhni ca vinyasetastramantramanusmṛtya puṣpamūrddhni tu vinyasetikṣusāraṃ tu śuddhodaṃ gandhatoyābhiṣecanamśuklavastreṇa saṃmṛjya puṣpamūrdhni tu vinyasetpañcāsanaṃ samabhyarcya uparyupari vinyasetkarṇikāyai namaśceti bijebhyo san ityapipīṭhe manonmani nyastvā śuddhasphaṭikasannibhamsadyojātavāmamaghorāśca puruṣeśānameva capaścime cottare yāmye pūrva īśāna eva cavāmīnīlī ca pāśāṅgī khaḍginīrjambīnī tathāananteśaśca sūkṣmaśca śivottaṃścaikanetrakambhūmisvāhā svadhākāntapuṣṭi kīrtimeyavivṛṣanandigaṇeśāśca mahākālaguhau tathābhadrā ca kundali caiva bhṛṅgiṇi patini tathā
