sanskrit: gaṇeśāvaraṇaṃ proktaṃ svanāmnairarcayet kramātkubera īśaviṣṇu ca pitāmahyeśameva cabhogini ghośaśaktaiśca gambhiṇī harṣaṇi tathāvajraṃ śaktiṃ ca daṇḍaṃ ca khaḍgaṃ pāśaṃ dhvajaṃ tathāprasannātmā ca kopa * guṇātmikomalātminiastreśāvaraṇaṃ proktaṃ prakrameṇaivamarcayetgandhapuṣpaṃ ca makuṭaṃ kaṅkaṇalambamālyakamsvarṇaratna vicitreṇa svarṇamālavibhūṣaṇamvaruṇe caiva kālākhyaṃ uttare tu kalākhyakamyogāsanaṃ tataḥ proktaṃ tanmadhye cārcayecchivamgomayālepanaṃ kṛtvā devāgre maṇḍalaṃ nyasetsthālikābhālanaṃ kṛtvā naivedyaṃ ca prapūrayetphalādigulasaṃyuktaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi ca madhyamenaivedyotthāpane mārge mārjanaṃ prokṣaṇaṃ kuruprokṣaṇaṃ cāstramantreṇa tālatrayamatho * *āpośanārghyakaṃ datvā hastaprakṣālanaṃ kurutatpuṣpaṃ tu visṛjyātha hastayokṣālanādikammaheśapratimādīnāṃ naivedyaṃ hṛdayena tuśeṣanirmālya sarvāśca aiśānye tu visarjayetkarodvartanamevoktaṃ mukhavāsaṃ tu vinyasetnityāgni yajanaṃ kṛtvā antarbalisamācaretbhasma darpaṇakacchatraṃ cāmaraṃ tālavṛntakamkaniṣṭhānāmikāmadhye puṣpaṃ saṅgṛhya buddhimānpracchinnapaṭamucchādya mūlamantramanusmaranvidyāpīṭhaṃ samabhyarcya pradakṣiṇa namaskṛtam

sanskrit: culukodakaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā arghyaṃ vaisarjayed guruḥpūrvavatsadanaṃ kṛtvā mūlaliṅgādi saṅgrahetpūjāparyuṣitadravyaiḥ caṇḍeśaṃ ca samarcayetdhūpadīpādikaṃ datvā argha visarjayedguruḥevaṃ dine dine pūjya arcayet pūrvavat kramātsaṃyutaṃ comayā devamekāsanagataṃ caretpṛthagve sthāpito devo māṃ ca sthāpitaṃ pṛthakekapīṭhasthitā vāpi pīṭhādanyasthitā tu nāmanyeṣāṃ caiva mūrtināṃ vāmapārśve tu kalpitāmdevasya bāhumātreṇa devi yuktyā tu kalpitāmmūlaṃ tu niṣkalādevamāvāhya kṣaṇiketanaḥmūladeśe tu saṃyojya devi snānāntaraṃ viśetgarbhe tu sthāpitā devī paryaṅkadyaiśca sthāpiteanenātropacāreṇa rātrau pūjāvasānakesarvālaṅkārasaṃyuktaṃ sarvatodyasamanvitamdevīṃ devagṛhadvāre gandhapuṣpādibhiryajetdevasya dakṣiṇe pārśve devyāsanaṃ prakalpayetpaścānirājanaṃ kṛtvā sarvālaṅkārasaṃyutamaruṇodayavelāyāṃ devyāsthānaṃ samācaretyapradhānatvamārgeṇa pratiṣṭhāṃ kuru mandireevaṃ mārgavidhā proktaṃ tasyāstu bahudhā śṛṇuevaṃ tu pañcadhā jñeyā kārayellakṣaṇānvitamlakṣaṇokta krameṇaiva trikarādi viśeṣataḥprāsādasyaiśadigbhāge pāvake vāruṇe tathāpañcaprākāramārgeṇa mūlārthaṃ ca na kārayet

sanskrit: daivike cārṣake caiva kramaṃ samyagvidhīyategrāmādīnāṃ tu bāhye tu kuryātsaṅkaramiśrakammūlaliṅgapramāṇena vīraṃ kuryād viśeṣataḥliṅgasya nāhamānena yogaṃ samyag vidhiyateathavā garbhamānena mūladhāmādi mānakaiḥnavāṅgulāt samārabhya dvitryaṅgulavivarddhanāttasmādvyaṅgulādhikyaṃ navadhā tuṅgamucyateevaṃ tu navadhā tuṅgaṃ uttamādini bhedataḥpīnonnata śanāṃ caiva kaṃbūgrīvāṃ sulocanāmsiṃhāsanasthitāṃ vāpi sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāmyādṛśaṃ mūlabimbaṃ ca tādṛśaṃ vaktramucyatesukhāsanādi bimbānāṃ tasya tasya pramāṇataḥmātroṅgulena vā kuryāt pūrvoktenaiva saṅkhyayāsaṅkaraṃ raudrakaṃ vakṣye svatantraṃ ca viśeṣataḥanye manorame deśe taṭākādistu pārśvaketrihastādyairviśeṣeṇa ekabhūmyādikādiṣusthāpayet saṅkaraṃ raudraṃ dvibhujaṃ vā caturbhujampaścimābhimukhaṃ vāpi dakṣinābhimukhaṃ vināśailaṃ ca lohacitrāṃ ca kuryāt tāṃ ca viśeṣataḥtasyāstu dakṣiṇe bhāge śambhuṃ kuryād vicakṣaṇaḥdevyāstu pāvake vāpi purastād dakṣiṇe'pi vāpaścimānanakaṃ cokṣaṃ pūrvānanaṃ tathottaramśaṅkarasya pratiṣṭho yā pārśvayorvā sthitaṃ bhavetsthānakaṃ cāsanaṃ vāpi mūṣikopari cāthavādevyāstu śaṅkare deśe pūrve vā cottare'pi vā

sanskrit: tasya prakārakānte tu pūrve vā caiśake'pi vāsthāpana kṣetrapālaṃ vā bāhye cābhyantare'pi vāśivavat parivārāṇāṃ prāsadasyāgrato'pi vāsukhāsanādi bimbeṣu bāhye cābhyantare'pi vālohajādyairviśeṣeṇa kuryādvā citrakādibhiḥgrāmādi sthāpanaṃ vāpi parvate ca vane'pi vāgrāmadasyānanaścātha yathā pṛṣṭhaṃ tathā kuruyajamānānurūpeṇa kuryāt sarvaṃ viśeṣataḥmandire sthāpanaṃ śaṃbhuṃ sakalaṃ miśra * * lamcaturbhujaṃ ṣaḍbhujaṃ vā aṣṭaudaśabhujaṃ tu vāvināyakaṃ tathā durgāṃ śaṅkaraṃ savṛṣaṃ yadiathavānyaprakāreṇa vakṣyate gauri bhedakamūrdhvajānusthite gulphe hastau jaścasthitoparivṛṣabhaṃ ca samīpe tu sthitaṃ vā śayanaṃ tu vātayostu purataḥ samyak durgāṃ vātha sarasvatimsamībāhya samīpe vā bāhye vā kṣetrapālakamutsavapratimaṃ kuryādvibhujāṃ ca svarūpakam* * * * * * * * raudramevaṃ vidhiyyateudgato jānusaṃyukto pādau pṛṣṭhaṃ sa bhūmikekṛttikā sthāpayet samyag ambikānāma bhāvayetpaścimevāpi kartavyaṃ kalpayet sakalaṃ viduḥbimbānāparitaścaiva kīrtitāsthanakasya tudevyāstathaiva digbhāge vighneśaṃ yadi saṃbhavetdevyāstu purato bhāge ubhayorvā viśeṣataḥanyeṣāṃ ca nirikṣyante tiryagamanameva vā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kṣetreśaṃ ca mahāpīṭhaṃ parito parivārakamevameva prakāreṇa kuryād bahuvidhānataḥratnanyāsaṃ tadādau tu pratyekaṃ mūladeśakelojahajādiṣu bimbeṣu netrotmīlanapūrvakamathavā bhūpradeśe tu navaratnādi kṣipetśāstu sthāpanamārgeṇa śāstośca sthāpanaṃ kurumiśraliṅgavidhānena miśreśaṃ sthāpayet kramātkuryādiha viśeṣeṇa kṣetreśaṃ tasya mārgataḥpūrvoktena vidhānena kuryāt saṃkara raudrayoḥuttarāyaṇakāle tu śuklapakṣe śubhe dineśubhavāre sthire lagne śubhāṃśe sumuhūrtakeprāsādādyasya rūpeṇa mānaṃ kuryāt tu śaktikamvāhanāni ca cinnāni āsanādi tathā budhānprāsādasyāgrataḥ kuryānmaṇḍapaṃ catuśrakamṣaṭsapta vasu hastā vā randhrahastamathāpi vānavabhāgaika bhāge tu madhye vedī prakalpayetgomaye lepanaṃ kṛtvā staṇḍiloddhe parinnyasetśaktyāstu vedikābāhye sthāpanaṃ sthānavedikāastamātra samutsetho stasyāstasya caturdaśipradhānaśaktidurgāyāṃ yonyākārāṇi kārayetjalādhivāsanaṃ kuryāt dakṣi mokṣavasānakedarbhamālābhirāveṣṭya vāmādi śaktikānnyasetsarvālaṅkārasaṃyuktaṃ vāhanādiṣu buddhimānkūrcayuktaṃ viśeṣeṇa jalamadhye niveśayetdivasārddhaṃ ntarddhaṃ vā tadarddhardhamathāpi vā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pañcagavyena saṃsnāpya pratyekaṃ tu viśeṣataḥmadhyādīśānaparyantaṃ varddhanīśca nyasedbudhaḥāryādiśaktayassarve varddhanīṣu nyaset kramātyājñikaistarubhiḥ kuryātsarvaḥ suca viśeṣataḥtilasarṣapanīṣpāvagulamekādaśaṃ tathādravyānte vyahṛtīṃ hutvābimba kūrcena saṃspṛśetśaktiktaiśca deśikānujñāṃ kuryātsarve ca deśikāḥādyāvante ca sarvatra puṇyāhaṃ vācayedbudhaḥevaṃ jāgaraṇaṃ ratrau prabhāte snānamācaretśayanādbimbamuddhṛtya bimbādanyat samarpaṇamghṛtaśirorpaṇaṃ kuryāt pratyekaṃ ca viśeṣataḥāryādi bhagavatyantaṃ tasyāṃ vai vinyased budhaḥevameva prakāreṇa kuryād vai śaṅkarādiṣudarpaṇeṣvabhiṣekaṃ syāt tat tanmūle mahāmbikegobhūmikāṃ ca nādyaiśca pūjayet tu pṛthak pṛthakante mahotsavaṃ kuryāt calaṃ caiva viśeṣataḥanuktāni ca sarvāṇi kuryāt tat tadvidhānataḥbrahmāviṣṇuśca rudraśca trimūrttiriti kathyatetasmāskandaṃ tathā durgāsaptamurtiriti smṛtamvighneśaṃ ca tathā cāryāśāstuścaiva viśeṣataḥpañcamūrtiriti jñeyā sadāvijaya vaddhanamekamūrtisthitā sarve ṣaṇmūrtiriti cocyatetantu saṅkara saṃjñeyaṃ sarvaprāṇihitaṃ bhavetanyathā yadi kuryācced grāmādenna śatadhṛvamteṣu teṣu ca bhedeṣu harirvā yadi saṃbhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bauddhādiṣu ca bhedeṣu śeṣu āsnādeścaiva mūrttayaḥpaścimānana viṣṇostu śaktyādīnāṃ tu deśikaḥvaighānase pāñcarātreḥ kuryādasminviśeṣataḥśaivabhedamiti proktaṃ śuddhaśaivastu tāṇḍavaḥśaivādanyāt samāyāti kuryadajñāna pūjitāarcanāyāgahīne tu cirakālaṃ viśeṣataḥgrāmāniṣṭabhayaṃ caiva sarvasatravivarddhanaṃdaśasaṃvatsarādūrdhvaṃ pūjāhīnaṃ hi saṃbhavetsthāpanoktakrameṇātha pratiṣṭhāṃ samyagārabhetsphoṭakaṃ tvatha jīrṇaṃ vā ekāṅgaṃ sakalāṅgakamprāsādaṃ taccharīraṃ syāt tasmāsthāṇuṃ na tiṣṭhatigauripradhānaṃ vā kaścid vighneśasya pradhānakaiśastu pradhānataḥ kaścit kaścit jyoti pradhānakekaścid viṣṇupradhānaṃ tu śaṅkarasya pradhānakamsaptamūrti saptadhā cāṣṭaṃ navamūrtirdūśaiva capradhānaṃ pāssamīpe tu pūrvoktāni ca devatāetāni sarvabhedāni kuryādasmit viśeṣataḥgauryāstu sthāpanaṃ proktaṃ śaivabhedaṃ śṛṇuṣvadhāsarvalokahitārthāya sarvopadravināśanammūlaliṅgasya śobhārthaṃ līlārthaṃ vā viśeṣataḥpāvake nai-ṛte caiva vesaraṃ kalpayed budhaḥmadhyamasya tu hārāyā manto bāhyaṃ na kārayetmālikākāramevaṃ syād brāhmaṇādi krameṇa tuprakārabhittibāhye vā bhyantare vā viśeṣataḥsūtrabandhau tu kartavyaṃ śatrunāśanam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yajamānāya tadedāṣaṃ sarvathā tu na kārayetnavahastātsamārabhya viṃśaddhastaṃ tameva capañcahastāt samārabhya pañcadaśakarāntakamtrihastaṃ tu samārabhya rudrahastāntameva cavistāradviguṇotsedhaṃ pādo na tu tadarthakamprāsādaparitaḥ kuryāt samīpe tathaiva caagramaṇḍapabāhye tu nṛttamaṇḍapamucyateśilpaśāstroktamārgeṇa pīṭhaṃ kuryāt salakṣaṇaṃsvayamudbhūtaliṅgasya daivikārṣayakorapipauruṣasya tu liṅgasya dhāmaṃ gartena kārayetpādaṃ vāpi prakartavyaṃ mutsedhaṃ pūrvavadbhavetpauruṣasya tu liṅgasya dhāmaṅgattena kārayetsvayamudbhūtaliṅgasya ālayañcāṣṭadikṣvapisauvarṇādyairviśeṣeṇa kārayet cchayanāṅganāmteṣāmabhāve bhittau tu nidrāśaktiṃ ca kārayettasmāt sarvaprayatnena śayanārthaṃ manonmanipañcāśad dvyaṅguṇenaiva kārayeduttamaṃ budhaḥekatraṃśāṅgulārabhya aśvanyagula hīnakammātrāṅgulena vā kuryād yajamānāṅgulena vāmūlaliṅgasamaṃ dairghyaṃ muttamāmānamiṣyatepratyekaṃ navamānaṃ syād uttamādi trayatrayampratyekaṃ navamānaṃ syāt pūjāṃśaṃ sadṛśaṃ kurutayormadhye'ṣṭabhāge tu pratyekaṃ navamānakamuttamaṃ madhyamaṃ caiva adhamañceti kathyateekāśādhikamānena uttamaṃ dīrghamucyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pratyekaṃ narmamānasyāt karṇamānaṃ tathaiva caliṅgamānādibhirmānairmānaiḥ kuryāt tu tāṃ pratiuttamaṃ madhyamaṃ caiva adhamaṃ tu tridhā punaḥpañcāṃśamuttamaṃ vidyātriyaṃśaṃ kannyasaṃ bhavetpratyekaṃ navamānaṃ syādvārastambho viśeṣataḥekaika tuṅgamānaṃ syānnavadhā bhedamucyateuttamaṃ mānamākhyātaṃ tayormadhye'ṣṭa bhājitesvāyambhuvādiliṅgānāṃ pūjāṃśaṃ dviguṇocchrayammadhyamaṃ dviguṇaṃ dairghyaṃ tatsamaṃ dairghyamucyatepūjāṃśaṃ navadhā bhajya ekaikaṃ mānamucyatetasmāt triyaṃśamadhityamuttamottamamucyateadhamaṃ mānamevoktaṃ kṣudraliṅgasya cocyateteṣu mukhyā navāṃśasyāccheṣāṃśaṃ kanyasatrayamdviguṇaṃ madhyamaṃ caiva triguṇaṃ cottamaṃ smṛtamviṣkabhaṃ triguṇaṃ tuṅgaṃ dviguṇaṃ tatsamaṃ tu vāliṅgasya karṇamānena pūrvavat prārabhetsudhiḥāyavyaya kṣavārāṣṭau yonyaṃśakaśubhaṃ nayetsaśaktyaissarva saṃpatyai rājārāṣṭrābhivardhayeniścitya pārvatituṅgaṃ mānāṃ śūlena bhajayetbhānunāḍi hṛde samyak śeṣamāyādikaṃ bhavetaṣṭābhivṛddhite tacca saptaviṃśatibhūṣitenavabhivṛddhitaṃ caiva saptabhirbhājayed budhaḥnavabhistu hade tatra śeṣamaṃśakamādiśetāyādhikyaṃ śubhaṃ vidyād vyayādhikyamaśobhanamevaṃ prakāramārgeṇa pīṭhotsadhaṃ tu dakṣiṇe
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pratikulaṃ na kartavyaṃ anukūlācchuśubhaṃ bhavetlakṣayet ṣaṭśubhaṃ samyag yathā tatra na kārayetvedhaṃ rajjuṃ ca rāśīṃ ca vaśyaṃ rāśyādhipaṃ tathāyajamānasya rakṣeṇa śubhāśubhaṃ parikṣayetśubhahinaṃ vyayadhityaṃ sā gauri sarvadoṣadāanyathā kārayed bimbaṃ rājā rāṣṭraṃ viniśyatiidamanyaprakāreṇa viśeṣaṃ cocyate mayātāni bhāgāni saṃgaṇya dvādaśena tu daṇḍayetṣoḍaśairguṇitaṃ kṛtvā tāni bhāgāni pūrvavatprāptotsedhasya mānaṃ tu ekonatriṃśadaṅgulamtāni sarvāṇi saṃhṛtya saptabhiḥ śeṣakaṃ vyayamśeṣo vyaya iti khyāto vyayahīnaṃ śubhaṃ bhavettāni bhāgāni gaṇayedvāreṇa matimānnaraḥgaṇayeddaśabhistāni saptaviṃśatibhirhṛdeutsedhaṃ bhūmibhirgaṇyaṃ tāni cāṣṭāni vardhayetbhānitāni ca saṅgaṇya dvādaśena viśeṣataḥāvartto setthamānaṃ tu turbhiguṇayet kramātāstot sedhasya bhāgāni guṇena guṇitaṃ yathāpūrvoktavidhimārgeṇa śubhāśubhaṃ hi lakṣayetāyādhikye vyayāhīne mānaṃ tatsamapātpadamtasmāt sarvaprayatnena āyādhikhyena yojayetnakṣatrādhipati candraḥ tasmāt prādhānyakaṃ śubhamevaṃ bahuprakāreṇa kārayed deśikottamaḥpradhāmārambhakāle tu śubhāśubhaṃ vicārayetgṛhitotsethamānaṃ tu pañcāṃśaṃ bhājayet tataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: triyaṃśe kāṃśamutsethaṃ ṣaḍidhaṃ pīṭhikocchrayamcaturguṇa navā kuryāt pañcāṅgaṃ sahitaṃ punaḥtena rūpeṇa mārgeṇa nyastvā saṅgrāhyayedbudhaḥsumuhūrtte sulagne tu pratimārambhayet sudhiyena dravyeṇa nirmāṇaṃ tena dravyeṇa kārayetstatbimba sthāpayenmohāt pūjānāśamavāpnuyātsthānāntaravidhānena kṣepayet pratimaṃ budhaḥdevānāṃ tu kṛtā lohaṃ sāṅgopāṅgaṃ viśeṣataḥdravyanāmaṃ na kuryāt tu dravyanāmaṃ na lepayetevaṃ vai dānavādīnāṃ cchatrādīnāṃ tathaiva caloke tu kalahaṃ rūpaṃ saṃbhrāntaṃ sakṛtaṃ yadiloke mānuṣarūpaṃ syāt rtyāmyā yadi bandhavāḥpurāṇānnijabimbaṃ ca punaṃ sandhānamācaretśilārūpaṃ na kartavyaṃ kartavyaṃ doṣadaṃ bhavetmadhyamaṃ daśatālena nindrārūpaṃ hi kārayettrayodaśāṅgulaṃ vaktraṃ arddhāṅgulagalasmṛtammukhadvayamiti proktaṃ ūrumāna mukhadvayambhāgaṃ pādatalaṃ proktaṃ pūrvoktena tu vistaramaṅgule nābhivāme tu gulpavāme dvayaṅgulamtanmadhye dvividhaṃ proktaṃmagramarddhayavaṃ smṛtamyavaṃ kinīnikāyāmaṃ vistāraṃ ca tathaiva cakarṇayormadhyame pṛṣṭhe dvādaśāṅgulavismṛtāmkeśāntaṃ carbhapaścāntaṃ dvayaṅgulaṃ dvayavādhikamkṛṣṇāni pakṣmaromāṇi prāhunnavati saṅkhyayādvayavaṃ tu bhruvormadhye padameṃ munipuṅgavā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: triyaṅgulaṃ tu vistāraṃ bhrūvocchrāyoryavadvayamevamevocchrayaṃ kuryādvistārasya tathaiva catilaprasūnamānaṃ syāt darddhaikadvayahatrikamādhārāntaṃ puṭaṃ sūtraṃ yavopetadvimātrakamvistāraṃ cottaroṣṭhasyāḥ yavatritiyamiṣyateyavārdhaṃ gojinimbaṃ syādutsedhaṃ tu caturthavamvistāramadharoṣṭasyā vidyumātrayavādhikamardhādhikaṃ yavaṃ proktaṃ madharasya tu pālikāharestasyonnati vidyāt ṣaḍavyaṃ darśanā na tuadho dantastadhāṣṭāṃśaṃ hi na mūrdhe tu ṣoḍaśātrimātraṃ hyanukramaṃ kuryād dviyavatrayamunnatibhavyasohanuvra * syādekamātraṃ dviyaṃtitiūrdhvaṃ padmabhruvormadhye yavādhikayavatrayamdviyavaṃ karṇapālyaṃ tatsamaṃ karṇasya paṭṭikālakāra sadṛśaṃ karṇaṃ pūrvācāryeṇa bhāṣitampūrvau parau tu nālau tu svayameva vilambanauapāṅgātkarṇamūlāntaṃ saptamātrayavatrayampūrvakeśāntamuṣṇīṣātprabhṛtyāṣṭāṅgulaṃ bhavettrayodaśārdhamevaṃ syāt pṛṣṭhakeśāyavasmṛtaḥkukuṭā kaṭisandhiṃ syāt saptaviṃśatimātrakamsamaṇḍalasya vistāramupasthaṃ tu daśāṅgulamnavamātrārdhavistāraṃ caturaṅgulamudgamambhruvamūlāgravistāraṃ rekhātrayasamanvitamhikkā sūtrādi kakṣāntaṃ daśamātrārdhamiṣyatehikkasūtropari skandhagrīvamūlād bhujo vidhi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhujayāmā tathā mātraṃ korparasya tramātrakamardhārdhamardhamātrārdhaṃ madhyamāṅgulamiṣyateardhādhika caturmātrāt kaniṣṭhāṅguṣṭhayorvidavistāraṃ bāhumātraṃ syāt tathā vai kārayed budhaḥprakoṣṭhasya tu mūlaṃ syādardhamātraṃ yavādhikamvistāre maṇibandhasya caturmātraṃ tu ṣaḍyavamadhyardhamadhikaṃ kṛtvā pariṇāhaṃ vidurbudhaḥanāmikāgra saṃvidyāt kaniṣṭhāmūlavistaramagraparvārdhamāyāmaṃ vistāraṃ navamiṣyatetalarekhātayogena madhye vai padmaśaṅkhakamsthanaṃ hikakāntaraṃ sārdhatrayodaśāṅgulannibhamstanamaṇḍalavistāraṃ navamātraṃ prakīrtitamcūcukaṃ dviyavardhoccaṃ vyālaṃ kolakamaṇḍalampañcārdhadviyavaisārdhaṃ nimnabhāgai prakīrtitamśroṇipradeśavipulaṃ saptadaśyāṅgulaṃ bhavetyonimūlasyavistāraṃ pañcāṅgulamiti smṛtamsthānakṣaprabhṛtaiḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ kakṣātpañcadaśāṅgulamaṣṭādaśāhamātraṃ syāt śroṇideśasya vistaramdaśamātrārdhamātrasyājjānumadhyayavādhikamnavamākaṃ bhavedagrāṇmātraṃ trivayavādhikampāṣṇīvistārakot sedham udayaṃ tatsamaṃ viduḥanuktaṃ yadbhavet kiñcit śilpiśāstroktamārgataḥlohaśailaṃ na kartavyaṃ lohe lohasamaṃ tathāmiṇmaye bhitticitre tu sauvarṇādyaiśca kārayetdakṣiṇenotpalaṃ hastaṃ vāmahastaṃ pralambitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: uttamaṃ caturaṅgulyaṃ dīrghamaṣṭāṅgulaṃ bhavetpadmāsanasthitāṃ devīṃ bālacandra prabhūṣitāmevameva vidhānena kārayecchayanāmbikāmpañcamānasamāyuktaṃ kārayet pārvati śubhāmadhikaṃ caiva hīnaṃ ca varjayet tu prayatnataḥāyādi ṣaṭśubhaṃ samyak kuryād devimamānakheadūṣādyastu liṅgāde liṅgānāṃ sarvalakṣaṇamteṣāmārabdhakāle tu nakṣatrādīni lakṣayetevameva vidhānena sarvamāneṣṭhakalpayetāgneryāṃ putradaṃ kuryādyāmya saubhāgya siddhidamvāyavyāṃ dhanadaṃ kuryāt some sūnuvivardhanampaścimadvārahamye tu āgneryāṃ vā saśaṅkareprākdvārasya tu liṅgasya tasya dakṣiṇa bhāgikemūlaprāsādavadvāramathavā cottarānanamdevatāsthāpanaṃ caiva iṣaścet sūnunālayamprāsādasya pramāṇena prajāvṛdhyartha kāraṇammūlabimbapramāṇena nāriṇāmabhivṛddhayetmātrāṅgulavidhānena nṛparāṣṭrābhivṛddhayetevamuktaprakāreṇa anyeṣāmapi kārayetparisamāptau vasyetatasya samakkratena tuśilādiṣu yatheṣṭaṃ syādaṅgalepaṃ na kārayetśubhau pa saṃlakṣya paścādbimba paścāt pratiṣṭhayetevaṃ vidhaprakāreṇa bahumārgeṇa kārayetdharmārthaṃ kāmamokṣārthaṃ śāntikaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ tathāgrāmavṛddhikaraṃ proktaṃ sarvopahati naśyati
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: triyahaṃ bhauvanaṃ proktaṃ ādiśaiva praśasyateādityahastamityuktamaṣṭamyaṃ tu caturdaśinavāhamuttamaṃ proktaṃ saptāhaṃ madhyamaṃ bhavetekāhaṃ roganāśārthaṃ evaṃ jñātvā tu buddhimānkṣīrābhiṣekaṃ kṛtvā tu tasmāt kautuka bandhanamprātasnātvā śucirbhūtvā deśikaṃ śiṣyameva cajalabhāṇḍavardhanīkumbhān kalaśaṃ puṣpapātrakampāṭālisadṛśākāraṃ sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutamdarbhāsanopari sthitvā kavacenāvakuṇṭhayettāḍanaṃ huṃ phaṭḍatena spaṭnaṃ sadyamantrakaiḥvastrapūtena toyena jalabhāṇḍeṣu saṅgrahetelālavuṅgakarpūraṃ gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ jalaṃ grahetaṅganyāsakaranyāsantaryāgaṃ samācaretkumbhāśca vardhanīṃ caiva tantunāveṣayet tataḥratnajaṃ hastimāṃsa ca romanāḍi ca tantunāsnapanamaṇḍape madhye śālibhistaṇḍilaṃ kurusūtrāt sūtrantaraṃ tālaṃ madhye navapadaṃ gṛhetvasudvārasamāyuktaṃ tyajed gomayavāriṇāśālyārthataṇḍulaṃ proktaṃ tasyārthaṃ tu tilaṃ tathāsūtratāre tu kartavyaṃ darbhe puṣpai paristaretpūrvāgraṃ cottarāgraṃ ca padaṃ pratipadaṃ pratipādyamācamanaṃ cārghyaṃ kasturigandhatailakamprathamāvaraṇe caiva kalaśaṃ cāṣṭadikṣu camadhukāṃ kṣamāṃgulaṃ caiva uśiraṃ candanaṃ tathākalhāraśatapatraṃ ca mālatidroṇameva ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kadali panasaṃ caiva vairavaṃ sarṣapaṃ tathābrahmāviṣṇuharaṃ caiva hṛṣikeśastathaiva caprathamāvaraṇe caiva devapāṇisthalaṃ nyasetindrādilokapālaṃśca somāṅgārabṛhaspativasiṣṭhaṃ kāśyapaṃ caiva munibhi ṣoḍaśo bhavetdarbhairekādaśaiścaiva deśike hastakūrcakamvardhanīṃ ca navagrandhiṃ vistāraṃ tālamātrakaiḥpuṣpagandhai samabhyarcya svasvamantrābhidhānakamtasya paścimadigbhāge pañcagavyaṃ tu vinyasettripādi pañcakoṣṭhāni madhye pūrvedha dakṣiṇelājapuṣpatilaiścaiva randhrasūtreṣu yojayetkṣaraṃ tu madhyamasthāpya gomūtraṃ pūrvadeśakeuttare tu ghṛtaṃ sthāpya vanau ca madhusaṃsthitamaiśānye nālikeraṃ ca navadravyaṃ vidhīyategomayaṃ kuḍupaṃ caiva dadhirvai kuḍupatrayamguḍupaṃ tu madhuścaiva phalodakuḍupadvayamnavadravyeṇasaṅkhyāyamadhidevaṃ tataḥ śṛṇubhārgavaṃ tu marañcaiva bhāradvājena mudgalaḥpuṣpakūrcaṃ samabhyarcya svasva mantreṇa deśikaḥtat tan mantreṇa saṃpūjya daśamudrāṃ pradarśayetsāpidhānaṃ ca sarvatra astramantreṇa buddhimāngarbhagehaṃ praviśitvā deśikaścottarānanaḥsaṃpūjye mūlaliṅgaṃ tu liṅgaśuddhi śivāstrakaiḥpiṣṭāmalakaḍāridraṃ pratyekaṃ lepayedbudhaḥaṣṭatriṃśat kalānyāsaṃ makuṭādi kramānyaset
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prākṛtaṃ bhāvamutsṛjya ekacittena pūjayetmūlabrahmaṣaḍaṅgaiśca gandhatoyaiḥ prapūjayetvedādhyāyanaṃ viprāṇām ardhamaṇḍapamadhyameviprādīnāṃ caturvedimahāśaivāssadīkṣitāliṅgāyāmapi tat tulyamācāryāstu samācaretgavyaṃ pañcāmṛtaṃ caiva vyomavyāpiṃ samuccaretlambakūrcasamāyuktaṃ mūlabrahmaṣaḍaṅgakaiḥaṣṭapuṣpaṃ tisṛgandhiṃ saptasaṅkhyā nivedayetkalaśai pañcaviṃśatyā abhiṣekaṃ ca kārayetnānāpuṣperalaṅkṛtya arcanoktaṃ samarcayetśuddhānnaṃ caiva ityete pañcānnaṃ tu praśasyatetāmbūlaṃ darpaṇaṃ chatraṃ mukhavāsaṃ ca darśayetśaivāgniṃ ca pravakṣyāmi agnikāryoktamārgataḥhomadravyāṇi sarvāṇi sadyojātena homayetsarvaroganivṛtyarthaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradamevaṃ yaḥ pūjayed dhīmān sarvakāmaphalaṃ bhavetśailemṛddāru lohānāṃ pratimānāṃ viśeṣataḥnityārcanavihīne tu dviguṇaṃ cānyasandhikea māse tataḥ kuryāt snapanāddhomakarmaṇiṣāṇmāse ca vihīne ca snapanaṃ ca śatāṣṭakamsaṃvatsaravihīne ca prokṣaṇaṃ hi samācaretsthāpayitvā vidhānenā pūrvoktena krameṇa tubrāhmaṇāt bhojayet tatra sahasrāṣṭakasaṃyutamhīne saṃvatsarodhve tu dānavasthānamucyatecaturabde piśācānāṃ pañcabde rākṣasāśrayam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: trayatriṃśati varṣāntaṃ tadūrdhve lohavat kramātsthāpanādi krameṇaiva ratnādi śarakriyāḥete dvādaśa pratimā jalasaṃprokṣaṇā vidhimsarvāriṣṭavināśāya putrapautravivarddhanamuttarāyaṇake bhānau māghamāse vivarjayetśeṣamāsaṃ samārabhya āyuśrīkīrtivardhanamtrīṇyuttarāṇi puṣyaṃ ca brāhmaṇānāṃ hitāya vairohiṇyādityapauṣṇaṃ ca vaiśyasya pravidhīyatetritīyā pañcamī caiva saptamī daśamī tathārāśayaśca ravajyāstu ubhayaṃ madhyamī bhavetśuklassaumya gurorinduvārāśreṣṭhavidhīyateśubhagrahaṃ drakakāṇaṃ viśeṣeṇa dadhīyatedigdvādaśahastaṃ vā navahastāṣṭahastakamdaśatālāṣṭatālena stambhotsedhaṃ vidhīyatepañcahastaṃ trihastaṃ tu toraṇasyocchrayaṃ bhavetdaśāṣṭāṅgule mānena triśūlasyaucchrayaṃ bhavetvedīṃ kuryād viśeṣeṇa dvitritālocchrayaṃ bhavetyathāmanoramaṃ kuryādarpaṇodarasannibhamathavā ekamevaṃ tu yathāvibhavavistarampṛthak prākkuṇḍamārabhya pṛthak homasamārabhettrimekhalairalaṅkṛtya catustridvayaṃṅgulayatamaśvaddha patravadyonīṃ bhūtavedaguṇāṃṅgulamkuṇḍamadhye guṇāṅgulyaṃ kesarairaṣṭadalairyutamindrādīśānayormadhye vṛttaṃ pradhanakaṃ kurucakra īśānayormadhye vṛttaṃ kuṇḍaṃ viśeṣataḥ

sanskrit: navakuṇḍavidhānaṃ tu aśrādyaṣṭāśramantakamguṇakuṇḍavidhānaṃ tu caturaśraṃ vidhīyateekakuṇḍavidhāne tu śakre vā śaṅkare'pi vāanyeṣu prāṅmukho bhūtvā homamkuryādviśeṣaṇaḥgomayālepanaṃ kṛtvā pañcacūrṇairalaṅkṛtamratnimātrasamutsedhamayudhāni prakalpayetutsethasyārtha vistāramathavā caturaṅgulamgairikeraliked vidvān patmakaṃ cakralakṣaṇaṃevaṃ vidhiprakāreṇa kārayed deśikottamaḥnavāhe caiva saptāhe pañcāhe triyahe'pi vāmaṇḍape madhyame caiva sthaṇḍilaṃ kārayet tataḥdarbhai puṣpai paristīrya devaṃ tathaiva vinyasetsarvālaṅkārasaṃyuktaṃ sarvatodyasamanvitamtato jalāśayaṃ prāpya jalamadhye prapāṅkuruvastreṇa veṣṭayed devaṃ lambakūrcenasaṃyutamabhita kalaśānaṣṭau aṣṭavidyaiśvarāvṛtamekarātra dvirātraṃ vā trirātraṃ vā jaloṣitamcaturdaśaṃ tu nāḍī vā jaloṣitaṃ tu kārayetjalena sthāpitān kumbhān abhiṣekaṃ tu kārayetsarvālaṅkārasaṃyuktaṃ ānīyādyāyāgamaṇḍapepuṇyāhaṃ vācayet tatra pāvamā mudirayankautukaṃ bandhayed dhīmān pūrvoktavidhinā sahātadardhaistaṇḍulaścaiva tadardhaiśca tilairapiprathayai śayanaṃ kalpyā aṇḍajādyairanukramātupastharaṇasaṃyuktaṃ śayanaṃ pañca kalpayet

sanskrit: sakūrcaṃ vastrasaṃveṣṭya prākcchiraścorddhvavaktrakamgandhādibhiḥ samabhyarcya hṛdayena tu mantrataḥtasyai cottaradigbhāge vardhanīṃ caiva vinyasettattacchaktisamādāya tattad devīṃ samācaretphalapallavasaṃyuktaṃ sarvagandhasamāyutamtriṇetraṃ ca caturbāhuṃ bālendumakuṭojvalamsarvābharaṇasaṃyuktaṃ baddha padmāsanasthitamvarddhanyāṃ varddhanī bījaṃ dhyātvā caiva manonmanīmsarvābharaṇasaṃyuktāṃ dvau hastau padmasaṃyutāmvyaktāvyaktamahābāhuṃ nīlagrīva mahādyutiḥtrayakṣaṃ caturbhujaṃ caiva vyāghracarmāmbaraprabhumsarvalakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitamdivyāmbaradharaṃ devīṃ dvinetrā dvibhujojvalāmmadhyakṣāmavilāsāṃ ca raktotphalakarā śubhāmgrive maṅgalasūtreṇa sarvabhūṣaṇabhūṣitāmkumāraṃ manonmā kuryāt sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutamekāsanasamāsīnaṃ dvibhujā locanadvayamkumāraṃ ramaṇairyuktaṃ devasenāpatiṃ tathāṭaṅkahastasamāyuktaṃ nyaset kumbhasya madhyamenīlajīmūtasaṃkāśaṃ daṇḍahastaṃ trilocanamtat tad bījena mantreṇa tat tad bījaṃ supūjayetdroṇārthatoyasaṃpūrṇān sahaimān vastrasaṃyutāntat tan * ma * kai bibai pūjayet parameśvaramvedibāhye tu paritaḥ aṣṭamaṅgali vinyasetdaśāyudhāni paryantaṃ sve sve sthāneṣu vinyaset

sanskrit: pūrvādi somaparyantaṃ toraṇādīni pūjayetnandiścaiva mahākālo daṇḍimuṇḍitathaiva capūrvādīnāṃ caturdikṣu dvārakumbheṣu vinyasetpālikādinaparyantaṃ malaṅkṛtyaṃ viśeṣataḥpaścāt śivāgniṃ saṃsthāpya ādiśaiva śivadvijaḥutsavaṃ ca pratiṣṭhāṃ ca ādīśaivena kārayetnavasaṃskāramādyena pratyekaṃ pañcaviṃśatisamidhājya carūlājān sarṣapāśca yavātilānaśvaddhodumbaraplakṣo vaṭapūrvādidikṣu cabhūtāgniṃ vā guṇāgniṃ vā palāśenaiva homayetastramantra viśeṣeṇa pūrṇāhutimathācaretpratyekaṃ juhuyād dhīmān dīpyaṃ teṣu ca saṃspṛśettasmāt kuṇḍeṣu sarvatra nikṣipeddhṛdayena tusadyādi pañcamūrtināṃ pañcakuṇḍeṣu homayetsadyādīśānaparyantaṃ pañcāgnau pañcamūrtayaḥadhidevāsamabhyarcya svasvamantrerviśeṣataḥrātrāvevaṃ prakartavyaṃ muhūrte snānamācaretpaṭe vā bhitticitre vā ekahomasamācaretbimbānāṃ bahurūpāṇāṃ ācārya bahurūpakaḥuttamaṃ śataniṣkaṃ syānmadhyamaṃ tu tadarthakamviṃśanniṣkaṃ samārabhya daśaniṣkavasānakamnavaniṣkāt samārabhya guṇaniṣkavasānakamācāryādardharātraṃ tu sādhakasya tu dakṣiṇātadarddha mantra paktṝṇāṃ tasyārddhaṃ paricāraketgrāmapradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā kumbhāni ca viśeṣataḥ

sanskrit: snānaśvabhrasya pūrve tu sthāpana kramato nyasetsumuhūrte sulagne tu mantranyāsena buddhimānprabhūtahaviṣaṃ datvā tāmbūlaṃ ca hṛdā dadetgrāmapradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā sarvālaṅkārasaṃyutammahābhūtapraśamanaṃ parasena palāyanamakālamṛtyuśamanaṃ navagrahavināśanamcaturdaśyāmathāṣṭamyāṃ pakṣayorubhayorapinakṣatrayajanaṃ kuryāt sakalābhiṣṭasiddhayetanmadhye vedikāṃ kuryād guṇabhāgaikabhāgataḥniśibhadrasamāyuktaṃ nimnonnatavivarjitamturagaṃ vātha vṛṣabhaṃ kalpayedagrapārśvayoḥkailāsaṃ kalpayenmadhye śālipiṣṭamayena tucaturaṅgulamutsedhaṃ nimnonnatavivarjitambhānusaṅkhyā mahābjaṃ ca liṅgaṣaṇṇavati viduḥśuklavarṇakrameṇaiva kalpayet pūrvavartmanāniścitya divasātpūrve navame saptame'thavātatpūrvādini paritaḥ straṇādini vyapohya caastamātreṇa tanmūle paritaḥ ścaturaśrakamgandhādibhisamabhyarcya mūlamantreṇa suvratadaddhyodana baliṃ datvā vanadevāya tṛptayejapānte saṅgrahed vidvān bilvavṛkṣaṃ samūlakamsadyojātena saṃyojya mūlamūrtikriyānvitamphalaṃ vaktreṇa saṅgrāhyā īśāne kusumaṃ gṛhetsarvālaṅkārasaṃyuktaṃ svastisūktasamanvitamgomayālepanaṃ kṛtvā piṣṭacūrṇervicitrayet

sanskrit: vinyased bilvapatraṃ ca tat tan mantreṇa tu (kra)meṇa tuaṣṭāṅgulapramāṇena cchittvā paraśunā trayamrocanaṃ kuṅkumaṃ koṣṭhaṃ candanaṃ haricandanamhiriberasamāyuktaṃ himatoyena mardayetgṛhītvā navabhāṇḍe tu mukhaṃ vastreṇa bandhayetjaptvāṣṭottarasahasraṃ pāpabhakṣaṇamantrataḥtato maṇḍapamāsādya sakalikṛta vigrahaḥmaṇḍapaṃ pūjayed vidvān pūrvoktavidhinā sadātaṇḍulaiḥ tilalājaiśca darbhaiścaiva paristaretmaṇḍapasyottare pūrve paścime vā viśeṣataḥarghyasaṃpādayed vidvān pātraśuddhisamācaretdvibhāgaṃ śivarūpaṃ syāt ekabhāgena pārvatigandhapuṣpādinā spṛṣṭvā japtvā pūrvoktamantrataḥpūjayet karṇikāmadhye pārvati parameśvarauaśvinyāśleṣaparyantaṃ saptakānvindradeśakemāghādi sūrpaparyantaṃ saptakaṃ yāmyadeśakesaṅkalpyābhyarcya gandhādyaistat tat svanāmamantrataḥnivedayantu mudgānnaṃ lepayeccandanena tutato maṇḍapamāsādya maṇḍapādhipatinyajetmadhuratrayasaṃyuktaṃ pūrvāgraṃ kadali phalamśatamardhaṃ tadardhaṃ vā mūlenaiva hutaṃ carettataḥ saṃpūjya deveśamumādevisamanvitamparicārakamāhūya soṣṇīṣaṃ sottariyakampraviśya garbhagehaṃ tu snāpaye snapanārhaketato maṇḍapamāsādya sarvālaṅkārasaṃyutam

sanskrit: śirasā vāhayitvā tu pradakṣiṇamathācaretkailāsagirimabhyarcya pūjayed vṛsadaivatamnakṣatrātparitastāpya pūrvavat pūjayet kramātlakṣmī ca raktapadmaṃ ca saptamaṃ kṛttikādiṣupradoṣaṃ pṛthivi padmaṃ bhūpāṭalaṃ ca dakṣiṇerudraparṇi ca dūrvā ca anūrādhādi saptakeviṣṇukrānti sahasrābhat śraviṣṭhādiṣu saptakepāyasānna pradātavyamanūrādhādi saptakebhaktyā sarvopacāreṇa pūjayediṣṭa siddhayeācārya pūjayet tatra vastrahemāṅguliyakaiḥdvijādīnāṃ ca bhaktānāmannapānādikāṃ dadetmūlena śivamādāya yojayet svayamātmanitaccūrṇaṃ yajamānāya dāpayet tadvidhānataḥbhasmanā vātha saṃyojya santataṃ dhārayennaraḥnakṣatrayajanaṃ proktaṃ puṣpapūjāvidhi śṛṇuśivalokapradaṃ nityaṃ śivaprītikaraṃ śubhamprajāvṛddhikaraṃ puṇyaṃ bhogamokṣapradāyakamāśvine māsi cāśvarkṣe kārtike māsa kārttikemāghamāse magharkṣe tu phālgune māsicottaremūlarkṣe jyeṣṭhamāse tu āṣāḍhe cottarāḍhakenadyabdhivāpi kule vā nagāgre vā mahāvanebhūmi saṃśodhya vidhivat prapāṃ kṛtvā tu sundaramtadardhaṃ vā śataṃ vāpi tadardhārdhamathāpi vāratnajaiśca viśeṣeṇa pūjārthaṃ saṃprakalpayetyavādviśatasaṅkhyāntaṃ mṛlliṅgesyodayaṃ bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: caturviṃśāṅgulaṃ yāvad dārulīṅgaprakalpayetmāṣatrayaṃ samārabhya māṣaikena vivarddhanātkalpayet kṣaṇikaṃ liṅgaṃ yathākāmaṃ pramāṇakamliṅgayāme tu vedāṃśe ekāṅgaṃ liṅgavistṛtamliṅgayāme guṇāṃśeṃśaṃ tanmūle caturaśrakamsūtropetavihīnaṃ vā chatrakāraśironvitamekaliṅge'dhavā kuryāt sarvaliṅgaviśeṣataḥekāṃśaṃ pīṭhabandhaṃ syādekāṃśamarcanārhakampūjābhāgaṃ tribhāgaṃ syāt saptabhāge trikolakampūjāṃśodayatuṅgaṃ tu pañcaviṃśatibhātijesahasraliṅgamevaṃ hi ayutasya vidhi śṛṇucatvāriṃśeṃśa pañcāṃśaṃ kṛtvā liṅgayutaṃ bhavetekapañcādaśena liṅgapañcaśataṃ bhavetaṣṭottaraśataṃ liṅgaṃ paritaḥ saṃprakalpayetpañcaviṃśati liṅgasyātpañcāśadvibhaje satialpaliṅgasya tārārdhaṃ pādaṃ vāṣṭāṃśameva vātanmānamalpaliṅgasya mahāliṅgādvinirgataḥantarāla bhavelliṅgaṃ madhya saṅkalpayet kramātmahāliṅgaśiromānaṃ madha saṅkalpayet kramātliṅgānāmapi sarveṣāṃ sūtrahīnaṃ prakalpayetevaṃ lakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ liṅgaṃ saṅgrāhayed budhaḥniścitya divasātpūrva sāyānna samayed budhaḥprapāmaṇḍapamāviśyā bhūtaśuddhisamācaretliṅgasaṅkhya japenmūlaṃ yajamānasamanvitammaṇḍapasyottare pārśve śāyayet saikatopari
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mukhaṃ śuddhiṃ tataḥ kṛtvā ācamye deśikottamaḥyajamānasamopeto snānaṃ kṛtvā yathāvidhiḥprapāmaṇḍapamāviśya sakalikṛtavigrahaḥcaturdvārasamabhyarcya pūrveṇa vidhinā sahaprapāmaṇḍapamadhye vā paścime vāpicakṣaṇauparyastaraṇaṃ kalpya śuddhavastrādikairyathāpuṇyāhaṃ vacayet tatra pañcagavyamṛtaṃ tathāprakṣālya cāstramantreṇa pañcagavyamṛtādikaiḥtat tan mantreṇa cābhyarcya gandhapuṣpaṃ sudhūpakamnīlotpalairvā kalhārai patrairvā śvetapaṅkajaiḥratnairvā kanakairvātha kalpuraśakalena vāpūjārthamāhṛtaṃ puṣpaṃ saṅgṛhya śuddhapātrakeyajamānamadhābhūya saṃprokṣyādhyajalena caśivahastaṃ ca saṅkalpya yajamānasya mūrdhanīpūjārthamāhṛtaṃ puṣpaṃ śaṅkhadhvanisamanvitamaṅgaṃ pratidadetpuṣpaṃ tattanmatra samuccarantrihastaṃ vā tadarthaṃ vā sthalamānaṃ vyapohya catadbāhye vedikāmānaṃ saptatālasamunnatamtrimekhalayutaṃ vāpi dvimekhalayutaṃ tu vāsudhāyāsikataistatra pūraye śuddhavāriṇāpūrvavatpūjayed vidvān liṅgasya paritaḥ kramātmūlādi cāgraparyantaṃ pūjāmuktiphalapradamyajamānena cābhyarcya pūrvavad deśikottamaḥdhūpadīpaṃ tato datvā liṅgavaraṇamārgataḥgītanṛtyādikaṃ sarvaṃ liṅgasya paritaḥ kramāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: iṣṭabandhujane sārdhaṃ yajamānasamanvitamanena vidhimārgeṇa snātvā tadvārimaṇḍalemahāśāntivrata dṛṣṭvā natvā liṅgasahasrakamācārya pūjayet tatra gobhūmikāñcanādikaiḥmahāśāntivrataṃ proktaṃ gaurivratamatha śṛṇuāyurārogyajayadaṃ putrapautrasamṛddhidamkarṣaṇādyarcanāntaṃ tu taruṇālasaṃgrahetanyāni sarva karmāṇi bhāṣitāni samāni catadūrdhve bālabālyatvaṃ tasmān mūle praveśayetviṃśaddhasta pravistāramuttamaṃ maṇḍapaṃ bhavetṣattriṃśadgrātrasaṃyuktamuttamaṃ maṇḍapaṃ smṛtamdiśiśca vidiśiścaiva nicchidraṃ vyomasaṃbhavamvitānadhvajasaṃyuktaṃ darbhamālāsamāvṛtamstambhāni veṣṭayet tatra pratyekaṃ vastraveṣṭitamratnimātramutsedhaṃ darpaṇodarasannibhaṃyugāṅgulasamutsedhaṃ dviguṇaṃ nīvṛmucyatenavāgnivātha pañcāgniṃ ekāgniṃ samudācaretśrotrārdhāṃ śoccamānena kṣetraṃ pañcaikabhāgikamyonikuṇḍaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā lakṣaṇaṃ samyagācaretpuṇyāhaṃ vācayet tatra brahmaṇān bhojayet tataḥsamaryavade samyagvāstu homaṃ tu kārayetkṛtvā tu vidhinā snātvanaṃ śuklacandanalepitaṃaṅkurānarpayed dhīmān sthānaśuddhi samācaretgarbhagehaṃ praviśyātha sthānaśuddhiṃ tataḥ kurupuṇyāhaṃ tu tataḥ kṛtvā śuddhodairabhiṣecayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: darbhamūle tu valmikaṃ kṣetre mṛdgṛhya lepayetcandanāgarukoṣṭhaṃ ca kuṅkumo śirakesaraiḥpiṇḍikābja samālipya prokṣayecchaktibījakamaṣṭapuṣpaiḥ samabhyarcya samānyaṃ puṣpapūritamtato bālagṛhaṃ paścāt pūjayed gauri saṃyutamsthaṇḍilaṃ hastamātreṇa nirdoṣaissikatairapisamidhā sadyamantreṇa īśānena ghṛtaṃ hunetprāsādaṃ śaktibījaiśca vyomavyāpi daśākṣaraiḥspṛṣṭvā tu juhuyāddhomaṃ gauribījamanusmarankumbhaṃ vā karakaṃ vāpi sthaṇḍilopari vinyasetnālikeraphalairyuktān lambakūrcasamanvitānsthāpayed vāma mantreṇa aghoreṇāvakuṇṭhayetdarśaye śaktimudrāṃ ca mukaliṃ padmamudrikāsūtrādibhiḥ samopetā abhito'ṣṭa ghaṭānnyasetkumbhamadhye samāvāhya tat tad bījamanusmarannaivedyaṃ dhūpadīpaṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ ca nivedayetpūrṇāhutiṃ ca śirasā ghaṭamuddhārayet tataḥpañcagavyena saṃprokṣya praviśedyāgamaṇḍapetaṇḍulaiśca tilaiścaiva lājaiḥ puṣpaiśca darbhakaiḥśirasā vāhayitvā tu pradakṣiṇamathācaretśanaiḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ kuryādumāsūktajapaṃ kramātgauribījamanusmṛtya kumbhaṃ tatraiva pūjayetsvanāmamantrerabhyarcya gandhapuṣpādibhiryajetgandhapuṣpādibhiścaiva pūjayet tu nivedyakamśrīsūktaṃ rudrasūktaṃ ca puruṣasūktatrayambakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ācāryo mūrtipaissārdhaṃ tato homasamācaretsamidhājya carūn lājān sarṣapāśca yavān tilānpalāśodumbaraśvattho bilvaṃ ca khādiraṃ tathālājaṃ vāmena mantreṇa sarṣapaṃ kavacena tuśatasyatratayaṃ vāpi tasyārdhaṃ vārdhameva vāsarvadravyasamāyuktaṃ havyavāhena homayetācāryo mūrtipaissārthaṃ vidhinā snānamācaretśaktikumbhaṃ samuddhṛtya kṛtvā harmyā pradakṣiṇamputrabhṛtra kalatraiśca sarvasaṃpat sukhāvahamsumuhūrte nirikṣyātha devājño sanniveśayetmantrapuṣpā tato datvā mantrānnaṃ ca nivedayetprabhāta haviṣaṃ datvā tāmbūlaṃ ca nivedayetnṛgādhyāyanaṃ kuryāt stotranṛttaṃ ca vādyakamprokṣaṇānte viśeṣeṇa utsavyaṃ samyagācaretutpāta dvividhaṃ proktaṃ sāmānyaṃ ca mahādbhutamtattatpratikriyā samyak kartavyā doṣanāśanibrāhmaṇānāṃ nṛpāṇāṃ ca viśeṣād doṣadaṃ mahatbhāskarasyodaye rātrāmamāvasyondudarśanepratimārodane caiva tataśśoṇitavarṣakevarṣe tu kṣīrasṛgbhyāṃ ca vṛkṣācchroṇitakasravepatite caiva taddhāmasthānāsthānāntarāptiketadanya puṣpa saṃbhūte gandhānanya tu saṃbhaveaṇḍajā svedajāścaiva catuṣpāñca tathā narāśvetavāyasasaṃbhūte parvatadvandayuddhakebhinne ca śivavarddhanyau liṅgapratimayostu vā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pratimānilidṛṣṭena kariṇimadasaṃyuteaṅgādhikasamutpanne catuṣpāt tu tathaiva cadarśane pratisūryasya praticandrasya darśanegṛhanakṣatrapāte ca saptāhe śanisaṃkulemahāmātaprakope ca diśāṃ dāhasamudbhaveakasmāt patite puṣpe sitapuṣpe site tathāśukāśca mūṣikotpannā viṣasarpādiko bhavetparivārālaye caiva madhu nīḍa samudbhavepatati kāraṇārdhāme vṛṣe caiva viśeṣataḥraktastrivāyasolūkajambugṛddhrāśca piṅgalādevālayopariṣṭāt tu nṛpasya bhavanopariliṅgaṃ ca pratimāyāṃ vā khadyotarohiṇe satiliṅgaṃ mūle ca bimbe ca jatvārohaṇake satiteṣāṃ doṣanivṛtyarthaṃ pravakṣyāmi pratikriyāmdiśāhomaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā mahāsnapanamuttamambrāhmaṇānbhojayet tatra vratiṃ tatra tu bhojayetcandrodaye tvamāvāsyāṃ gonāśaṃ sasyanāśanamsaṃbhavedbhūmikampe ca rājārāṣṭrasya doṣakṛtsaṃsnāpya śivasaṃyaṅmahāvyometi mantrataḥbrahmaṇānbhojayennityaṃ ekaviṃśad dināntakamdurbhikṣaṃ jāyate loke mahāmāri bhavet tataḥmaṇṭape maṇḍalaṃ samyak tanmadhye sthaṇḍilaṃ kuruvyāghātasamidhaḥ kṛtvā astramantreṇa deśikaḥśatamarthaṃ tadardhaṃ vā pratyekaṃ juhuyāt kramātjayādirabhyādhānaṃ ca rāṣṭrabhṛśca kramādhunet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: evaṃ kyruāt tu pañcāham ante cotssvamācarettanmaṇḍalādhipo rājā grāmaṃ rāṣṭraṃ viniśyatipakṣaṃ pakṣadvayaṃ vādhāśamithaiśāntihomakaiḥbrāhmaṇānbhojayennityaṃ patināṃ caiva bhojayetprāsādamaṇḍapādīni toyena kṣālayet tataḥparyagnikaraṇaṃ kṛtvā punaḥ puṇyāhamācaretsaṃsnāpya vidhivanmatri mahāvyomiti mantrataḥevaṃ kuryāt tu saptāhaṃ mante cotsavamācarettat tat prasthahasraiśca snāpayed deśikottamaḥaśokasamidhā caiva śāntihomaṃ tu kārayetvṛkṣācchroṇitasaṃbhūte paracakrād bhayaṃ bhavetbrāhmaṇān bhojayet tatra vāstu devān prapūjayetpūjayet tu viśeṣeṇa prabhūta haviṣa dadetstrīṇāṃ caiva tu bālānāṃ kṣetrāṇāṃ caiva nāśanampunaḥ bimbaṃ samāpādya pūrvavat sthāpayed guruḥsthānāntaraṃ ca prāptiścet sthānabhraṃśaṃ nṛpasya tudevasya sthāpanaṃ pragvatpūjayet tu viśeṣataḥvardhanī śivakumbhau ca cchinne bhinne tadantikekārayedvidhivadrājā bhaktyā taṭe ṣaśāntayetadanyakusumotpanne rasagandhānyasaṃbhavettajjātivṛkṣaṃ saṃsarvaṃ pūrvasthāne viśeṣataḥśivasaṃpūjya vidhivat saptāhaṃ snapanaṃ kurutataḥ phalāni sarvāṇi puṣpaissarveyyajecchivamgonāśaṃ caiva durbhikṣaṃ tadrāṣṭrau jāyate dhruvamnālikerodakenāpi snāpayet tu śivaṃ budhaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pūjayet tu viśeṣeṇa kuṅkumo śiracandanemahāhavi pradātavyaṃ diśāhomaṃ tu kārayetaṇḍajāsvedajāścaiva catuṣpādā narāstathāgobhūmikāñcanādini dānaṃ kuryā prayatnataḥevaṃ kuryāt tu saptāhaṃ ante cotsavamācaretpratyekaṃ prasthasāhasrairgavyaiḥ prāsādameva caprāsādaṃ prokṣayed dhīmān pūrvokta vidhinā sahasittotra sumamutpanne rāṣṭrakṣobhaṃ bhavet sadāvaikaṅkatena samidhā śāntihomaṃ tu kārayettatparvata samīpe tu liṅgaṃ saṃsthāpya pūjayetviśeṣapūjanaṃ kuryāt tadante cotsavaṃ caretagnikṣobhaṃ ca tadrāṣṭre sadya eva bhaved dhruvamsamidhājya carūlājān sarṣapān homamācaretśatamardhaṃ tadardhaṃ vā pratyekaṃ juhuyāt kramātpratyekaṃ tu sahasraṃ vā tadardhaṃ juhuyāt kramātkṛtvā tu snapanaṃ paścād viśeṣeṇaiva pūjayetpratimā kampanotpanne rājāmaraṇamāpnuyātdiśāhomaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā puṇyāhaṃ vācayet tataḥbhinne ca śivavardhanyau liṅgaṃ pratimayaṃ tathābālastānaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā prāsādaṃ pūrvavat kurutenaiva bhinnaliṅgaṃ ceduddhṛtya sthāpayennavampratiṣṭhākārayed dhīmān pūrvokta vidhinā sahapunaḥ sandhānakaṃ kṛtvā saṃprokṣaṇamathācaretpañcagavyāmṛtaiścaiva abhiṣekaṃ ca kārayetsnāpayet parameśānaṃ mahāvyometi mantrataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: samidhā khādireṇaiva śāntihomaṃ tu kārayetpratimonmilanaṃ kṛtvā (yatra) rāṣṭragrāmasya nāśanamsnapanaṃ kārayennityaṃ diśāhomaṃ tu kārayetkariṇimadasaṃyukte mahāvātaprakopaneśivasaṃpūjya vidhivat snapanaṃ kuru nityaśāevaṃ saptadinaṃ nītvā mahāhaviṃ nivedayetparacakrādbhayaṃ tatra bhūmau saṃbhavati dhruvamvyākhyāta samidhā caiva śāntihomaṃ tu kārayetkṣiraprasthasahasraiśca snāpayet parameśvaramliṅgaṃ varṇāntare prāpte jātidūṣaṇamālabhetpeṣayitvā yathā mantri liṅgamālepayet tataḥaśokasamidhā hutvā tryambakenaiva deśikābherighosa svayaṃ jāte mahāmāri pravarttatepakṣaṃ pakṣadvayaṃ vāpi evamevaṃ samācaretādityodayakāle tu pratisūryasya darśaneaśvaddhasamidhā caiva śāntihomaṃ tu kārayetprabhūta haviṣā dattvā evaṃ saptāhamācaretdurbhikṣaṃ jāyate loke mahāmāri pravartaterālāvidradharudṛṣṭau vahninakṣatradarśanejvaragrastā narāssarve vāhanānāṃ kṣayaṃ bhavetśāntihomaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā aśvaddha samidhā tataḥnairantaryeṇa saptāhaṃ maniśaṃ patite satiavasāne ghṛtakṣīraprastanāṃ tu sahasrakaiḥtadante snapanaṃ kuryāt prabhūta haviṣaṃ dadettanmaṇḍalādhipo rājā yuddhe maraṇamāpnuyāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kṛtvā prastasahasrai ca kṣireṇaiva maheśvaramdiśāhomaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā evaṃ saptāhamācaretvastrānulepanaṃ tadvadgāmadūṣaṇamādiśetativa śalabhotpanne unmatte vāhane tathāprāṇināṃ naśanaṃ caiva anāvṛṣṭiṃ na saṃśayaḥdaśadvādaśahastaṃ vā darpaṇodarasannibhamhastadvayapramāṇena vṛttakuṇḍaṃ tu madhyamenābhiyonisamāyuktaṃ kārayed deśikottamaḥśivāgniṃ kalpayitvā tu agnikāryoktavanmanākārpāsasya tu bījaṃ ca homayed deśikottamaḥśamibilvamaśokaṃ ca mayūraṃ ca vidikṣu capañcabrahmaṣaḍaṅgaiśca vidyāṅgairmūlamantrataḥsahasraṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā pratyekaṃ juhuyāt kramāttadante snapanaṃ kuryād viśeṣeṇaiva pūjayetevamevaṃ tu madhyāhne japtvevaṃ kārayed budhaḥparivārālaye caiva madhu niḍasamudbhaveprapohya madhuniḍa tatprokṣayecchuddhavāriṇāmadhvāja payasādhīmān snāpayet parameśvaramtadante snapanaṃ kuryād devaṃ saptāhamācaretanāvṛṣṭi samutpanne gonāśaṃ sasyanāśanamkṣīrābhiṣecanaṃ kṛtvā tadante snapanaṃ kuruativṛṣṭisamudbhūte durbhikṣaṃ bhavati dhruvamsnāpayet parameśānaṃ tadante snapanaṃ kuruṣaḍaṅgulapramāṇena veṣṭayelliṅgapīṭhikāgoghṛtenasamāyuktaṃ vedatālapramāṇataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mudgabhinnasamāyuktaṃ prabhūtahaviṣaṃ dadetpradhānapaṅkajaṃ vāpi maraṇaṃ tu bhaved yatiyuddhedyoge nṛpasyaiva vinā pātadramasya tupradhānāśca gajaṃ vāpi maraṇaṃ tu bhavedyatimahādānaṃ prakurvita brāhmaṇānāṃ viśeṣataḥmahāhavistato datvā vāstudevān prapūjayetvidyāpiyāgaśālāyāṃ sabhāsthāne ca catvarepratikriyā ca kartavyā raktastri jāyate yadisabhāsthāne samutpanne grāmanāśaṃ bhavet tadāmaṭhe caiva samutpanne grāmadūṣaṇamādiśetradhyā samutthite strīṇāṃ bālānāṃ nāśanaṃ bhavettatpradeśaṃ tathā khātvā pūrayedvā yugādibhiḥpañcagavyena saṃprokṣya pavamānamudirayantadante snapanaṃ kṛtvā śāntihomaṃ samācaretālayāntaṃ praviṣṭe ca nṛpaṃ veśmāntare'thavāśītakumbhaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā śāntihoma samācaretdevālayopariṣṭāntaṃ nṛpasya bhavanoparitadaṃ hatvā tryajaṃ tyaktvā puṇyāhavācayet tataḥbrāhmaṇān bhojayet paścāt kuryā cā snapanaṃ mahatliṅgaṃ ca pratimā caiva jantvārohaṇake satitaṃ hatvā cādha sadyotra tad devān snāpayet tataḥsnapanaṃ tu tataḥ kṛtvā mahāhaviṃ nivedayetdṛśyate tatra niścitya prāyaścitta samācaretrāṣṭrakṣobhaṃ ca durbhikṣaṃ jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥśāntihomaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā samidhā khādireṇa tu
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vyatirikta kriyākāryo śāntihomena śāmyatimāsaṃ māse nayet kṛtvā niṣphalatvaṃ prajāyatevastrāṅguliyakaiścaiva gobhūmidhanadhānyakaiḥtriguṇaṃ cottamaṃ vidyā deśikasya tu dakṣiṇāyāgopayoga dravyāṇi deśikāya pradāpayetgrāme vā nagare vāpi paṭṭaṇe rājadhānikeevaṃ sthānaviśūnyaścet pūrve vā dakṣiṇe'pi vāgrāmamānaṃ caturbhāgaṃ vasubhāgamathāpi vāevaṃ niścitya vidhisyād bāhye vābhyantare'pi vābrahmādīśānaparyantaṃ indrādīśāntakaṃ kramātādyantaṃ baliyuktaṃ tu ayuktaṃ tu dinaṃ pratietāśca devatāssarve śūnyagrāmaṃ tu vāsinātadgrāmavāsināssarve rogaśokabhayaṃ bhavettad doṣaśamanārthāya rākṣasādi baliṃ dadetrākṣasādyāśca ye devāḥ dvāradeśā samāśrayetbalidravyaṃ tu saṃpādya deśikaṃ snānamācaretsakalikaraṇaṃ kṛtvā samānyārghyaṃ ca kalpayetnālikeraphalaṃ datvā dvikhaṇḍaṃ sarvasiddhidamvighnarāja namastubhyaṃ vijñāpya parameśvaramśivādhvarapravarttoya tavājñā kuru me sadābhūtāśca balikarmāṇi tvatprasādāt karomyahamnālikeraphalaṃ māsaṃ saṅkhyāyā pratigṛhyatāmpītaratnanibhaṃ puṣpaṃ padmapuṣpasamṛddhidamanyat sugandha puṣpaṃ ca puṣpapātre nidhāpayetgajamṛgamadaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ gandhakarpūrasaṃyutam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pañcakaṃ dārupīṭhaṃ tu caturthaṃ vā samanvitamnālikeraṃ ca tailaṃ ca samṛddhakadaliphalamkramukaṃ tailasaṃyuktaṃ tāmbūlaṃ ca samṛddhidampāyasaṃ cāḍhakenaiva tatsakhyaiśca sitākṣataiḥevaṃ dravyaṃ tu saṃpādya astreśvaramathārcayetvijñāpya parameśānaṃ balidravyantu saṅgrahetśaṅkhabheryāśca ghoṣaiśca ḍamarū paṭamardalaisadākhaṇḍaṃ khopetaṃ dīpajvālasamanvitamdvārapālān samabhyarcya snānaṃ naivedyakāntakamdvāraprakṣālya toyena nandikālau baliṃ dadetpaścādvāraṃ bahiḥ kṛtvā pañcahastapramāṇataḥtanmadhye vedikāṃ kuryād gomayā lepanaṃ kuruastreśaṃ vedikordhve tu śivakhaḍgaṃ tu vinyasetmadhye pātrāṣṭapanmaṃ ca aindre tu vasukoṇakamuttare cāṣṭaśūlam ca raktavarṇena saṃlikhetaśrasyābhyantaraṃ koṇaṃ pañcavarṇairalaṅkṛtampīṭhaṃ vinyasya madhye tu madhye maṇḍalapaścimevṛttaṃ kuḍḍupamādhikyaṃ taṇḍulaṃ pīṭhikoparikhaḍgapūrve tu vinyasya dhanurbāṇaṃ ca dakṣiṇeśūlaṃśca madhyamaṃ sthāpya odane paścabhiḥ śaramkāṃsyapātre tu taṇḍulyaṃ kārayet tasya mūrddhanitanmadhye tu mahāvattiṃ vidhayuktaṃ ca vinyasettasyordhve vātha śuddhaṃ ca nālikerasamāśṛtamsitākṣate nyasedūrdhva kadaliphalasaṃyutamtanmadhye bhūtanātheśaṃ pūrvādiṣu samarcayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mūrttimānābjapūrve tu vinyasyāṣṭa diśāsu vāpiṇḍimekaṃ pradātavyaṃ vattidīpasamanvitamnair-ṛte caiva ṣaṭkoṇaṃ pañcacūrṇaivilikhya caaiśānyāṃ maṇḍalaṃ kalpya catuṣkoṇasamanvitamnālikerodakenaiva lambayet tu padārthakamcatuṣpathe piśācāśca tripa rākṣasāṃ balimtripathe bhairavaṃ pūjya dvipathe asurārcanamevaṃ krameṇa saṃpūjya puṣpaṃ grāhya vikīrya caśivakhaḍgena saṃśodhya raktatoyaṃ visajya canamaste bhūtanātheśaṃ prītyarthaṃ baligṛhyatāmtataḥ pratimanā bhūtvā gacchadhvaṃ si yathā sukhamtad grāme bhadrakālyāśca tṛpyarthaṃ balimācaretpādaprakṣālanaṃ kṛtvā paścād vāstu praveśayetbhūtapīṭhe dramadhye vā vāstumadhye prakalpayetkubera īśa saṃyukte yathā devabaliṃ kṣipetmṛgayātrādi tīrthāśca vāstu bāhyeṣu yānakamgrāmaśāntibaliṃ kuryāt sarvābhiṣṭaphalapradamgrāmaśāntibale hīne tadrāṣṭre vāstunāśanamtadṛṣṭhavāsinassarve jvaramaryādi piḍitātadanto cotsavaṃ kuryāt sarvakāmaphalapradamevaṃ yaḥ kurute martyaḥ sa puṇyāgatimāpnuyātpraṇināṃ bhogamevaṃ syād bhavatīnāṃ sukhaṃ bhavetevaṃ trividhamākhyātaṃ uttamāyathamadhyameabdhiśreyān samasya syānadimadhyaṃ ca madhyameabhiṣeka kṛtaṃ beraṃ uttamantu praśasyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sadyaniṣkṛtiberaṃ tu adhamaṃ cocyate mayāmadhyamaberamevaṃ tu nadyādīn darśanaṃ matamśatakośavidhiryāvaduttame darśanaṃ matamdvādaśaṃ kośamevaṃ tu adhame darśanaṃ matamdevadāṃśāṃśa vihīnaṃ syātkrameṇa parikalpayetśasukhyacottamañcaiva dina saṅkhya krameṇa tutallilā dviguṇavidhaṃ proktaṃ vā sāyanaṃ ca kathyatesarvālaṅkārasaṃyukte maṇḍapaṃ prati bhūṣayetdevadeva jagannātha jagadārtti vināmunāsvarṇādi sūtra saṃgṛhya rakṣābandhaṃ pūroktavatprātassandhyāvasāne tu surivṛndaiśca sevitammaddhyāhne pūjaye nānte tu sarvālaṅkārasaṃyutammastyasthānaṃ samuddiśya yānaṃ pūrvavadācaretkarpūrarajanī cūrṇaṃ rāgavallidalairapiuttare paścime vāpi pūrvo vā dakṣiṇe'pi vādevaṃ madhye tu vinyasya tadagre matsya pūjanamtaṇḍulaiḥ tilalājaiśca matsyaṃ samyak samarcayetevaṃ mantrasamuccārya matsyānaṃ bhojanaṃ nayettadante yānakārye tu limlāganaṃ ca gādhakamsnapanaṃ śāntihomaṃ ca snāpayet parameśvarampūrvavannityapūjāṃ ca viśeṣot pūjadantakeālayasya samīpaṃ cedhyānamevaṃ vidhīyaterātrau pūjāvasāne tu kartadeśikasaṃyutamekamūrtti svarūpaṃ tu pañcadhā parikalpayetambikāsahito devo jagadutpattikāraṇāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: evaṃ prārtthatu tatkāle bhagavānujñayā sahātataḥ prābhāte kartavyaṃ sarvālaṅkāraśobhitamrājopacārasahitaṃ yānaṃ bandhaḥ śanaiśanaiḥmanoramye'nyadeśeva bhakṣyādini nivedayetdinaṃ prati viśeṣeṇaṃ snapanaṃ śāntihomakamuddiśya sthānadeśe tu prapāṃ kṛtvā salakṣaṇāmmaheśaṃ tatra vinyasya līlāgānamadha śṛṇumatsyabhojanamagre tu taṇḍulādi pṛthak pṛthakmatsyalīlā samālokya matsyānāṃ bhojanaṃ kṣipetnityapūjāvihīnaṃ cet prāyaścittaṃ tathā caretprāyaścittavihinaṃ cedrājārāṣṭrasya doṣakṛtlīlāvasāne kartavyaṃ vimukhaṃ yānamucyatesnapanaṃ śāntihomaṃ ca prabhūta haviṣaṃ dadetmelāṃ mantra samuccāryā puṣpamūrdhni nidāpayetevameva prakāreṇa matsyalīlā samācaretmatsyalīlā vidhi proktaṃ mauktikagrahaṇaṃ śṛṇuphalgune caitramāse vā kṛttikeva pare'pi capūrvapakṣe gṛhītaṃ cedaṣṭaminavami tathākṛṣṇapakṣe gṛhitaṃ ce caturthipañcami tathāvarjayet tu prayatnena anyāśca tithayo bhavetaśvayuk rohiṇī caiva puṣyā ca madya eva caetadṛkṣaṃ gṛhitvā tu anyadṛkṣaṃ tu kanyasamvajre vajraṃ ca siddhiṃ ca parighaḥ śivayeva capratirāyuṣmamevaṃ ca saubhāgyaṃ śobhanaṃ tathāetāśca śubhadā proktā anyayogāni varjayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kumbhaścaiva śubhā jñeyā anyarāśivivarjayetniścitya divasātpūrve prātasandhyāvasānakerājā cihnani sarvāṇi tadūrdhve sthāpayet kramātmauktikagrahaṇārthāya ratnaṃ saṃgrāhya sanmatamddhvajādichatraparyantaṃ ḍiṇḍivādyasamanvitametatsarvagṛhitvā tu yānaṃ pūrvavaducyatetanmadhye vedikāyuktaṃ sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutampatākādi vitānaiśca pūgādyaiścaiva śobhayetnityapūjāṃ prayatnena nityavatpūjanaṃ kuruamburā namastyaṃ mauktika grahaṇāya cadaddhayābdhe ta namastubhyaṃ mauktikagrahaṇāya camabdhe tu namastubhyaṃ mauktikagrahaṇāya casārabdhe tu namastubhyaṃ mauktikagrahaṇāya caevameva prakāreṇa arcayed deśikottamaḥdevaṃ samyaksamāropya paṭamāropayed dhvajamdevāgre sarvavādyaiśca līlāgānaṃ ca vadayetsarvavādyaintramārgeṇa mauktikaṃ grahaṇaṃ matampaścime ni-ṛte vāpi aiśānye cottare'pi cātacchālāṃ ratnamāveśya sādhāhantaṃ masā vidhinityapūjā prayatnena nityavatsamyagācaretevameva krameṇaiva pakṣāhāntasamācaretāsthānamaṇḍape prāpya sūrivṛndaiśca sevitammūlālaye prakartavyaṃ pūrvavat pūjanaṃ nayettasmāt sarvaprayatnena nityapūjā puroktavatmaheśāgre viśeṣeṇa gomayālepanaṃ kuru
source_edition: Muktabodha M00329 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: devāgra vinyasedratna tadravyamaṣṭadhā bhavetādithyamaṃśakaścaiva suriṇāmaṃśakaṃ tathāṣoḍaśaṃ devabhāgaṃ syād devabhāgaṃ krameṇa tusarvalokahitaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvadeva prayārthakamsthānācāryo phaṇikarmi samayi samāyadhipaḥbhaṅgarājapadestvagramaṇḍape deśikasya canair-ṛte tviśadeśe vā saumye vā samayādhipaḥnai-ṛte tviśadeśe vā karmasthā maṇimaṇḍapesthānākhya maṇḍapadvāre samiyi sthānamucyatemadvadhyaṃ hamradvārapārśve svadeśisthānamucyatecakracihnapradānāṃ ca kriyāni yogameva cadravyaṃ puṣpakṛtaṃ caiva cakrabhāgasya sādhanamācāramevamākhyātaṃ cakrarūpaṃ tataḥ śṛṇuparaśuṃ hemamudrā ca kṣvaṇikaṃ phiṇḍiphālakamsamicaṇḍaṃ ca mudrārhaparaśuṃ samayādhipaḥācāryo dharmamudrādin phaṇibhyādi kara dadetpūjopakaraṇadravyaṃ tattadravyādhipātryadhāsvadeśikṛtyamevoktaṃ samayi caritaṃ śṛṇutatkāle sami viyogyaṃ prerayitvā na saṃkaramyāgopakaraṇadravyaṃ tat tatkāraṇabhārakānsamayikṛtyamevoktaṃ samayāśādhipate śṛṇupunaścakre samāyojya yathāśaktyā praśaṃsitānkarmikṛtyamiti proktaṃ * * * * ritaṃ śṛṇusthānācāryeṇa saṃyuktaṃ vij~āpya svānubhūtikamsthānācārya kare dadyāt tat tan mantrasamuccaran
